Fatty acids cannot give pyruvate because the pyruvate dehydrogenase step is irreversible; ketone bodies are a catabolic dead end and do not start the PPP; glycerol is glucogenic but enters as DHAP, not through citrate and the TCA cycle.

quiz.q_zh: 在人体内，脂肪的哪一部分仍然可以净生成葡萄糖？
quiz.q_en: In humans, which part of a fat molecule can still give a net yield of glucose?

options.zh: 由乙酰CoA 缩合成的乙酰乙酸酮体
options.en: The acetoacetate ketone body made from acetyl-CoA

options.zh: 偶数碳脂肪酸链切出的乙酰CoA 单位
options.en: Acetyl-CoA units cut from an even-chain fatty acid

options.zh: β-氧化产生的 FADH₂ 与 NADH
options.en: The FADH2 and NADH produced by β-oxidation

options.zh: 甘油三酯分子骨架上的那一分子甘油
options.en: The single glycerol on the triacylglycerol backbone

quiz.explain_zh: 甘油经甘油激酶变成 3-磷酸甘油，再氧化为 DHAP 直接进糖异生，是脂肪里唯一常规的生糖部分。乙酰CoA 进 TCA 时进两个碳、放两个 CO₂，净碳为零；FADH₂ 和 NADH 只提供还原当量和 ATP，不提供碳骨架；酮体在肝外重新变回乙酰CoA，同样不能净生糖。
quiz.explain_en: Glycerol kinase makes glycerol-3-phosphate, oxidised to DHAP, which enters gluconeogenesis directly — the one routinely glucogenic part of fat. Acetyl-CoA brings two carbons into the TCA cycle and two leave as CO2, for zero net gain; FADH2 and NADH supply reducing equivalents and ATP, not carbon skeletons; ketone bodies revert to acetyl-CoA in extrahepatic tissue and are equally non-glucogenic.

title_zh: 糖原的结构与分解：磷酸化酶、G1P，以及合成第一步的 UTP
title_en: Glycogen structure and breakdown: phosphorylase, G1P, and UTP at the first step of synthesis

points.zh: 糖的这一章讲到最后一节：糖原的合成与分解。
points.en: The carbohydrate chapter closes with its last section: glycogen synthesis and breakdown.

points.zh: 他说糖原是一种类似淀粉的物质，只是葡萄糖分子之间形成糖苷键的形式稍有不同。
points.en: He calls glycogen a starch-like substance, differing only in how the glycosidic bonds between glucose units are formed.

points.zh: 他说淀粉一般来说是直链的、没有分支，而糖原是可以有分支的一种葡萄糖聚合物。
points.en: He says starch is generally linear and unbranched, while glycogen is a glucose polymer that can branch.

points.zh: 糖原的分解很简单：糖原加一分子磷酸，在糖原磷酸化酶作用下生成一分子 1-磷酸葡萄糖 (G1P)。
points.en: Glycogen breakdown is simple: glycogen plus one phosphate, under glycogen phosphorylase, yields one glucose-1-phosphate (G1P).

points.zh: 他特别提醒这一点不一样：磷酸加在 1 位上，而整张 EMP 图里讲的都是 6 位磷酸化的葡萄糖。
points.en: He stresses the difference: the phosphate goes on carbon 1, whereas everything in the EMP diagram is phosphorylated at carbon 6.

points.zh: 有一种酶可以随意地把 G1P 和 G6P 互相切换、进行异构，两者可以相互转化。
points.en: An enzyme freely interconverts G1P and G6P, isomerising one into the other.

points.zh: 糖原合成的第一步是 G1P 加一分子 UTP。
points.en: The first step of glycogen synthesis is G1P plus one UTP.

points.zh: 他强调 UTP 是重点：这是整个生化过程里基本上唯一一个由 UTP 供能的反应，GTP 供能的反应还不算很少，UTP 却几乎只有这一处（他补了一句核酸那一章可能还有一个）。
points.en: He stresses UTP as the point: this is essentially the only UTP-driven reaction in the whole of biochemistry — GTP-driven reactions are not rare, but UTP has almost only this one (he adds that the nucleic acid chapter may hold another).

points.zh: G1P 与 UTP 形成一个复合物，叫 UDPG。
points.en: G1P and UTP form a complex called UDPG.

extra.zh: 「淀粉没有分支、糖原有分支」是错的。淀粉是直链淀粉 amylose（α-1,4，无分支）和支链淀粉 amylopectin（α-1,4 主链 + α-1,6 分支）的混合物，而且支链淀粉通常占 70–80%。糖原与淀粉的真正差别是分支密度：糖原每 8–12 个残基一个 α-1,6 分支，支链淀粉约每 24–30 个残基才有一个。他把量的差别讲成了有无的差别。
extra.en: "Starch is unbranched, glycogen is branched" is wrong. Starch is a mixture of amylose (α-1,4, unbranched) and amylopectin (α-1,4 backbone with α-1,6 branches), and amylopectin is usually 70–80% of it. The real difference from glycogen is branch density: glycogen branches every 8–12 residues, amylopectin only every 24–30. He turned a quantitative difference into a presence/absence one.

extra.zh: 分支为什么重要：糖原磷酸化酶只能从非还原端往里啃，分支越密非还原端越多，能同时开工的位点就越多，动员速度也越快——这正是储能形式选糖原而不选淀粉的理由。而且磷酸化酶啃到离分支点 4 个残基就停下，剩下的要靠脱支酶（一个双功能酶）：先把 3 个残基整段转移到邻近链的非还原端（转移酶活性），再水解掉分支点上最后那个 α-1,6 连接的残基（α-1,6-葡萄糖苷酶活性）。所以糖原分解的产物约 90% 是 G1P、约 10% 是游离葡萄糖。
extra.en: Why branching matters: glycogen phosphorylase can only chew inward from a non-reducing end, so denser branching means more ends, more simultaneous working sites, and faster mobilisation — exactly why the storage form is glycogen rather than starch. Phosphorylase also stalls four residues from a branch point; the debranching enzyme (one bifunctional protein) then transfers three residues as a block to a nearby non-reducing end (transferase activity) and hydrolyses off the last α-1,6-linked residue (α-1,6-glucosidase activity). Hence about 90% of the product is G1P and about 10% free glucose.

extra.zh: 磷酸解 (phosphorolysis) 而不是水解，是糖原分解的省钱之处：糖原磷酸化酶用无机磷酸 Pi 直接切下 G1P，不消耗 ATP。G1P 经磷酸葡萄糖变位酶变成 G6P（他说的「那种可以随意切换的酶」就是它，机制上靠一个磷酸化的丝氨酸和 1,6-二磷酸葡萄糖中间物来回传磷酸基）。因此肌肉里糖原来源的葡萄糖单位进糖酵解时省掉了己糖激酶那一步，净得 3 个 ATP 而不是 2 个。
extra.en: Phosphorolysis rather than hydrolysis is what makes glycogen breakdown cheap: glycogen phosphorylase uses inorganic phosphate to release G1P with no ATP spent. Phosphoglucomutase then converts G1P to G6P (this is the enzyme he calls the free interconverter; it works via a phosphoserine and a glucose-1,6-bisphosphate intermediate). So a glucose unit from muscle glycogen entering glycolysis skips the hexokinase step and nets 3 ATP instead of 2.

extra.zh: 肝糖原和肌糖原用途完全不同。肝有葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶，能把 G6P 水解成游离葡萄糖送进血，所以肝糖原维持血糖；肌肉没有这个酶，G6P 只能留在细胞里进糖酵解自用，所以肌糖原不能升血糖。这也解释了上一节 Cori 循环为什么必须把乳酸送去肝脏——肌肉自己没有输出葡萄糖的出口。
extra.en: Liver and muscle glycogen serve different ends. The liver has glucose-6-phosphatase and can hydrolyse G6P to free glucose for export, so liver glycogen defends blood sugar; muscle lacks that enzyme, so its G6P stays inside and goes down glycolysis for local use, and muscle glycogen never raises blood glucose. This is also why the Cori cycle in the previous section must send lactate to the liver — muscle has no glucose exit at all.

quiz.q_zh: 关于淀粉与糖原的分支，下面哪种说法是正确的？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about branching in starch and glycogen is correct?

options.zh: 两者的分支密度相同，区别在糖苷键是 α 还是 β
options.en: Branch density is the same; the difference is an α or β glycosidic bond

options.zh: 支链淀粉的分支比糖原更密，约每 5 个残基就一个
options.en: Amylopectin branches more densely than glycogen, one per five residues

options.zh: 淀粉完全没有分支，只有糖原才带 α-1,6 分支点
options.en: Starch has no branches at all; only glycogen carries α-1,6 branch points

options.zh: 两者都有分支，糖原分支更密（约每 8–12 个残基一个）
options.en: Both branch, and glycogen branches more densely, roughly every 8–12 residues

quiz.explain_zh: 淀粉里支链淀粉占 70–80%，α-1,6 分支约每 24–30 个残基一个，糖原约每 8–12 个残基一个，所以是密度差别不是有无差别。「淀粉完全无分支」正是课上说错的那句；直链淀粉与支链淀粉、糖原全都是 α 型糖苷键，β-1,4 是纤维素；支链淀粉的分支明显比糖原稀疏，不是更密。
quiz.explain_en: Amylopectin is 70–80% of starch and branches every 24–30 residues, glycogen every 8–12, so this is a difference of density, not of presence. "Starch is wholly unbranched" is exactly the error made in class; amylose, amylopectin and glycogen all use α-glycosidic bonds, while β-1,4 is cellulose; and amylopectin branches distinctly less, not more, than glycogen.

quiz.q_zh: 糖原磷酸化酶催化的反应有什么特点？
quiz.q_en: What characterises the reaction catalysed by glycogen phosphorylase?

options.zh: 用无机磷酸磷酸解，生成 G1P 且不耗 ATP
options.en: It uses inorganic phosphate to give G1P and spends no ATP

options.zh: 用 UTP 活化葡萄糖单位，生成 UDP-葡萄糖
options.en: It activates the glucose unit with UTP to give UDP-glucose

options.zh: 直接切下 G6P 进糖酵解，消耗一个无机磷酸
options.en: It releases G6P straight into glycolysis, using one phosphate

options.zh: 水解糖苷键释放游离葡萄糖，需消耗一个 ATP
options.en: It hydrolyses the bond to free glucose and spends one ATP

quiz.explain_zh: 它是磷酸解不是水解：Pi 进攻非还原端的糖苷键，切下 1-磷酸葡萄糖，不花 ATP，这也是储能形式选糖原的经济性所在。水解并消耗 ATP 与实际相反；UTP 活化生成 UDP-葡萄糖是合成方向、由 UDP-葡萄糖焦磷酸化酶做；产物磷酸在 1 位而不是 6 位，G6P 要靠磷酸葡萄糖变位酶再转一步。
quiz.explain_en: It is phosphorolysis, not hydrolysis: inorganic phosphate attacks the glycosidic bond at a non-reducing end and releases glucose-1-phosphate at no ATP cost, part of why glycogen is an economical store. Hydrolysis with ATP expenditure is the opposite of what happens; UTP activation to UDP-glucose belongs to the synthetic direction and to UDP-glucose pyrophosphorylase; and the phosphate lands on carbon 1, not 6 — phosphoglucomutase is needed to reach G6P.

quiz.q_zh: 肌糖原分解不能升高血糖，直接原因是肌肉缺少哪种酶？
quiz.q_en: Muscle glycogen breakdown cannot raise blood glucose because muscle lacks which enzyme?

options.zh: 从糖原非还原端切下 G1P 的磷酸化酶
options.en: Phosphorylase, which cuts G1P off a non-reducing end

options.zh: 把进入胞内的葡萄糖磷酸化的己糖激酶
options.en: Hexokinase, which phosphorylates glucose entering the cell

options.zh: 把 G6P 水解成游离葡萄糖的磷酸酶
options.en: The phosphatase that hydrolyses G6P to free glucose

options.zh: 把 G1P 转成 G6P 的磷酸葡萄糖变位酶
options.en: Phosphoglucomutase, which isomerises G1P into G6P

quiz.explain_zh: 只有肝（和肾、肠）有葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶，能把 G6P 水解成能跨膜的游离葡萄糖；肌肉的 G6P 带电荷出不去，只能就地进糖酵解。变位酶和磷酸化酶肌肉都有，否则糖原根本分解不动；己糖激酶肌肉不但有而且活性很高，它的作用是把葡萄糖抓进来，方向与输出相反。
quiz.explain_en: Only liver (plus kidney and intestine) has glucose-6-phosphatase to hydrolyse G6P into membrane-permeant free glucose; the charged G6P in muscle cannot leave and goes down glycolysis on the spot. Muscle has both phosphoglucomutase and phosphorylase, or glycogen could not be broken down at all; and muscle hexokinase is abundant but traps glucose inward, the opposite of export.

title_zh: UDP-葡萄糖：两个高能磷酸键的活化，与被跳过的糖原调控
title_en: UDP-glucose: activation costing two high-energy phosphates, and the regulation he skips

points.zh: 一分子 G1P 加一分子 UTP 形成 UDPG 这个复合物。
points.en: One G1P plus one UTP forms the complex UDPG.

points.zh: 他指出 UTP 在这里相当于消耗了两分子高能磷酸键，因为它掉了一个 PPi（焦磷酸）。
points.en: He notes UTP effectively spends two high-energy phosphate bonds here, because it loses a PPi (pyrophosphate).

points.zh: 等于说 UTP 把 β 和 γ 两个磷酸都丢掉了，只保留下来一个。
points.en: That is, UTP sheds both its β and γ phosphates and keeps one.

points.zh: 他预告：脂质那一章会频繁提到「消耗两分子高能磷酸键」这种活化方式。
points.en: He previews that the lipid chapter will repeatedly feature this "two high-energy bonds" style of activation.

points.zh: 他说这里可能还把碱基也脱掉了，只剩下核糖加一个磷酸，然后又改口说 U 还在这里。
points.en: He says the base may also be removed, leaving just ribose and one phosphate, then corrects himself that the U is still there.

points.zh: 他指出剩下的那个磷酸本来就是 G1P 自带的，并对比 G1P 的磷酸在 1 位、G6P 的磷酸在 6 位。
points.en: He points out the remaining phosphate is the one G1P brought, contrasting G1P's phosphate at position 1 with G6P's at position 6.

points.zh: 第二步：UDPG 在另外一个酶的作用下重新产生 UDP 加一分子糖原。
points.en: Step two: another enzyme converts UDPG into UDP plus one unit added to glycogen.

points.zh: 所以糖原合成需要两步，第一步是由 UTP 进行的活化；他把「消耗两分子糖苷键」当场改口为「两分子高能磷酸键」。
points.en: So glycogen synthesis takes two steps, the first being UTP-driven activation; he corrects "two glycosidic bonds" on the spot to "two high-energy phosphate bonds".

points.zh: 后面那一大串糖原调控（什么时候合成、什么时候分解，酶的失活激活）他判定重要性很低、完全不用看，理由是网上都搜不到什么；只粗略提了 ATP 不足就分解糖原产生葡萄糖。
points.en: He dismisses the long regulation section that follows — when the body builds versus breaks down glycogen, enzyme activation and inactivation — as unimportant and not worth reading, on the grounds that he could find little about it online; he only notes in passing that low ATP triggers glycogen breakdown to glucose.

extra.zh: 「碱基也给脱掉了，只剩下核糖和一个磷酸」说反了。UDP-葡萄糖里保留的正是完整的 UMP 部分——尿嘧啶 + 核糖 + 一个磷酸；丢掉的是 UTP 的 β、γ 两个磷酸（以 PPi 形式离去）。他在同一段里已经自己往回找补了一句「U 在这里」，以这句为准。如果碱基真被脱掉，后面 UDP 怎么再被磷酸化成 UTP 循环使用就无法解释了。
extra.en: "The base is stripped off, leaving only ribose and one phosphate" is backwards. What UDP-glucose retains is the intact UMP moiety — uracil, ribose and one phosphate; what leaves are UTP's β and γ phosphates, departing as PPi. He half-catches this in the same passage by saying "the U is here", which is the version to keep. If the base really were removed, there would be no way to explain how UDP is later rephosphorylated to UTP for reuse.

extra.zh: 两个酶的名字他都没点出来，但都是考点。第一步是 UDP-葡萄糖焦磷酸化酶 (UDP-glucose pyrophosphorylase)：G1P + UTP → UDP-葡萄糖 + PPi，这一步本身接近等能，真正把反应拉到底的是无机焦磷酸酶把 PPi 水解成 2 Pi——这才是「净耗两个高能磷酸键」的出处。第二步是糖原合酶 (glycogen synthase)，把葡萄糖加到糖原引物的非还原端形成 α-1,4 键，它是糖原合成的限速酶和激素调控靶点。分支还需要分支酶把一段约 7 个残基转到内部形成 α-1,6 键。
extra.en: He names neither enzyme, though both are exam material. Step one is UDP-glucose pyrophosphorylase: G1P + UTP → UDP-glucose + PPi, a reaction that is near-isoenergetic on its own; what pulls it to completion is inorganic pyrophosphatase hydrolysing PPi to 2 Pi — that hydrolysis is the source of the "two high-energy bonds". Step two is glycogen synthase, adding glucose to the non-reducing end of a glycogen primer as an α-1,4 bond; it is the rate-limiting enzyme and the hormonal control point. Branching further requires branching enzyme, which moves a block of about seven residues inward to create the α-1,6 link.

extra.zh: 他说糖原调控「完全不用看」，但这一段恰恰是内分泌与代谢的经典考点，而且逻辑非常整齐：胰高血糖素/肾上腺素 → cAMP → 蛋白激酶 A → 磷酸化 → 磷酸化酶被激活、糖原合酶被灭活；胰岛素 → 蛋白磷酸酶 1 → 去磷酸化 → 结果全部反过来。同一个磷酸化信号让分解开、合成关，正是为了避免两条路同时空转。糖原起始还需要一个蛋白引物 glycogenin，它先给自己接上几个葡萄糖。
extra.en: He calls glycogen regulation "not worth reading", yet it is a classic endocrine-metabolism exam topic with unusually clean logic: glucagon or adrenaline → cAMP → protein kinase A → phosphorylation → phosphorylase on, glycogen synthase off; insulin → protein phosphatase 1 → dephosphorylation → everything reversed. One phosphorylation signal switches breakdown on and synthesis off precisely to stop the two running as a futile cycle. Starting a glycogen molecule also needs the protein primer glycogenin, which first glucosylates itself.

extra.zh: 他总结时说「ATP 不足就分解糖原，分解糖原产生葡萄糖，葡萄糖就产生 GDP」——最后那个核苷酸名字是口误，应该是 ATP：ATP 不足 → 分解糖原 → 葡萄糖进糖酵解和 TCA → 产生 ATP。整句方向是对的。
extra.en: In summing up he says "when ATP is low, glycogen is broken down, glucose is produced, and glucose produces GDP" — the last nucleotide is a slip and should be ATP: low ATP → glycogenolysis → glucose into glycolysis and the TCA cycle → ATP. The direction of the sentence is otherwise right.

quiz.q_zh: UDP-葡萄糖生成时，UTP 分子上发生了什么？
quiz.q_en: What happens to the UTP molecule when UDP-glucose is formed?

options.zh: 核糖被葡萄糖取代，形成一个尿苷酸类似物
options.en: Ribose is replaced by glucose, giving a uridylate analogue

options.zh: 尿嘧啶碱基被脱掉，只留下核糖和一个磷酸
options.en: The uracil base is removed, leaving ribose and one phosphate

options.zh: 丢掉 β、γ 两个磷酸成 PPi，保留 UMP
options.en: The β and γ phosphates leave as PPi and UMP remains

options.zh: 只丢掉 γ 磷酸成 Pi，UDP 与葡萄糖相连
options.en: Only the γ phosphate leaves as Pi, and UDP stays on glucose

quiz.explain_zh: UDP-葡萄糖 = 尿嘧啶 + 核糖 + 两个磷酸 + 葡萄糖，其中 α 磷酸来自 UTP、另一个磷酸来自 G1P，离去的是 β 和 γ 两个磷酸组成的 PPi。「碱基被脱掉」正是课上讲反的地方，碱基若没了 UDP 就无法再生成 UTP；也不是只走掉一个 Pi，那样就解释不了净耗两个高能磷酸键；核糖始终在分子上，没有被葡萄糖取代。
quiz.explain_en: UDP-glucose is uracil plus ribose plus two phosphates plus glucose, one phosphate coming from UTP's α position and the other from G1P, while the β and γ pair departs together as PPi. "The base is stripped" is the inverted claim from class — without the base, UDP could never be rebuilt into UTP; a single departing Pi would not account for the two high-energy bonds spent; and the ribose stays in the molecule throughout.

quiz.q_zh: 把糖原合成第一步拉到不可逆方向的，是下面哪一件事？
quiz.q_en: What actually pulls the first step of glycogen synthesis in the irreversible direction?

options.zh: 无机焦磷酸酶把 PPi 水解成两分子 Pi
options.en: Inorganic pyrophosphatase hydrolysing PPi into two Pi

options.zh: 糖原合酶被蛋白磷酸酶 1 去磷酸化激活
options.en: Glycogen synthase being activated by protein phosphatase 1

options.zh: 磷酸葡萄糖变位酶把 G6P 迅速转成 G1P
options.en: Phosphoglucomutase rapidly converting G6P into G1P

options.zh: 分支酶把一段残基转移形成 α-1,6 分支
options.en: Branching enzyme moving a block of residues to an α-1,6 link

quiz.explain_zh: G1P + UTP → UDP-葡萄糖 + PPi 本身接近等能，是细胞里大量存在的无机焦磷酸酶把 PPi 立刻水解掉，把平衡彻底拉向产物，也正是「净耗两个高能磷酸键」的来源。糖原合酶去磷酸化激活作用在第二步，不是这一步的热力学推手；变位酶只是提供底物；分支酶发生在链已经延长之后，与这一步的可逆性无关。
quiz.explain_en: G1P + UTP → UDP-glucose + PPi is close to isoenergetic on its own; the abundant cytosolic inorganic pyrophosphatase immediately hydrolyses the PPi, dragging the equilibrium to product, and that hydrolysis is where the two spent high-energy bonds go. Dephosphorylation of glycogen synthase acts at the second step, not as the thermodynamic driver here; phosphoglucomutase merely supplies substrate; and branching enzyme acts after the chain is already extended.

quiz.q_zh: 肾上腺素通过 cAMP 和蛋白激酶 A 引起的磷酸化，对糖原代谢两个关键酶的作用是什么？
quiz.q_en: What does adrenaline-driven phosphorylation via cAMP and protein kinase A do to the two key glycogen enzymes?

options.zh: 两个酶同时被抑制，糖原代谢整体停止运转
options.en: Both enzymes are inhibited, so glycogen metabolism halts altogether

options.zh: 糖原合酶被激活，糖原磷酸化酶同时被灭活
options.en: Glycogen synthase is activated while glycogen phosphorylase is inactivated

options.zh: 糖原磷酸化酶被激活，糖原合酶同时被灭活
options.en: Glycogen phosphorylase is activated while glycogen synthase is inactivated

options.zh: 两个酶同时被激活，合成与分解一起加快
options.en: Both enzymes are activated, so synthesis and breakdown both speed up

quiz.explain_zh: 同一个磷酸化信号对两个酶作用相反：磷酸化开启分解、关闭合成，胰岛素经蛋白磷酸酶 1 去磷酸化则完全反过来。两个酶同开会造成底物空转白白烧掉 UTP；两个酶同关则应激时动员不出葡萄糖；合成开而分解关是胰岛素信号的效果，方向与肾上腺素相反。
quiz.explain_en: One phosphorylation signal acts oppositely on the two enzymes: it switches breakdown on and synthesis off, while insulin acting through protein phosphatase 1 reverses both. Activating both would create a futile cycle burning UTP for nothing; inhibiting both would leave no glucose mobilised under stress; and synthesis-on with breakdown-off is the insulin effect, the opposite of adrenaline.

title_zh: 糖代谢总复习（上）：糖酵解与 TCA 的地位，中间产物作为枢纽
title_en: Carbohydrate review, part one: why glycolysis and the TCA cycle rank first, and intermediates as hubs

points.zh: 糖的代谢讲完了，他回过头来排一遍哪些部分最重要。
points.en: With carbohydrate metabolism finished, he goes back to rank which parts matter most.

points.zh: 第一重要的一定是糖酵解，因为它在整个能量代谢里是最基础的一种能量代谢方式。
points.en: First is unquestionably glycolysis, the most basic mode of energy metabolism in the whole system.

points.zh: 糖酵解只关心葡萄糖的糖酵解，别的糖的糖酵解一点都不用看。
points.en: Only glucose glycolysis matters; the glycolysis of other sugars can be skipped entirely.

points.zh: 其次是 TCA 循环，因为它是把丙酮酸最终完全消耗掉、产生大量能量的过程。
points.en: Next is the TCA cycle, the process that finally consumes pyruvate completely and yields most of the energy.

points.zh: TCA 还有一个开始时不容易理解的作用：它的中间代谢产物是其他途径很重要的分子前体，这才是它被叫做「循环」的原因。
points.en: The TCA cycle has a second role that is hard to grasp at first: its intermediates are important precursors for other pathways, which is why it is called a cycle.

points.zh: 他举草酰乙酸为例，说它在乳酸循环里把丙酮酸上的氢带走，最终经糖异生形成葡萄糖。
points.en: He gives oxaloacetate as an example, saying it carries the hydrogens off pyruvate in the lactate cycle and eventually forms glucose via gluconeogenesis.

points.zh: 他还举琥珀酸和延胡索酸（英文 fumarate，即富马酸），说富马酸是尿素循环里很重要的中间产物。
points.en: He also cites succinate and fumarate, noting fumarate is an important intermediate of the urea cycle.

points.zh: TCA 循环的调节相对来说重要性没那么高，可以稍微看一下；但 EMP 途径的几个不可逆步骤及其调节非常重要。
points.en: Regulation of the TCA cycle is comparatively less important and can be skimmed, but the irreversible steps of EMP and their regulation are highly important.

points.zh: 接下来一大片丙酮酸酶的调节不需要看；氧化磷酸化的重要性低于 EMP 和 TCA，但远高于磷酸戊糖途径和糖异生——五个大点里，EMP 与 TCA 第一，氧化磷酸化/电子传递链第三，后两个最不重要。
points.en: The long section on pyruvate kinase regulation can be skipped; oxidative phosphorylation ranks below EMP and the TCA cycle but well above the PPP and gluconeogenesis — of the five major topics, EMP and TCA come first, oxidative phosphorylation and the electron transport chain third, and the last two are least important.

extra.zh: 他把琥珀酸和延胡索酸并列成「琥珀酸或者是延胡索酸或者英文名叫 fumarate」，像是同一个东西的几个名字。实际上 fumarate 的中文名才是延胡索酸／富马酸；琥珀酸 succinate 是它的上游化合物，琥珀酸经琥珀酸脱氢酶（复合体 II）氧化才成为延胡索酸。他随后又单独列出「还有琥珀酸」，说明心里其实是两个分子，只是那一句并列说错了。
extra.en: He lines up succinate and fumarate as though they were alternative names for one compound — "succinate, or fumaric acid, or in English fumarate". Fumarate is the one called 延胡索酸/富马酸; succinate is the upstream compound, oxidised to fumarate by succinate dehydrogenase (complex II). He then lists "and also succinate" separately, showing he does hold them apart and only the one sentence conflated them.

extra.zh: 「草酰乙酸在乳酸循环里把丙酮酸上的氢带走」把两件事压成了一句。乳酸循环里带走氢的是乳酸脱氢酶（丙酮酸 + NADH → 乳酸）。草酰乙酸的角色在糖异生：丙酮酸在线粒体基质由丙酮酸羧化酶变成草酰乙酸，再还原成苹果酸出线粒体（顺带把还原当量带到胞质），随后由 PEP 羧激酶进入糖异生。
extra.en: "Oxaloacetate carries the hydrogens off pyruvate in the lactate cycle" compresses two separate things. In the Cori cycle the hydrogen carrier is lactate dehydrogenase (pyruvate + NADH → lactate). Oxaloacetate belongs to gluconeogenesis: pyruvate carboxylase makes it in the mitochondrial matrix, it is reduced to malate to leave the mitochondrion (carrying reducing equivalents to the cytosol on the way), and PEP carboxykinase then takes it into gluconeogenesis.

extra.zh: 「中间产物是别的途径的前体」值得展开成一张表，这是 TCA 真正的枢纽含义：柠檬酸 → 出线粒体供胞质脂肪酸合成；α-酮戊二酸 ↔ 谷氨酸（转氨基总入口，本课末尾氨基酸代谢就从这里接上）；琥珀酰CoA → 血红素（δ-氨基乙酰丙酸合成）；草酰乙酸 ↔ 天冬氨酸、也是糖异生起点；延胡索酸 → 由精氨基琥珀酸裂解酶从尿素循环放出，把尿素循环和 TCA 缝在一起（这一点他说对了）。因为中间产物会被抽走，TCA 需要回补反应 (anaplerosis)，主力就是丙酮酸羧化酶。
extra.en: "Intermediates are precursors for other pathways" deserves a table, since this is the real hub function: citrate leaves for cytosolic fatty acid synthesis; α-ketoglutarate interconverts with glutamate (the master transamination entry, which is where the amino acid section at the end of this lecture connects); succinyl-CoA feeds haem synthesis via δ-aminolevulinate; oxaloacetate interconverts with aspartate and starts gluconeogenesis; fumarate is released from the urea cycle by argininosuccinate lyase, stitching that cycle to the TCA cycle (a point he gets right). Because intermediates are siphoned off, the cycle needs anaplerotic refilling, chiefly by pyruvate carboxylase.

extra.zh: 他说 EMP 的不可逆步骤最该记，这三步是：己糖激酶／葡萄糖激酶、磷酸果糖激酶-1 (PFK-1)、丙酮酸激酶。PFK-1 是真正的限速酶，被 ATP 和柠檬酸抑制、被 AMP 和果糖-2,6-二磷酸激活；果糖-2,6-二磷酸同时抑制果糖-1,6-二磷酸酶，一个分子同时开糖酵解、关糖异生，这就是他说的「调节非常重要」的核心。
extra.en: He says the irreversible EMP steps are the ones to memorise; they are hexokinase/glucokinase, phosphofructokinase-1 and pyruvate kinase. PFK-1 is the true rate-limiting enzyme, inhibited by ATP and citrate, activated by AMP and fructose-2,6-bisphosphate. That same fructose-2,6-bisphosphate inhibits fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase, so one molecule switches glycolysis on and gluconeogenesis off — the core of the regulation he calls highly important.

quiz.q_zh: TCA 循环的哪个中间产物是尿素循环与三羧酸循环之间的连接分子？
quiz.q_en: Which TCA intermediate links the urea cycle to the citric acid cycle?

options.zh: 顺乌头酸（cis-aconitate）
options.en: cis-Aconitate

options.zh: 琥珀酰CoA（succinyl-CoA）
options.en: Succinyl-CoA

options.zh: 延胡索酸（富马酸 fumarate）
options.en: Fumarate

options.zh: 异柠檬酸（isocitrate）
options.en: Isocitrate

quiz.explain_zh: 尿素循环里精氨基琥珀酸裂解酶把精氨基琥珀酸切成精氨酸和延胡索酸，延胡索酸回到 TCA 经苹果酸变成草酰乙酸，这就是所谓「Krebs 双循环」。异柠檬酸和顺乌头酸都只是柠檬酸异构化过程中的内部环节，不向外输出；琥珀酰CoA 的确是重要枢纽，但它通向的是血红素合成和奇数碳脂肪酸入口，不是尿素循环。
quiz.explain_en: In the urea cycle, argininosuccinate lyase cleaves argininosuccinate into arginine and fumarate, and that fumarate rejoins the TCA cycle via malate to oxaloacetate — the so-called Krebs bicycle. Isocitrate and cis-aconitate are internal to the citrate isomerisation and are not exported; succinyl-CoA is indeed a major hub, but its connections are haem synthesis and odd-chain fatty acid entry, not the urea cycle.

quiz.q_zh: 糖酵解 (EMP) 中真正的限速酶及其最有力的变构激活剂是什么？
quiz.q_en: Which enzyme is the true rate-limiting step of glycolysis, and what most potently activates it?

options.zh: 丙酮酸激酶，被线粒体乙酰CoA 激活
options.en: Pyruvate kinase, activated by mitochondrial acetyl-CoA

options.zh: 己糖激酶，被自身产物葡萄糖-6-磷酸激活
options.en: Hexokinase, activated by its own product glucose-6-phosphate

options.zh: 磷酸果糖激酶-1，被果糖-2,6-二磷酸激活
options.en: Phosphofructokinase-1, activated by fructose-2,6-bisphosphate

options.zh: 磷酸甘油酸激酶，被无机磷酸浓度变构激活
options.en: Phosphoglycerate kinase, activated allosterically by phosphate

quiz.explain_zh: PFK-1 催化 F6P → F1,6BP，是糖酵解的承诺步骤，果糖-2,6-二磷酸是它最强的激活剂，同时抑制果糖-1,6-二磷酸酶。丙酮酸激酶受果糖-1,6-二磷酸前馈激活而不是乙酰CoA，乙酰CoA 激活的是丙酮酸羧化酶；己糖激酶被自己的产物 G6P 反馈抑制而不是激活；磷酸甘油酸激酶是可逆的产 ATP 步骤，不是调控点。
quiz.explain_en: PFK-1 catalyses F6P to F1,6BP, the committed step of glycolysis, and fructose-2,6-bisphosphate is its strongest activator while simultaneously inhibiting fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase. Pyruvate kinase is feed-forward activated by fructose-1,6-bisphosphate rather than acetyl-CoA, which activates pyruvate carboxylase instead; hexokinase is feedback-inhibited by its own product G6P, not activated by it; and phosphoglycerate kinase is a reversible ATP-forming step, not a control point.

title_zh: 电子传递链要点、两条穿梭与 30–32 ATP，磷酸戊糖途径与糖异生的定位
title_en: What to know about the respiratory chain, the two shuttles and 30–32 ATP, and where the PPP and gluconeogenesis sit

points.zh: 电子传递链要知道每个复合体干什么、接收什么，比如 complex I 接收的到底是 FADH₂ 还是 NADH，这一定要搞清楚。
points.en: For the respiratory chain, know what each complex does and what it accepts — for instance whether complex I takes FADH2 or NADH, which must be clear.

points.zh: 每个复合体传递多少电子、往外泵出多少个氢离子，这个要记住。
points.en: How many electrons each complex passes and how many protons it pumps out must be memorised.

points.zh: ATP 合酶的作用模式，以及后面提到的解偶联试剂，都跟 ATP 的产生相关，比较重要，可以多了解。
points.en: The working mode of ATP synthase, and the uncouplers mentioned later, both bear on ATP production and are worth extra attention.

points.zh: 两条穿梭：三磷酸甘油穿梭（他一度说成三磷酸甘油酸穿梭）和苹果酸-天冬氨酸穿梭。
points.en: The two shuttles: the glycerol phosphate shuttle (he once says glycerate) and the malate-aspartate shuttle.

points.zh: 他说它们的主要功能是把 NADH 转运到细胞膜内——随即自己改口为线粒体膜内。
points.en: He says their main job is to move NADH inside the cell membrane, immediately correcting himself to the mitochondrial membrane.

points.zh: 走三磷酸甘油穿梭就变成 FADH₂，走苹果酸-天冬氨酸穿梭就变成 NADH，他说这就是 TC 循环会产生 30–32 个 ATP 的原因。
points.en: Via the glycerol phosphate shuttle it becomes FADH2, via malate-aspartate it becomes NADH — which he says is why "the TCA cycle" yields 30–32 ATP.

points.zh: 一个 FADH₂ 产生 1.5 个 ATP，一个 NADH 产生 2.5 个 ATP；他解释说 FADH₂ 给出的能量只够合成 1.5 个（不计能量损失），NADH 给出的相对多一点，所以 NADH 用得也比 FADH₂ 稍多。
points.en: One FADH2 yields 1.5 ATP and one NADH yields 2.5; he explains FADH2 releases only enough energy for 1.5 (ignoring losses) while NADH gives somewhat more, so NADH is used a bit more often.

points.zh: 磷酸戊糖途径重要性排第四、和糖异生不分伯仲：它产生核酮糖可掺入核酸代谢，还产生大量 NADPH 作为还原力，主要不是为了产能而是进行还原作用。
points.en: The PPP ranks fourth, on par with gluconeogenesis: it makes ribulose that can feed nucleic acid metabolism and large amounts of NADPH as reducing power, whose purpose is reduction rather than energy production.

points.zh: 糖异生这一块主要讲 EMP 三个不可逆过程在糖异生里由别的酶催化、因而变得可逆；他接着说糖异生和磷酸戊糖途径两者加一起就构成了乳酸循环，可以缓解肌肉里大量 EMP 的产物。
points.en: For gluconeogenesis the point is that the three irreversible EMP steps are catalysed by different enzymes and so become reversible; he then says gluconeogenesis plus the PPP together constitute the lactate cycle, relieving the products of heavy EMP flux in muscle.

extra.zh: 「糖异生 + 磷酸戊糖途径构成乳酸循环」是错的。乳酸循环 = 肌肉的糖酵解（产乳酸）+ 肝脏的糖异生（乳酸 → 葡萄糖），磷酸戊糖途径完全不参与。这与他 24:24 前后把乳酸脱氢酶的 NADH 说成来自 PPP 是同一个误解的两次出现：PPP 被错误地塞进了乳酸循环。他前半句「糖异生用别的酶绕过 EMP 三个不可逆步骤」是对的。
extra.en: "Gluconeogenesis plus the PPP constitute the lactate cycle" is wrong. The Cori cycle is muscle glycolysis (making lactate) plus hepatic gluconeogenesis (lactate back to glucose); the PPP takes no part. This is the same misconception as at around 24:24, where LDH's NADH was attributed to the PPP, surfacing a second time — the PPP keeps being written into the Cori cycle. His first clause, that gluconeogenesis uses different enzymes to bypass the three irreversible EMP steps, is correct.

extra.zh: 「TC 循环会产生 30–32 个 ATP」的归属错了。30–32 是一分子葡萄糖完全氧化的总产量；TCA 每转一圈（每个乙酰CoA）产 10 个 ATP，一分子葡萄糖走两轮共 20 个。而且 30 与 32 的差别恰恰不来自 TCA，它来自糖酵解产生的胞质 NADH 走哪条穿梭——磷酸甘油穿梭交给 FAD 得 1.5，苹果酸-天冬氨酸穿梭交给 NAD⁺ 得 2.5，两分子 NADH 就是 2 个 ATP 的差。他讲的正是这件事，只是把结论挂到了 TCA 头上。
extra.en: "The TCA cycle yields 30–32 ATP" is misattributed. 30–32 is the total for complete oxidation of one glucose; the TCA cycle yields 10 ATP per turn (per acetyl-CoA), so 20 for the two turns one glucose drives. And the 30-versus-32 difference is precisely not from the TCA cycle: it comes from which shuttle carries cytosolic glycolytic NADH — glycerol phosphate hands it to FAD for 1.5, malate-aspartate to NAD+ for 2.5, and two NADH make the 2 ATP gap. He is describing exactly this, but hangs the conclusion on the TCA cycle.

extra.zh: 穿梭系统并不转运 NADH 本身——线粒体内膜对 NADH 不通透。被运的是还原当量：胞质 NADH 把电子交给磷酸二羟丙酮 (DHAP) 或草酰乙酸，生成的 3-磷酸甘油或苹果酸过膜，在基质侧再把电子交给 FAD 或 NAD⁺。他在 39:47 前后已把「细胞膜内」自纠为「线粒体膜内」，但「转运 NADH」这个说法仍要改成「转运还原当量」。另外名字是 3-磷酸甘油（α-磷酸甘油），不是 3-磷酸甘油酸——甘油酸是糖酵解中间产物，与该穿梭无关。
extra.en: The shuttles do not transport NADH itself — the inner membrane is impermeable to it. What moves are reducing equivalents: cytosolic NADH passes electrons to dihydroxyacetone phosphate or to oxaloacetate, and the resulting glycerol-3-phosphate or malate crosses, handing electrons to FAD or NAD+ on the matrix side. He self-corrects "cell membrane" to "mitochondrial membrane" around 39:47, but "transporting NADH" still needs to read "transporting reducing equivalents". The name is also glycerol-3-phosphate, not 3-phosphoglycerate — glycerate compounds are glycolytic intermediates unrelated to this shuttle.

extra.zh: 「磷酸戊糖途径产生核酮糖掺入核酸代谢」少了一步：进入核苷酸合成的是 5-磷酸核糖，核酮糖-5-磷酸是氧化阶段的直接产物，要经异构酶转成核糖-5-磷酸，再由 PRPP 合成酶变成 PRPP 才是嘌呤／嘧啶合成的实际起点。另外 NADPH 的具体去向他没点名：脂肪酸和胆固醇合成的还原步骤、谷胱甘肽还原酶维持 GSH、以及中性粒细胞 NADPH 氧化酶的呼吸爆发。
extra.en: "The PPP makes ribulose that feeds nucleic acid metabolism" skips a step: what enters nucleotide synthesis is ribose-5-phosphate. Ribulose-5-phosphate is the direct product of the oxidative phase and must be isomerised to ribose-5-phosphate, then converted by PRPP synthetase to PRPP, which is the actual starting point for purine and pyrimidine synthesis. He also never names where NADPH goes: the reductive steps of fatty acid and cholesterol synthesis, glutathione reductase keeping GSH reduced, and the neutrophil NADPH oxidase respiratory burst.

quiz.q_zh: 一分子葡萄糖完全氧化产 30 还是 32 个 ATP，差别来自哪里？
quiz.q_en: Whether complete oxidation of one glucose yields 30 or 32 ATP depends on what?

options.zh: TCA 循环究竟转了两轮还是只转一轮
options.en: Whether the TCA cycle turned twice or just a single time

options.zh: 丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体是否被磷酸化所抑制
options.en: Whether the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex was inhibited

options.zh: 糖酵解产的胞质 NADH 走哪一条穿梭
options.en: Which shuttle carries the cytosolic NADH made by glycolysis

options.zh: 葡萄糖进细胞走 GLUT4 还是 GLUT2
options.en: Whether glucose entered the cell by GLUT4 or by GLUT2

quiz.explain_zh: 磷酸甘油穿梭把电子交给 FAD，两分子胞质 NADH 只值 2×1.5 = 3；苹果酸-天冬氨酸穿梭交给 NAD⁺，值 2×2.5 = 5，正好是 2 个 ATP 的差。TCA 每分子葡萄糖固定转两轮，不是变量；丙酮酸脱氢酶被抑制会让整条路停下而不是差 2 个；转运体决定的是葡萄糖进不进得来，与线粒体内的产率无关。
quiz.explain_en: The glycerol phosphate shuttle gives electrons to FAD, so two cytosolic NADH are worth 2 × 1.5 = 3; the malate-aspartate shuttle gives them to NAD+, worth 2 × 2.5 = 5 — exactly the 2 ATP gap. The TCA cycle always turns twice per glucose and is not the variable; inhibiting pyruvate dehydrogenase would stop the pathway rather than cost 2 ATP; and the transporter governs whether glucose gets in at all, not the mitochondrial yield.

quiz.q_zh: 苹果酸-天冬氨酸穿梭实际转运进线粒体的是什么？
quiz.q_en: What does the malate-aspartate shuttle actually move into the mitochondrion?

options.zh: 载体携带的还原当量（电子）
options.en: Reducing equivalents carried as electrons

options.zh: 游离的 NADPH 与磷酸基
options.en: Free NADPH together with its phosphate

options.zh: 乙酰CoA 与草酰乙酸复合物
options.en: A complex of acetyl-CoA and oxaloacetate

options.zh: 完整的 NADH 分子本身
options.en: The intact NADH molecule itself, unchanged

quiz.explain_zh: 线粒体内膜对 NADH 不通透，胞质 NADH 把电子交给草酰乙酸生成苹果酸，苹果酸过膜后在基质里再还原 NAD⁺，天冬氨酸把氨基骨架送回来，整套只运电子不运辅酶。NADPH 根本不进呼吸链，它的去向是还原性合成和抗氧化；乙酰CoA 出线粒体走的是柠檬酸穿梭，方向和这条也相反。
quiz.explain_en: The inner membrane is impermeable to NADH, so cytosolic NADH passes electrons to oxaloacetate to form malate, malate crosses and re-reduces NAD+ in the matrix, and aspartate returns the carbon-nitrogen skeleton — electrons move, the coenzyme does not. NADPH never enters the respiratory chain at all; it serves reductive synthesis and antioxidant defence. Acetyl-CoA leaves the mitochondrion on the citrate shuttle, in the opposite direction.

quiz.q_zh: 磷酸戊糖途径氧化阶段的产物要经过哪一步才能用于核苷酸合成？
quiz.q_en: What must the oxidative-phase product of the PPP undergo before it can be used for nucleotide synthesis?

options.zh: 被己糖激酶在 6 位磷酸化成二磷酸
options.en: Hexokinase phosphorylating position 6 to a bisphosphate

options.zh: 经异构酶变成 5-磷酸核糖再成 PRPP
options.en: An isomerase giving ribose-5-phosphate, then PRPP

options.zh: 由转酮酶把它重排成三碳与四碳片段
options.en: Transketolase rearranging it into three- and four-carbon pieces

options.zh: 由脱氢酶再氧化一次并脱去一分子 CO₂
options.en: A dehydrogenase oxidising it again and removing one CO2

quiz.explain_zh: 氧化阶段的直接产物是核酮糖-5-磷酸，异构成 5-磷酸核糖后由 PRPP 合成酶加上焦磷酸基，PRPP 才是嘌呤和嘧啶合成的真实起点。转酮酶属于非氧化阶段的碳骨架重排，是把五碳糖变回六碳糖的方向；氧化脱羧已经在生成核酮糖时完成，不会再来一次；己糖激酶作用于游离葡萄糖，与戊糖磷酸无关。
quiz.explain_en: The direct oxidative-phase product is ribulose-5-phosphate; isomerisation gives ribose-5-phosphate, and PRPP synthetase then adds a pyrophosphate group, PRPP being the real starting point for purines and pyrimidines. Transketolase belongs to the non-oxidative rearrangement that runs pentoses back toward hexoses; the oxidative decarboxylation already happened in making ribulose and is not repeated; and hexokinase acts on free glucose, not on pentose phosphates.

title_zh: 复习收尾：「唯一」就是考点，剩余章节安排与难度排序
title_en: Wrapping up the review: "the only one" is an exam point, plus what remains and how hard it gets

points.zh: 乙醛酸循环他认为是比较有意思的一个点，可以稍微看一下。
points.en: He thinks the glyoxylate cycle is an interesting point worth a look.

points.zh: 糖原的合成与分解他判定非常不重要，是一个很路边的小知识点，但还是要稍微看。
points.en: He rates glycogen synthesis and breakdown as very unimportant, a roadside detail, but still worth a glance.

points.zh: 要看的理由只有一个：这里是唯一用到 UTP 的地方。
points.en: The one reason to look: this is the only place UTP is used.

points.zh: 他提炼出一条应试规律：生化里每次说到「唯一」——某个东西只有一个用途的时候——这个东西很容易成为考点。
points.en: He distils an exam heuristic: in biochemistry, whenever something is "the only" — a molecule with a single use — it easily becomes an exam question.

points.zh: UTP 我们都知道它能供能，但学到目前为止唯一的用途就是在糖原合成这里供能。
points.en: We know UTP can supply energy, but so far its only use is supplying energy in glycogen synthesis.

points.zh: 糖的代谢到此完全讲完；他指出越往后代谢反应的重要性越低，讲它们的章节也越来越少。
points.en: Carbohydrate metabolism is now finished; he notes that the further on you go, the less important the reactions and the fewer the chapters.

points.zh: 章节账：糖酵解单独一张、TCA 一张、氧化磷酸化／电子传递链一张、EMP 相关一张，一共四大章才讲完糖类的降解；脂质只有分解一张、合成一张。
points.en: The chapter budget: glycolysis one, the TCA cycle one, oxidative phosphorylation and the respiratory chain one, plus one more — four whole chapters to finish carbohydrate breakdown; lipids get only one chapter for catabolism and one for synthesis.

points.zh: 后面：蛋白质的降解和合成基本算一张（蛋白质合成基本不谈），核酸代谢一到两张，课程已接近尾声。
points.en: After that: protein degradation and synthesis amount to roughly one chapter (protein synthesis is barely covered), nucleic acid metabolism one or two, and the course is near its end.

points.zh: 他给出难度排序：最难是 TCA 循环（酶太多、产物长得都很像，错一步就推不出来），其次是 EMP／葡萄糖代谢（葡萄糖分子结构复杂），再往下是尿素循环（其实还好，产物逻辑清晰），再往下是脂质代谢（知道每一步干嘛就 OK）；今天的脂质代谢是除 TCA 和尿素循环之外最难的内容。
points.en: His difficulty ranking: hardest is the TCA cycle (too many enzymes, products that all look alike, one wrong step and you cannot derive the rest), then EMP and glucose metabolism (glucose itself is structurally complex), then the urea cycle (actually fine, its products follow clear logic), then lipid metabolism (knowing what each step does is enough); today's lipid metabolism is the hardest material apart from the TCA and urea cycles.

extra.zh: 「UTP 唯一的用途就是糖原合成」在本课范围内可以这么记，严格说不成立。UTP 的真正职能是糖基活化，UDP-葡萄糖之外还有 UDP-半乳糖（半乳糖代谢的 Leloir 途径）、UDP-葡萄糖醛酸（肝脏生物转化、胆红素结合）、UDP-GlcNAc（糖基化）。UTP 当然也是 RNA 合成的四种底物之一。他自己在 32:52 前后已补了一句「核酸那一章可能还有一个」，属于已经自我保留。
extra.en: "UTP's only use is glycogen synthesis" works within this course but is not strictly true. UTP's real job is activating sugars: besides UDP-glucose there is UDP-galactose (the Leloir pathway of galactose metabolism), UDP-glucuronate (hepatic biotransformation and bilirubin conjugation) and UDP-GlcNAc (glycosylation). UTP is of course also one of the four substrates of RNA synthesis. He already hedges this around 32:52 by saying the nucleic acid chapter may hold another.

extra.zh: 「UTP 供能」这个说法要小心。UTP 在糖原合成里提供的不是一般意义的能量，而是把葡萄糖做成高能的活化糖基供体 UDP-葡萄糖——真正的能量投资在于 PPi 被焦磷酸酶水解掉。同一套逻辑在别的地方由别的核苷三磷酸承担：脂质合成用 CTP（CDP-胆碱、CDP-二酰甘油），蛋白质合成的肽链延伸用 GTP，这三组「专用核苷酸」放在一起记比单记 UTP 更牢。
extra.en: "UTP supplies energy" needs care. What UTP provides in glycogen synthesis is not energy in the ordinary sense but an activated, high-energy glycosyl donor, UDP-glucose — the real energetic investment is the pyrophosphatase hydrolysis of PPi. The same logic runs elsewhere with different nucleotides: lipid synthesis uses CTP (CDP-choline, CDP-diacylglycerol) and peptide chain elongation uses GTP. Learning these three dedicated-nucleotide pairings together sticks better than memorising UTP alone.

extra.zh: 他的「唯一即考点」规律确实好用，可以顺手列一份本课已出现的清单：糖酵解里唯一的底物水平磷酸化产 ATP 的两步（磷酸甘油酸激酶、丙酮酸激酶）；TCA 里唯一直接产 GTP 的一步（琥珀酰CoA 合成酶）；唯一嵌在线粒体内膜上的 TCA 酶（琥珀酸脱氢酶／复合体 II）；唯一由胆固醇衍生的脂溶性维生素（维生素 D）；唯一需要维生素 B₁₂ 的脂肪酸代谢步骤（甲基丙二酰CoA 变位酶）。
extra.en: His "if it is the only one, it will be asked" rule really is useful, and a list can be drawn from this course already: the only two substrate-level phosphorylation steps in glycolysis (phosphoglycerate kinase and pyruvate kinase); the only TCA step producing GTP directly (succinyl-CoA synthetase); the only TCA enzyme embedded in the inner membrane (succinate dehydrogenase, complex II); the only fat-soluble vitamin derived from cholesterol (vitamin D); and the only fatty-acid step requiring vitamin B12 (methylmalonyl-CoA mutase).

extra.zh: 他把尿素循环排在脂质代谢之上、说「其实还好」，值得先记住它的骨架，因为本课末尾就要开氨基酸代谢的头：氨在肝内经氨甲酰磷酸合成酶 I 进入循环（线粒体基质，耗 2 ATP），与鸟氨酸缩合成瓜氨酸，出线粒体后接天冬氨酸提供第二个氮，经精氨基琥珀酸放出延胡索酸，最后由精氨酸酶水解出尿素并再生鸟氨酸。两个氮一个来自游离氨、一个来自天冬氨酸，这一点是最常考的。
extra.en: He ranks the urea cycle above lipid metabolism and calls it "actually fine", and its skeleton is worth holding in advance since amino acid metabolism opens at the end of this lecture: ammonia enters in the liver through carbamoyl phosphate synthetase I (mitochondrial matrix, 2 ATP), condenses with ornithine to citrulline, leaves the mitochondrion, takes its second nitrogen from aspartate, releases fumarate via argininosuccinate, and finally arginase hydrolyses out urea and regenerates ornithine. That the two nitrogens come one from free ammonia and one from aspartate is the most examined point.

quiz.q_zh: 关于 UTP 在糖原合成中的角色，下面哪种描述最准确？
quiz.q_en: Which description of UTP's role in glycogen synthesis is most accurate?

options.zh: 它像 ATP 一样直接水解为反应提供自由能
options.en: It hydrolyses directly to provide free energy, just as ATP does

options.zh: 它是糖原合酶必需的变构激活剂与辅因子
options.en: It is an allosteric activator required by glycogen synthase

options.zh: 它把葡萄糖做成活化糖基供体 UDP-葡萄糖
options.en: It converts glucose into the activated glycosyl donor UDP-glucose

options.zh: 它为糖原引物蛋白提供起始的葡萄糖单位
options.en: It supplies the starting glucose unit to the glycogen primer

quiz.explain_zh: UTP 的职能是糖基活化：与 G1P 结合生成 UDP-葡萄糖，让葡萄糖带上一个好离去基团，糖原合酶才能把它接到非还原端。它不是像 ATP 那样单纯水解供能；它不作用于糖原合酶的变构位点，糖原合酶的调控靠磷酸化和 G6P；引物蛋白 glycogenin 起始时用的糖基同样来自 UDP-葡萄糖，而不是 UTP 直接提供。
quiz.explain_en: UTP's job is glycosyl activation: it joins G1P to make UDP-glucose, giving the glucose a good leaving group so glycogen synthase can attach it to a non-reducing end. It does not simply hydrolyse for energy as ATP does; it does not act at an allosteric site on glycogen synthase, which is controlled by phosphorylation and G6P; and the primer protein glycogenin also draws its glucose from UDP-glucose rather than from UTP directly.

quiz.q_zh: 下列哪一项符合老师提出的「唯一即考点」规律，且陈述本身是正确的？
quiz.q_en: Which of these fits his "if it is the only one, it gets examined" rule and is itself a correct statement?

options.zh: 柠檬酸合酶是唯一直接生成 GTP 的 TCA 酶
options.en: Citrate synthase is the only TCA enzyme that directly makes GTP

options.zh: 己糖激酶是糖酵解中唯一产生 ATP 的酶
options.en: Hexokinase is the only enzyme in glycolysis that produces ATP

options.zh: 维生素 A 是唯一由胆固醇衍生的脂溶性维生素
options.en: Vitamin A is the only fat-soluble vitamin derived from cholesterol

options.zh: 琥珀酸脱氢酶是唯一嵌在线粒体内膜的 TCA 酶
options.en: Succinate dehydrogenase is the only TCA enzyme in the inner membrane

quiz.explain_zh: 琥珀酸脱氢酶同时是电子传递链的复合体 II，是唯一整合在内膜上的三羧酸循环酶，其余七个酶都溶在基质里。直接产 GTP 的是琥珀酰CoA 合成酶而不是柠檬酸合酶；糖酵解产 ATP 的是磷酸甘油酸激酶和丙酮酸激酶，己糖激酶反而消耗 ATP；由胆固醇（7-脱氢胆固醇）经紫外线衍生而来的是维生素 D，维生素 A 必须从食物摄取。
quiz.explain_en: Succinate dehydrogenase doubles as respiratory complex II and is the only citric acid cycle enzyme integral to the inner membrane; the other seven are soluble in the matrix. GTP is made directly by succinyl-CoA synthetase, not citrate synthase; ATP in glycolysis comes from phosphoglycerate kinase and pyruvate kinase while hexokinase consumes ATP; and the vitamin derived from cholesterol via 7-dehydrocholesterol and UV light is vitamin D, whereas vitamin A must come from the diet.

quiz.q_zh: 按老师的说法，剩余课程里哪一条代谢途径与三羧酸循环并列被点名为最复杂的循环？
quiz.q_en: By his account, which remaining pathway is named alongside the TCA cycle as a genuinely complex cycle?

options.zh: 肝脏中处理氨的尿素循环
options.en: The urea cycle that disposes of ammonia in the liver

options.zh: 磷酸戊糖途径的非氧化重排阶段
options.en: The non-oxidative rearrangement phase of the PPP

options.zh: 脂肪酸 β-氧化的四步循环
options.en: The four-step cycle of fatty acid β-oxidation

options.zh: 胆固醇合成的甲羟戊酸途径
options.en: The mevalonate pathway of cholesterol synthesis

quiz.explain_zh: 他说除了 TCA 循环和尿素循环这两个循环之外就没有更难的要背了，并把尿素循环单独列为「稍微有一点复杂」，随后又说它其实还好、产物逻辑清晰。磷酸戊糖途径他明确排在重要性第四第五；β-氧化他说只要知道每一步干嘛就 OK；甲羟戊酸途径在这一段完全没有被提到。
quiz.explain_en: He says that apart from the TCA cycle and the urea cycle there is nothing harder left to memorise, singling out the urea cycle as "a bit complicated" before adding that it is actually fine because its products follow clear logic. He explicitly ranks the PPP fourth or fifth in importance; he says β-oxidation only requires knowing what each step does; and the mevalonate pathway is not mentioned in this stretch at all.

title_zh: 核酸代谢为何不作重点 · 脂肪的能量密度与小肠消化
title_en: Why nucleic acid catabolism is skipped; energy density of fat and its digestion in the small intestine

points.zh: 核酸分解代谢在本课不作重点：核酸由磷酸、碱基、核糖三部分组成，拆开以后三部分各有各的去处，没有统一的难点。
points.en: Nucleic acid catabolism is not emphasised in this course: a nucleic acid is phosphate + base + ribose, and once it is taken apart each of the three pieces has its own separate fate, so there is no single hard pathway to learn.

points.zh: 碱基有 A、T、C、G 再加一个 U 共五种，每一种碱基的降解都不一样，不是一个通用过程，所以课本也没有多讲。
points.en: There are five bases, A/T/C/G plus U, and each one is degraded differently; it is not a single general process, which is why the textbook spends little space on it.

points.zh: 核糖拆下来自然而然进入磷酸戊糖途径就被用掉了，所以核糖这一支没有难点。
points.en: The ribose released simply feeds into the pentose phosphate pathway and is consumed there, so that branch presents no difficulty.

points.zh: 他给出的难度排序：TCA 循环最难（酶太多、产物长得都很像，错一步就推不下去），其次是 EMP／葡萄糖代谢，再往下是尿素循环，然后才是脂质代谢。
points.en: His difficulty ranking: the TCA cycle is hardest (too many enzymes, intermediates that all look alike, one wrong step and you cannot derive the rest), then EMP/glucose metabolism, then the urea cycle, then lipid metabolism.

points.zh: 脂质代谢的要求相对低：知道每一步是干嘛就可以了，没有很复杂的推导。
points.en: Lipid metabolism is graded easier: knowing what each step does is enough, there is no complicated derivation.

points.zh: 但脂质代谢这一章的重要性比蛋白质代谢、比核酸代谢都要高一些。
points.en: Even so, the lipid chapter matters more than the protein or nucleic acid chapters.

points.zh: 能量密度：1 g 葡萄糖约产生 16 kJ，1 g 脂肪约产生 37 kJ，他口算成大概 2.1 到 2.2 倍。
points.en: Energy density: about 16 kJ per gram of glucose versus about 37 kJ per gram of fat, which he estimated aloud as roughly 2.1 to 2.2 times.

points.zh: 所以脂肪是人体储存能量的主要形式，而葡萄糖主要是现场获取、现场就利用掉。
points.en: Fat is therefore the body's main storage form of energy, whereas glucose is mostly taken up and used on the spot.

points.zh: 脂肪吃进去以后在小肠部分吸收：底物是一个甘油骨架接三坨脂肪酸；在胰脂肪酶作用下先把两边的两个脂肪酸拆下来，剩下 2 位的单酰甘油，他给的理由是中间那个位置位阻比较大。
points.en: Dietary fat is absorbed in the small intestine: the substrate is a glycerol backbone carrying three fatty acids, and pancreatic lipase first removes the two outer fatty acids, leaving 2-monoacylglycerol; the reason he gave was that the middle position is too sterically hindered.

extra.zh: 胰脂肪酶留下中间那个酯键，不是因为位阻，而是因为酶本身的 sn-1,3 位置专一性：活性中心只识别甘油骨架两个端位的酯键。结果他讲对了（产物是 2-单酰甘油 + 2 分子脂肪酸），理由要换掉。
extra.en: Pancreatic lipase spares the middle ester bond not because of steric bulk but because of the enzyme's own sn-1,3 positional specificity: the active site only recognises the two terminal ester bonds of the glycerol backbone. His product is right (2-monoacylglycerol + 2 fatty acids); the reason needs replacing.

extra.zh: 37 ÷ 16 ≈ 2.3 倍，不是 2.1–2.2 倍。属于口算误差，结论（脂肪的能量密度是糖的两倍多）不受影响。另外他说「我们有五种 ATCG」也是口误，ATCG 是四种，加上 U 才是五种，他在同一句里把总数说对了。
extra.en: 37/16 is about 2.3, not 2.1-2.2 — an arithmetic slip that does not change the conclusion that fat carries a bit more than twice the energy per gram. He also said 'five bases, ATCG', a slip: ATCG is four, and only with U does it become five, which he got right in the same sentence.

extra.zh: 脂肪能量密度高的分子原因：脂肪酸碳链几乎全是 —CH₂— ，碳的氧化态最低，可供氧化的电子最多；糖的每个碳都已经带了羟基（部分氧化），而且糖原在体内还结合大量水，实际单位重量差距比 2.3 倍更大。
extra.en: Why fat is so energy dense: a fatty acyl chain is almost all -CH2-, the most reduced carbon there is, so it carries the most oxidisable electrons; every carbon of a sugar already bears a hydroxyl (partly oxidised), and stored glycogen is heavily hydrated, so the real per-wet-weight gap is even larger than 2.3-fold.

extra.zh: 消化的完整链条他跳过了：胆汁酸先把脂滴乳化成微小油滴、扩大表面积；胰脂肪酶必须靠辅脂酶 colipase 才能在被胆汁酸覆盖的油水界面上锚定并发挥活性；产物 2-单酰甘油和脂肪酸再与胆汁酸形成混合微团被运到微绒毛表面吸收。
extra.en: He skipped the full digestive chain: bile salts first emulsify the fat into fine droplets to expand the surface; pancreatic lipase needs colipase to anchor at a bile-salt-coated oil-water interface at all; and the products, 2-monoacylglycerol plus fatty acids, then form mixed micelles with bile salts that ferry them to the microvillar surface for uptake.

quiz.q_zh: 胰脂肪酶作用于膳食甘油三酯后，肠腔中的主要产物是什么？
quiz.q_en: What are the main luminal products after pancreatic lipase acts on a dietary triacylglycerol?

options.zh: 1-单酰甘油加两分子脂肪酸
options.en: 1-monoacylglycerol plus two fatty acids

options.zh: 甘油加三分子游离脂肪酸
options.en: glycerol plus three free fatty acids

options.zh: 2-单酰甘油加两分子脂肪酸
options.en: 2-monoacylglycerol plus two fatty acids

options.zh: 1,2-二酰甘油加一分子脂肪酸
options.en: 1,2-diacylglycerol plus one fatty acid

quiz.explain_zh: 胰脂肪酶有 sn-1,3 位置专一性，只切甘油骨架两个端位的酯键，所以留下 2-单酰甘油加两分子脂肪酸。甘油加三分子脂肪酸是完全水解的结果，需要别的酯酶接力；1,2-二酰甘油只切了一刀，是一过性中间物；1-单酰甘油保留的恰是端位酯键，与该酶的专一性正好相反。
quiz.explain_en: Pancreatic lipase is sn-1,3 specific and cleaves only the two terminal ester bonds, leaving 2-monoacylglycerol plus two fatty acids. Glycerol plus three fatty acids would be complete hydrolysis, which needs other esterases; 1,2-diacylglycerol has had only one bond cut and is transient; 1-monoacylglycerol retains a terminal ester, the opposite of this enzyme's specificity.

quiz.q_zh: 关于葡萄糖与脂肪的能量密度，课上给出的数值是哪一组？
quiz.q_en: Which pair of energy-density values was given in the lecture?

options.zh: 1 g 葡萄糖约 16 kJ，1 g 脂肪约 37 kJ
options.en: about 16 kJ per gram of glucose, about 37 kJ per gram of fat

options.zh: 1 g 葡萄糖约 37 kJ，1 g 脂肪约 16 kJ
options.en: about 37 kJ per gram of glucose, about 16 kJ per gram of fat

options.zh: 葡萄糖与脂肪都约 16 kJ，差别只在储存部位
options.en: both about 16 kJ per gram, differing only in where they are stored

options.zh: 葡萄糖与脂肪都约 37 kJ，差别只在氧化速度
options.en: both about 37 kJ per gram, differing only in how fast they oxidise

quiz.explain_zh: 脂肪的能量密度约为糖的 2.3 倍（37/16），这正是机体用脂肪而不是糖原做长期储备的原因。把两个数字对调就把结论颠倒了；说两者都约 16 kJ 或都约 37 kJ 则抹掉了这个差别，而差别恰恰来自碳的氧化态不同，不是储存部位或氧化速度造成的。
quiz.explain_en: Fat is about 2.3 times as energy dense as sugar (37/16), which is why the body stores long-term reserves as fat rather than glycogen. Swapping the two numbers inverts the conclusion; saying both are about 16 or both about 37 erases the difference, which comes from the oxidation state of the carbons, not from storage site or rate of oxidation.

title_zh: 乳糜微粒：他讲的「脂肪酸小球」与真正的脂蛋白颗粒
title_en: Chylomicrons: the 'ball of fatty acids' he described versus the real lipoprotein particle

points.zh: 脂肪酸被吸收以后会「再次被合成」，形成他称之为乳糜微粒的颗粒。
points.en: After the fatty acids are absorbed they are 'resynthesised' into what he calls chylomicrons.

points.zh: 他把乳糜微粒定义成「实际上就是这些脂肪酸」聚成的小球，因为脂肪酸高度疏水、不容易溶于水。
points.en: He defines a chylomicron as 'really just these fatty acids' aggregated into a ball, because fatty acids are highly hydrophobic and do not dissolve well in water.

points.zh: 他给的结构：像磷脂小球一样，疏水的长链埋到里边去，亲水的羧基朝向外边。
points.en: The structure he gives: like a phospholipid ball, with the hydrophobic long chains buried inside and the hydrophilic carboxyls facing outward.

points.zh: 乳糜微粒的缩写是 CM，在脂质分类那一章已经提到过一点。
points.en: The chylomicron is abbreviated CM and was mentioned briefly back in the lipid classification chapter.

points.zh: 它存在的理由：血液里不能溶解大量脂肪，所以脂肪必须包成这样的小球才能运输。
points.en: Why it exists: blood cannot dissolve large amounts of fat, so fat has to be packaged into such particles to be transported.

points.zh: 他顺带解释 R 基团：R—COOH 里的 R 就是之前画的那种一长条波浪形的烃链，末端是羧基。
points.en: In passing he explains the R group: in R-COOH the R is the long wavy hydrocarbon chain drawn earlier, terminating in the carboxyl.

points.zh: 他把这一步定位成「脂肪酸刚分解出来、被吸收了以后」发生的事。
points.en: He places this step right after the fatty acids have been released by digestion and taken up.

points.zh: 学生问要不要看发的两张英文图，他说待会儿再看，先讲甘油的去向。
points.en: A student asks whether to open the two English figures; he says later, and moves on to the fate of glycerol.

extra.zh: 乳糜微粒不是脂肪酸的胶束，而是一个脂蛋白颗粒。小肠黏膜细胞把吸收进来的 2-单酰甘油和脂肪酸在滑面内质网里重新酯化成甘油三酯，再与磷脂、胆固醇和载脂蛋白（ApoB-48）组装成颗粒：核心是甘油三酯和胆固醇酯，表面是磷脂单分子层的极性头基加载脂蛋白，不是脂肪酸的羧基。
extra.en: A chylomicron is not a micelle of fatty acids, it is a lipoprotein particle. The intestinal mucosal cell re-esterifies the absorbed 2-monoacylglycerol and fatty acids into triacylglycerol in the smooth ER, then assembles them with phospholipid, cholesterol and apolipoprotein (ApoB-48): the core is triacylglycerol and cholesteryl ester, the surface is the polar head groups of a phospholipid monolayer plus apolipoproteins, not fatty acid carboxyls.

extra.zh: 「羧基朝外、疏水链朝内」准确描述的是肠腔里由胆汁酸和消化产物形成的混合微团 mixed micelle —— 那是消化阶段的运输工具，几个纳米大，把脂质送到微绒毛表面就解体了。乳糜微粒是吸收之后由细胞分泌出去的颗粒，直径在几百纳米量级。两个层次被他压到同一句话里了。
extra.en: 'Carboxyls out, hydrophobic tails in' correctly describes the bile-salt mixed micelle in the gut lumen — a few nanometres across, a digestion-stage carrier that falls apart once it has delivered lipid to the microvillar surface. The chylomicron is a particle secreted by the cell after absorption, hundreds of nanometres across. He compressed the two levels into one sentence.

extra.zh: ApoB-48 是乳糜微粒的结构蛋白，装配时就在上面、终生不离开颗粒（肝脏的 VLDL 用的是同一个基因编辑出的全长 ApoB-100）。进入血液后颗粒再从 HDL 获得 ApoC-II（激活毛细血管内皮上的脂蛋白脂肪酶 LPL，把核心甘油三酯卸给组织）和 ApoE（介导残粒被肝脏受体摄取）。
extra.en: ApoB-48 is the chylomicron's structural protein, present from assembly and never leaving the particle (the liver's VLDL uses full-length ApoB-100 from the same gene). Once in blood the particle acquires ApoC-II from HDL, which activates lipoprotein lipase on capillary endothelium to unload the core triacylglycerol, and ApoE, which lets the liver take up the remnant.

extra.zh: 乳糜微粒颗粒太大，不能穿过肠毛细血管的连续内皮，所以走淋巴：中央乳糜管 → 胸导管 → 左锁骨下静脉入血。这正是「乳糜」这个名字的来历，也是高脂餐后血浆变乳白色的原因；相比之下短链和中链脂肪酸直接从门静脉走，不进乳糜微粒。
extra.en: Chylomicrons are too large to cross the continuous endothelium of intestinal capillaries, so they take the lymphatic route: central lacteal, thoracic duct, left subclavian vein. That is where the name 'chyle' comes from and why plasma turns milky after a fatty meal; short- and medium-chain fatty acids by contrast go straight into the portal vein and never enter a chylomicron.

quiz.q_zh: 乳糜微粒颗粒表面直接面向血浆水相的是什么？
quiz.q_en: What faces the aqueous plasma on the surface of a chylomicron?

options.zh: 游离脂肪酸的羧基与甘油骨架
options.en: the carboxyls of free fatty acids and the glycerol backbone

options.zh: 磷脂的极性头基与载脂蛋白
options.en: the polar head groups of phospholipid plus apolipoproteins

options.zh: 甘油三酯与胆固醇酯的酯键
options.en: the ester bonds of triacylglycerol and cholesteryl ester

options.zh: 胆汁酸的羟基面与牛磺酸尾端
options.en: the hydroxyl face and taurine tail of bile salts

quiz.explain_zh: 乳糜微粒是脂蛋白颗粒：核心装甘油三酯和胆固醇酯，外面裹一层磷脂单分子层，极性头基朝水相，表面还嵌着 ApoB-48 等载脂蛋白。游离脂肪酸的羧基朝外描述的是肠腔里的胆汁酸混合微团；胆汁酸留在肠腔并在回肠被重吸收，不出现在颗粒表面；甘油三酯和胆固醇酯是被包在核心里的，根本不接触水。
quiz.explain_en: A chylomicron is a lipoprotein particle: triacylglycerol and cholesteryl ester in the core, a phospholipid monolayer outside with its polar heads to the water, and apolipoproteins such as ApoB-48 embedded in that surface. Carboxyls facing out describes the bile-salt mixed micelle in the gut lumen; bile salts stay in the lumen and are reabsorbed in the ileum, never appearing on the particle; triacylglycerol and cholesteryl ester are buried in the core and never touch water.

quiz.q_zh: 「疏水链朝内、羧基朝外的小球」这一描述，准确对应的是哪一种结构？
quiz.q_en: Which structure does 'a ball with hydrophobic tails in and carboxyls out' accurately describe?

options.zh: 血浆中与白蛋白结合的脂肪酸
options.en: fatty acids carried bound to plasma albumin

options.zh: 肝脏分泌的极低密度脂蛋白
options.en: very-low-density lipoprotein secreted by the liver

options.zh: 小肠细胞分泌的乳糜微粒
options.en: the chylomicron secreted by intestinal cells

options.zh: 肠腔中由胆汁酸形成的混合微团
options.en: the bile-salt mixed micelle formed in the gut lumen

quiz.explain_zh: 混合微团是胆汁酸、脂肪酸和单酰甘油在肠腔里自发形成的几纳米小球，极性面朝水、烃链朝内，负责把消化产物送到微绒毛表面。乳糜微粒和极低密度脂蛋白都是细胞装配并分泌的脂蛋白颗粒，表面是磷脂头基加载脂蛋白；血浆游离脂肪酸不成球，而是一个个结合在白蛋白的疏水口袋里。
quiz.explain_en: The mixed micelle is a few-nanometre aggregate that bile salts, fatty acids and monoacylglycerol form spontaneously in the lumen, polar faces to water and chains inward, ferrying digestion products to the microvilli. Chylomicrons and VLDL are both cell-assembled secreted lipoproteins whose surface is phospholipid head groups plus apolipoprotein; plasma free fatty acids do not form a ball at all but ride one by one in albumin's hydrophobic pockets.

quiz.q_zh: 乳糜微粒装配时就带上、并终生留在颗粒上的结构性载脂蛋白是哪一个？
quiz.q_en: Which structural apolipoprotein is present from assembly and stays on the chylomicron for its lifetime?

options.zh: ApoB-48，在小肠上皮细胞内合成
options.en: ApoB-48, made inside small-intestinal epithelium

options.zh: ApoB-100，在肝实质细胞内合成
options.en: ApoB-100, made inside hepatic parenchymal cells

options.zh: ApoE，在白色脂肪细胞内合成
options.en: ApoE, made inside white adipocytes

options.zh: ApoA-I，在胆囊上皮细胞内合成
options.en: ApoA-I, made inside gallbladder epithelium

quiz.explain_zh: ApoB-48 由小肠上皮细胞合成，是乳糜微粒的骨架蛋白，装配时就在颗粒上且不会转移出去。ApoB-100 是同一基因未经 mRNA 编辑的全长产物，由肝细胞用于 VLDL；ApoE 主要由肝和巨噬细胞产生，是后来从 HDL 转来的可交换载脂蛋白，负责残粒清除；ApoA-I 是 HDL 的主要蛋白，由肝和小肠合成，不是胆囊产物。
quiz.explain_en: ApoB-48 is made by intestinal epithelium and forms the chylomicron's scaffold, present from assembly and never transferred away. ApoB-100 is the unedited full-length product of the same gene used by hepatocytes for VLDL; ApoE comes mainly from liver and macrophages and is an exchangeable apolipoprotein acquired later from HDL for remnant clearance; ApoA-I is HDL's main protein, made by liver and intestine, not by the gallbladder.

title_zh: 甘油的去向：甘油激酶 → 磷酸甘油 → 磷酸二羟丙酮
title_en: The fate of glycerol: glycerol kinase, glycerol phosphate, dihydroxyacetone phosphate

points.zh: 甘油的结构长得很像 EMP 途径后半段那几个变来变去的三碳中间物，所以它的去向很清晰。
points.en: Glycerol's structure closely resembles the three-carbon intermediates in the second half of the EMP pathway, so its fate is easy to follow.

points.zh: 第一步是甘油激酶，消耗一分子 ATP，给甘油上一个磷酸。
points.en: Step one is glycerol kinase, which spends one ATP to put a phosphate on glycerol.

points.zh: 他把产物叫做「一位的磷酸甘油或者是 α 位磷酸甘油，都无所谓」。
points.en: He calls the product '1-glycerol phosphate, or alpha-glycerol phosphate, it doesn't matter which'.

points.zh: 第二步是磷酸甘油脱氢酶：把中间那个位置的羟基脱氢，就变成了磷酸二羟丙酮。
points.en: Step two is glycerol phosphate dehydrogenase: dehydrogenating the hydroxyl at the middle position gives dihydroxyacetone phosphate.

points.zh: 磷酸二羟丙酮直接参与到 EMP 途径里去，不需要前面那些步骤。
points.en: Dihydroxyacetone phosphate joins the EMP pathway directly, without needing any of the earlier steps.

points.zh: 他现场查英文名并读出来：dihydroxyacetone phosphate，acetone 是丙酮、dihydroxy 是二羟，合起来就是磷酸二羟丙酮。
points.en: He looks up the English name on the spot: dihydroxyacetone phosphate — acetone is the ketone, dihydroxy the two hydroxyls, hence 'phosphodihydroxyacetone' in Chinese.

points.zh: 他说这个化合物好像有一个缩写，但一时想不起来，让学生课后自己查一下。
points.en: He says the compound has an abbreviation but he cannot recall it, and tells the student to look it up afterwards.

points.zh: 讲完甘油就进入他所说的「真正的重点」：脂肪酸的分解代谢。
points.en: With glycerol done he moves to what he calls the real core of the chapter: fatty acid catabolism.

points.zh: 约定画法：脂肪酸的长链一律用 R 代替，只把靠近羧基的两个亚甲基 CH₂ 画出来。
points.en: Drawing convention agreed: the long chain of the fatty acid is always abbreviated R, and only the two methylenes nearest the carboxyl are drawn out.

extra.zh: 甘油激酶的产物按惯例写作 3-磷酸甘油（sn-glycerol-3-phosphate，即 L-α-磷酸甘油）。因为甘油两端的碳是前手性的，口语上说「α 位」不算错，但编号要统一到 3 位 —— 考试里写「1-磷酸甘油」会被判错。
extra.en: By convention the product of glycerol kinase is written glycerol 3-phosphate (sn-glycerol-3-phosphate, i.e. L-alpha-glycerophosphate). Because glycerol's two end carbons are prochiral, saying 'the alpha position' out loud is not wrong, but the numbering must be standardised to 3 — writing 'glycerol 1-phosphate' in an exam is marked wrong.

extra.zh: 他想不起来的缩写是 DHAP（dihydroxyacetone phosphate）。另外这一步的胞质甘油磷酸脱氢酶用的是 NAD⁺，产 NADH；线粒体内膜上还有一个同名的黄素酶用 FAD —— 两个酶配成一对，就是糖酵解里那条 3-磷酸甘油穿梭。
extra.en: The abbreviation he could not recall is DHAP (dihydroxyacetone phosphate). The cytosolic glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase in this step uses NAD+ and makes NADH; a same-named flavoenzyme on the inner mitochondrial membrane uses FAD — the two together are exactly the glycerol-3-phosphate shuttle of glycolysis.

extra.zh: 甘油激酶主要表达在肝、肾、肠和乳腺，脂肪细胞里几乎没有。所以脂解放出的甘油必须随血流回肝才能被利用，而脂肪细胞要再酯化脂肪酸时只能用糖酵解来的 DHAP 现做 3-磷酸甘油 —— 这就是「脂肪细胞的再酯化依赖葡萄糖供应」的分子原因。
extra.en: Glycerol kinase is expressed mainly in liver, kidney, intestine and mammary gland, and is essentially absent from adipocytes. Glycerol released by lipolysis must therefore travel back to the liver to be used, while an adipocyte wanting to re-esterify fatty acids has to make glycerol 3-phosphate fresh from glycolytic DHAP — the molecular reason re-esterification in fat depends on a glucose supply.

extra.zh: 一分子甘油三酯水解出 1 个甘油和 3 个脂肪酸；甘油是三碳，走糖异生只够合成半分子葡萄糖。禁食时甘油是仅次于乳酸和生糖氨基酸的糖异生底物，而脂肪酸本身在人体内不能净合成葡萄糖（偶数碳脂肪酸的乙酰CoA 进 TCA 只是烧掉，不留碳骨架）。
extra.en: One triacylglycerol yields one glycerol and three fatty acids; glycerol has three carbons and supports only half a glucose through gluconeogenesis. In fasting it is a gluconeogenic substrate ranking behind lactate and glucogenic amino acids, whereas the fatty acids themselves cannot yield net glucose in humans — acetyl-CoA from an even-chain fatty acid is burned in the TCA cycle without leaving a carbon skeleton behind.

quiz.q_zh: 甘油经两步反应后，以哪个化合物的形式汇入糖代谢主干？
quiz.q_en: After two reactions, as which compound does glycerol join the mainstream of carbohydrate metabolism?

options.zh: 3-磷酸甘油酸，直接接到 EMP 途径末段
options.en: 3-phosphoglycerate, joining the late part of EMP directly

options.zh: 6-磷酸果糖，直接接到 EMP 途径前段
options.en: fructose 6-phosphate, joining the early part of EMP directly

options.zh: 3-磷酸甘油醛，需再经异构酶转化一步
options.en: glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate, needing one more isomerase step

options.zh: 磷酸二羟丙酮，直接接到 EMP 途径中段
options.en: dihydroxyacetone phosphate, joining the middle of EMP directly

quiz.explain_zh: 甘油激酶先给甘油上磷酸得到 3-磷酸甘油，再由甘油磷酸脱氢酶把 C2 上的羟基氧化成酮基，产物正是磷酸二羟丙酮 DHAP，也就是醛缩酶那一步的产物之一，所以能直接汇入。3-磷酸甘油醛确实是 DHAP 的异构体，但它不是这两步的直接产物；3-磷酸甘油酸比甘油多一个羧基，来自 1,3-二磷酸甘油酸；6-磷酸果糖是六碳糖，三碳的甘油不可能一步生成。
quiz.explain_en: Glycerol kinase phosphorylates glycerol to glycerol 3-phosphate, then glycerol phosphate dehydrogenase oxidises the C2 hydroxyl to a ketone, giving dihydroxyacetone phosphate — one of the two aldolase products, so it plugs straight in. Glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate is indeed DHAP's isomer but is not the direct product of these two steps; 3-phosphoglycerate carries an extra carboxyl and comes from 1,3-bisphosphoglycerate; fructose 6-phosphate has six carbons, which three-carbon glycerol cannot reach in one step.

quiz.q_zh: 甘油激酶的产物，按教科书标准编号应该写成什么？
quiz.q_en: Using standard textbook numbering, how should the product of glycerol kinase be written?

options.zh: 3-磷酸甘油，即 L-α-磷酸甘油
options.en: glycerol 3-phosphate, i.e. L-alpha-glycerophosphate

options.zh: 1,3-二磷酸甘油，两个端位各一个
options.en: glycerol 1,3-bisphosphate, one on each end

options.zh: 1-磷酸甘油，习惯上按 sn-1 位编号
options.en: glycerol 1-phosphate, conventionally numbered at sn-1

options.zh: 2-磷酸甘油，磷酸接在中间那个碳上
options.en: glycerol 2-phosphate, phosphate on the middle carbon

quiz.explain_zh: 标准写法是 sn-glycerol-3-phosphate，也就是 L-α-磷酸甘油；老师说的「α 位」在口语上不算错，但写成 1-磷酸甘油在考试里会被扣分。磷酸接在中间碳上的 2-磷酸甘油是另一个化合物，不是甘油激酶的产物；两端各一个磷酸的二磷酸形式在这条通路上根本不出现，甘油激酶只磷酸化一次。
quiz.explain_en: The standard form is sn-glycerol-3-phosphate, that is L-alpha-glycerophosphate; his spoken 'alpha position' is acceptable, but writing glycerol 1-phosphate loses marks. Glycerol 2-phosphate, with the phosphate on the middle carbon, is a different compound and not this enzyme's product; a bisphosphate with one on each end never appears in this pathway, since glycerol kinase phosphorylates only once.

title_zh: 脂肪酸的活化：脂酰CoA 合成酶、焦磷酸与高能硫酯键
title_en: Activating the fatty acid: acyl-CoA synthetase, pyrophosphate and the high-energy thioester bond

points.zh: 细胞摄取游离脂肪酸以后，第一件事是用辅酶 A 把它活化。
points.en: Once a cell has taken up a free fatty acid, the first thing it does is activate it with coenzyme A.

points.zh: 他说发生分解代谢的部位主要是人体的器官（大量储存脂肪的地方）以及肠道细胞。
points.en: He says the catabolism happens mainly in the body's organs, which store large amounts of fat, and in intestinal cells.

points.zh: 催化的酶是脂酰CoA 合成酶，位置很特殊：在线粒体的外膜上，不是在内膜里面。
points.en: The catalysing enzyme is acyl-CoA synthetase, and its location is unusual: on the outer mitochondrial membrane, not inside the inner membrane.

points.zh: 线粒体外膜由很少几种蛋白质构成，脂酰CoA 合成酶就是外膜上主要的蛋白之一。
points.en: The outer mitochondrial membrane contains only a few kinds of protein, and acyl-CoA synthetase is one of the main ones.

points.zh: 只要涉及「活化」就会产生一分子焦磷酸：等于把 ATP 的 β 位和 γ 位磷酸全都消耗掉，用掉两分子高能磷酸键。
points.en: Any reaction called 'activation' releases a pyrophosphate: it consumes both the beta and gamma phosphates of ATP, spending two high-energy phosphate bonds.

points.zh: 反应式：一分子脂肪酸 + 一分子 CoA，在脂酰CoA 合成酶催化下生成一分子脂酰CoA。
points.en: The reaction: one fatty acid plus one CoA, catalysed by acyl-CoA synthetase, gives one fatty acyl-CoA.

points.zh: 键的位置在脂肪酸的羧基处，形成的是一个高能的硫酯键（硫-CoA）。
points.en: The bond forms at the fatty acid's carboxyl, giving a high-energy thioester bond to the sulfur of CoA.

points.zh: 脂酰CoA 是整个脂肪酸代谢的起始分子，他说它的地位跟糖代谢里的 G6P 有点像。
points.en: Fatty acyl-CoA is the starting molecule of all fatty acid metabolism; he compares its role to that of G6P in carbohydrate metabolism.

points.zh: 他先说「就是把 CoA 活化」，紧接着自己改口成活化的是脂肪酸；并强调这一整步是在细胞质里、酶挂在线粒体外膜上进行的。
points.en: He first says 'this activates the CoA', then immediately corrects himself to say it is the fatty acid that is activated; and he stresses that the whole step happens in the cytosol, with the enzyme sitting on the outer mitochondrial membrane.

extra.zh: 活化的能量账要写清楚：ATP → AMP + PPi，随后无机焦磷酸酶把 PPi 水解成 2 Pi。这个水解本身强烈放能，把整个活化反应从近乎可逆拉成不可逆 —— 不可逆性就是靠它买来的。净耗两个高能磷酸键，所以脂肪酸氧化做能量结算时这一步按 −2 ATP 记。
extra.en: Write the energy ledger properly: ATP goes to AMP + PPi, and inorganic pyrophosphatase then hydrolyses PPi to 2 Pi. That hydrolysis is strongly exergonic and is what drags an otherwise near-reversible activation to completion — irreversibility is bought with it. The net cost is two high-energy phosphate bonds, so this step is booked as -2 ATP when tallying fatty acid oxidation.

extra.zh: 为什么非要做成硫酯：硫酯键水解的 ΔG°′ 约 −31 kJ/mol，和 ATP 末端磷酸酐相当，而普通氧酯只有约 −20 kJ/mol。原因是硫的 3p 轨道与羰基 π 体系重叠差，共振稳定弱。正因为脂酰CoA 自带这份能量，后面的硫解、以及合成方向的缩合才不需要再花 ATP。
extra.en: Why a thioester specifically: its hydrolysis has a standard free energy near -31 kJ/mol, comparable to ATP's terminal anhydride, whereas an ordinary oxygen ester gives only about -20. Sulfur's 3p orbitals overlap poorly with the carbonyl pi system, so resonance stabilisation is weak. Because acyl-CoA carries that energy internally, the later thiolysis, and the condensation in the synthetic direction, need no further ATP.

extra.zh: 他脱口而出的「把 CoA 活化」在下一句被他自己纠正为脂肪酸被活化，以自纠版本为准：是脂肪酸的羧基与 CoA 的巯基 —SH 成键，被提高了转移势能的是酰基。CoA 在这里是载体，不是被活化的对象。
extra.en: His offhand 'this activates the CoA' is corrected by himself in the very next sentence to say the fatty acid is activated; take the corrected version. The fatty acid's carboxyl bonds to CoA's thiol -SH, and what gains transfer potential is the acyl group. CoA is the carrier here, not the thing activated.

extra.zh: 酶名是 acyl-CoA synthetase（长链型 ACSL）。按链长有不同的活化系统：短链和中链脂肪酸（约 C12 以下）在线粒体基质里有自己的活化酶，可以不经肉碱穿梭直接进基质氧化 —— 这正是临床上用中链甘油三酯 MCT 快速供能、以及 MCT 不依赖 CPT-1 调控的原因。
extra.en: The enzyme is acyl-CoA synthetase (long-chain form, ACSL). Different chain lengths use different activation systems: short- and medium-chain fatty acids (up to about C12) have their own activating enzymes inside the matrix and can be oxidised without the carnitine shuttle — which is exactly why medium-chain triglycerides are used clinically for rapid energy and why they escape CPT-1 regulation.

quiz.q_zh: 脂肪酸活化成脂酰CoA 这一步的能量代价是多少？
quiz.q_en: What is the energy cost of activating a fatty acid to its acyl-CoA?

options.zh: 净耗三个高能磷酸键，两分子 ATP 一起被水解
options.en: three high-energy phosphate bonds, with two ATP hydrolysed at once

options.zh: 不耗高能磷酸键，全靠硫酯键自身放能推动反应
options.en: no high-energy phosphate bond, driven by the thioester on its own

options.zh: 净耗两个高能磷酸键，ATP 断成 AMP 与焦磷酸
options.en: two high-energy phosphate bonds, ATP splitting to AMP and pyrophosphate

options.zh: 净耗一个高能磷酸键，ATP 断成 ADP 与磷酸
options.en: one high-energy phosphate bond, ATP splitting to ADP and phosphate

quiz.explain_zh: 脂酰CoA 合成酶把 ATP 断在 α 与 β 磷酸之间，生成 AMP 和焦磷酸，β、γ 两个高能键一起被消耗，所以按 2 个 ATP 记账。断成 ADP 加磷酸是激酶类反应的写法，不是这一步；说水解两分子 ATP 得三个高能键把化学计量算多了；说完全不耗能则否定了这一步是活化反应 —— 硫酯键的能量正是用 ATP 换来的。
quiz.explain_en: Acyl-CoA synthetase cleaves ATP between the alpha and beta phosphates, giving AMP and pyrophosphate, so both the beta and gamma bonds are spent and the step is booked as 2 ATP. Splitting to ADP plus phosphate is what kinases do, not this enzyme; hydrolysing two ATP for three bonds overcounts the stoichiometry; and claiming no cost denies that this is an activation — the thioester's energy is precisely what was bought with ATP.

quiz.q_zh: 脂酰CoA 合成酶位于细胞的什么位置？
quiz.q_en: Where in the cell is acyl-CoA synthetase located?

options.zh: 线粒体内膜，与呼吸链复合体在一起
options.en: the inner mitochondrial membrane, alongside respiratory complexes

options.zh: 线粒体外膜，是外膜的主要蛋白之一
options.en: the outer mitochondrial membrane, a main protein of that membrane

options.zh: 过氧化物酶体膜，面向胞质的那一侧
options.en: the peroxisomal membrane, on the side facing the cytosol

options.zh: 线粒体基质，与 TCA 循环的酶在一起
options.en: the mitochondrial matrix, alongside the TCA cycle enzymes

quiz.explain_zh: 这一点老师讲对了：脂酰CoA 合成酶在线粒体外膜上，活性面朝细胞质，所以活化反应发生在胞质侧，产物脂酰CoA 还在膜外，接下来才需要肉碱穿梭。放在基质里就不需要穿梭系统了，与事实矛盾；内膜上跑的是呼吸链和转位酶；过氧化物酶体确实有自己的一套脂肪酸氧化系统，但那是处理极长链脂肪酸的旁路，不是这里讲的主干。
quiz.explain_en: He got this right: acyl-CoA synthetase sits on the outer mitochondrial membrane with its active face to the cytosol, so activation happens on the cytosolic side and the acyl-CoA is still outside, which is why the carnitine shuttle is needed next. Putting it in the matrix would make the shuttle unnecessary and contradicts the facts; the inner membrane carries the respiratory chain and translocases; peroxisomes do run their own fatty acid oxidation, but that is the very-long-chain side route, not the main path discussed here.

quiz.q_zh: 活化反应放出的焦磷酸 PPi 在细胞里的下场是什么，有什么后果？
quiz.q_en: What happens to the pyrophosphate released by the activation, and why does it matter?

options.zh: 焦磷酸作为别构激活剂，直接激活脂酰CoA 合成酶
options.en: it acts as an allosteric activator, directly switching on acyl-CoA synthetase

options.zh: 焦磷酸进入线粒体基质，在那里被氧化磷酸化利用
options.en: it enters the mitochondrial matrix and is used by oxidative phosphorylation

options.zh: 焦磷酸重新与 AMP 结合成 ATP，把能量收回来
options.en: it recombines with AMP to remake ATP, recovering all the energy spent

options.zh: 焦磷酸被焦磷酸酶水解成两个磷酸，使反应不可逆
options.en: pyrophosphatase hydrolyses it to two phosphates, making the step irreversible

quiz.explain_zh: 无机焦磷酸酶把 PPi 水解成 2 Pi，这一步强烈放能，把产物端不断抽走，从而把本来接近可逆的活化反应拉成不可逆 —— 生化里凡是「ATP 断成 AMP + PPi」的活化步骤（氨基酸活化、糖基活化、脂肪酸活化）都用这一招。焦磷酸不会自发重新装回 ATP；它不是这个酶的别构激活剂；也没有任何途径把 PPi 送进基质去参与氧化磷酸化。
quiz.explain_en: Inorganic pyrophosphatase hydrolyses PPi to 2 Pi, a strongly exergonic step that keeps draining the product side and so pulls an otherwise near-reversible activation to completion — every biochemical activation that splits ATP to AMP plus PPi (amino acid, sugar, fatty acid) uses this trick. Pyrophosphate does not spontaneously reassemble into ATP; it is not an allosteric activator of this enzyme; and no route carries PPi into the matrix for oxidative phosphorylation.

title_zh: 肉碱穿梭：脂酰基怎么进线粒体，以及左旋肉碱减肥
title_en: The carnitine shuttle: getting the acyl group into the mitochondrion, and L-carnitine as a diet product

points.zh: 他提出问题：细胞质里的脂酰CoA 怎么进到线粒体里去？并说脂肪酸的分解过程是在线粒体内膜里边进行的。
points.en: He poses the question of how cytosolic acyl-CoA gets into the mitochondrion, and states that fatty acid breakdown takes place inside the inner mitochondrial membrane.

points.zh: 他强调这一点「比较违背常理」：必须进入到线粒体内膜的内侧才会发挥作用，原因后面讲。
points.en: He stresses this is counter-intuitive: the acyl group must reach the inner face of the inner membrane before anything happens, with the reason to come later.

points.zh: 关键的小分子是肉碱 carnitine，长得跟 CoA 有点像，是一个赖氨酸的衍生物。
points.en: The key small molecule is carnitine, which looks a bit like CoA and is a derivative of lysine.

points.zh: 肉碱会和脂酰CoA 结合，变成脂酰肉碱。
points.en: Carnitine combines with acyl-CoA to give acyl-carnitine.

points.zh: 他说在「脂酰肉碱转移酶」的作用下，这两个东西一起进入到线粒体内膜的内侧，然后在内侧它俩又分开。
points.en: He says that under 'acyl-carnitine transferase' the two of them go in together to the inner side of the inner membrane, and then separate once inside.

points.zh: 整个过程的净效果，就是把脂酰CoA 从细胞质转移到了线粒体内膜内侧。
points.en: The net effect, he says, is to move the acyl-CoA from the cytosol to the inner side of the inner membrane.

points.zh: 商家卖的左旋肉碱咖啡之类的减肥产品，原理就在这里：肉碱能帮着把脂酰CoA 送进线粒体。
points.en: This is the basis of the L-carnitine coffee and similar slimming products once sold: carnitine helps deliver acyl-CoA into the mitochondrion.

points.zh: 但他指出多补肉碱其实没什么用：转运最终由脂酰肉碱转移酶催化，而这个酶肯定受机体能量状态调节，ATP 比较多的时候转运本来就少。
points.en: But he points out that supplementing carnitine does little: transport is ultimately catalysed by the transferase, and that enzyme is certainly regulated by the body's energy state — when ATP is plentiful it transports less anyway.

points.zh: 而且肉碱是小分子，吃进去可能在小肠里就被分解了；它本来就是人体自己从赖氨酸衍生出来的，所以这类产品近几年少见了。
points.en: Besides, carnitine is a small molecule that may simply be broken down in the gut, and the body already derives it from lysine — which is why such products have faded from view.

extra.zh: 「两个一起进去、进去以后再分开」是错的：进膜的只有脂酰肉碱，CoA 从头到尾不过膜。三步分工是 —— CPT-1（肉碱棕榈酰转移酶 I，外膜、面向胞质）把脂酰基从 CoA 转到肉碱上并释放游离 CoA-SH；CACT（肉碱-脂酰肉碱转位酶，内膜）以肉碱换脂酰肉碱的反向交换把它送进基质；CPT-2（内膜基质侧）再用基质里另一池 CoA-SH 重新生成脂酰CoA。分开发生在进去之前，而且胞质侧和基质侧是两个不同的酶、两池不同的 CoA。
extra.en: 'They go in together and separate inside' is wrong: only acyl-carnitine crosses, and CoA never crosses at all. The division of labour is three steps — CPT-1 (carnitine palmitoyltransferase I, outer membrane, facing the cytosol) transfers the acyl group from CoA onto carnitine and releases free CoA-SH; CACT (carnitine/acyl-carnitine translocase, inner membrane) exchanges acyl-carnitine inward against carnitine outward; CPT-2 (matrix face of the inner membrane) regenerates acyl-CoA using a second, matrix pool of CoA-SH. The separation happens before entry, and the two faces use different enzymes and different CoA pools.

extra.zh: β-氧化的部位应写「线粒体基质 matrix」，不是「线粒体内膜里边／内膜内侧」。四个酶里只有第一步的脂酰CoA 脱氢酶与内膜结合（电子经 ETF 和 ETF-泛醌氧化还原酶交给辅酶 Q），后三步都是基质中的可溶性酶。他「内膜内侧」的说法已经接近基质，可算半自纠，但笔记上必须写基质。
extra.en: Beta-oxidation should be located in the mitochondrial matrix, not 'inside the inner membrane'. Of the four enzymes only the first, acyl-CoA dehydrogenase, is membrane-associated (its electrons pass via ETF and ETF-ubiquinone oxidoreductase to coenzyme Q); the other three are soluble matrix enzymes. His 'inner side of the inner membrane' is close to the matrix and counts as a half-correction, but notes must say matrix.

extra.zh: CPT-1 的调控不是「看 ATP 多少」，方向对但机制错。它的生理性别构抑制剂是丙二酰CoA（malonyl-CoA），也就是脂肪酸合成路上最早出现的那个中间物：进食、胰岛素高 → 乙酰CoA 羧化酶活跃 → 丙二酰CoA 升高 → CPT-1 被抑制 → 脂肪酸进不了线粒体。合成与氧化因此不会同时空转，这也是本课后半段脂肪酸合成部分的关键接口。
extra.en: CPT-1 is not regulated by 'how much ATP there is' — right direction, wrong mechanism. Its physiological allosteric inhibitor is malonyl-CoA, the first intermediate of fatty acid synthesis: feeding and high insulin activate acetyl-CoA carboxylase, malonyl-CoA rises, CPT-1 is inhibited and fatty acids cannot enter the mitochondrion. That is what stops synthesis and oxidation from running as a futile cycle, and it is the hinge to the synthesis half of this lecture.

extra.zh: 临床对应：CPT-2 缺陷是最常见的遗传性脂肪酸氧化障碍之一，典型表现是长时间运动或禁食后横纹肌溶解、肌红蛋白尿。真正会造成继发性肉碱缺乏的是长期血液透析、某些抗癫痫药和早产儿，那种情况下补充肉碱才有意义 —— 健康人补充没有可靠的减脂证据。
extra.en: Clinical counterpart: CPT-2 deficiency is among the commonest inherited fatty acid oxidation disorders, typically presenting as rhabdomyolysis and myoglobinuria after prolonged exercise or fasting. Genuine secondary carnitine deficiency occurs in long-term haemodialysis, with certain antiepileptics, and in preterm infants, and only there does supplementation make sense — in healthy people there is no reliable fat-loss evidence.

quiz.q_zh: 长链脂酰基通过肉碱穿梭进入线粒体时，真正跨过内膜的是什么？
quiz.q_en: In the carnitine shuttle, what actually crosses the inner membrane?

options.zh: 游离脂肪酸直接扩散过内膜，在基质里再接上 CoA
options.en: the free fatty acid diffuses across and picks up CoA in the matrix

options.zh: 肉碱把整个脂酰CoA 装进转位酶，随后一同释放
options.en: carnitine loads the whole acyl-CoA into the translocase and both are released

options.zh: 脂酰肉碱单独过膜，CoA 在膜外就被 CPT-1 释放
options.en: acyl-carnitine crosses alone, CoA having been released outside by CPT-1

options.zh: 脂酰CoA 与肉碱结合后一起过膜，进基质再分开
options.en: acyl-CoA joined to carnitine crosses together and splits in the matrix

quiz.explain_zh: CPT-1 在外膜、面向胞质，把脂酰基从 CoA 转到肉碱上并放出游离 CoA-SH；CACT 以肉碱/脂酰肉碱反向交换把脂酰肉碱送进基质；CPT-2 在内膜基质侧用基质里另一池 CoA-SH 重新生成脂酰CoA。老师说的「两个一起进去再分开」把分离的时机放晚了。长链游离脂肪酸不能靠扩散完成定向转运；把脂酰CoA 整个装进转位酶同样错在 CoA 不过膜。
quiz.explain_en: CPT-1 on the outer membrane, facing the cytosol, moves the acyl group from CoA onto carnitine and frees CoA-SH; CACT exchanges acyl-carnitine inward for carnitine outward; CPT-2 on the matrix face regenerates acyl-CoA from a separate matrix pool of CoA-SH. His 'they go in together and separate' puts the separation too late. Long-chain free fatty acids cannot achieve directional transport by diffusion, and loading the intact acyl-CoA into the translocase fails for the same reason: CoA does not cross.

quiz.q_zh: 脂肪酸 β-氧化的四步反应发生在哪里？
quiz.q_en: Where do the four reactions of fatty acid beta-oxidation take place?

options.zh: 线粒体内膜的内表面，四个酶都嵌在膜上
options.en: the inner face of the inner membrane, all four enzymes embedded

options.zh: 线粒体基质，只有第一步脱氢酶与内膜结合
options.en: the matrix, with only the first dehydrogenase membrane-associated

options.zh: 线粒体膜间隙，紧挨呼吸链复合体的一侧
options.en: the intermembrane space, right beside the respiratory complexes

options.zh: 细胞质基质，与脂肪酸的合成共用一个区室
options.en: the cytosol, sharing a compartment with fatty acid synthesis

quiz.explain_zh: β-氧化在线粒体基质中进行；四个酶里只有脂酰CoA 脱氢酶与内膜结合，把电子经 ETF 交给辅酶 Q，其余三步（水合酶、L-3-羟脂酰CoA 脱氢酶、硫解酶）都是基质里的可溶性酶。老师反复说的「线粒体内膜里边／内膜内侧」是本课两处被多位校对者独立记下的混淆之一，笔记要改成基质。膜间隙没有这套酶；细胞质是脂肪酸合成的区室，两条路正是靠区室分开的。
quiz.explain_en: Beta-oxidation runs in the mitochondrial matrix; of its four enzymes only acyl-CoA dehydrogenase is membrane-associated, passing electrons through ETF to coenzyme Q, while the hydratase, L-3-hydroxyacyl-CoA dehydrogenase and thiolase are soluble matrix enzymes. His repeated 'inside the inner membrane' is one of the two confusions several proofreaders logged independently, and notes should say matrix. The intermembrane space holds none of these enzymes, and the cytosol is the compartment for synthesis — the separation of the two routes is exactly what compartmentation achieves.

quiz.q_zh: CPT-1（肉碱棕榈酰转移酶 I）在生理条件下的关键别构抑制剂是哪一个？
quiz.q_en: What is the key physiological allosteric inhibitor of CPT-1 (carnitine palmitoyltransferase I)?

options.zh: 柠檬酸，从线粒体漏到胞质时抑制该酶
options.en: citrate, inhibiting the enzyme when it leaks into the cytosol

options.zh: 丙二酰CoA，脂肪酸合成的起始中间物
options.en: malonyl-CoA, the entry intermediate of fatty acid synthesis

options.zh: 长链脂酰CoA，以产物反馈方式抑制转运
options.en: long-chain acyl-CoA, inhibiting transport by product feedback

options.zh: ATP 本身，能量充足时直接结合并抑制该酶
options.en: ATP itself, binding and inhibiting the enzyme when energy is high

quiz.explain_zh: 丙二酰CoA 由乙酰CoA 羧化酶生成，是脂肪酸合成的起点；它一升高就抑制 CPT-1，脂肪酸进不了线粒体，于是合成开动时氧化自动关闭。老师说「ATP 多就转运少」方向对但机制错，ATP 不是这个酶的别构配体。长链脂酰CoA 抑制的是乙酰CoA 羧化酶那一端；柠檬酸在胞质里是乙酰CoA 羧化酶的别构激活剂，作用点和方向都不同。
quiz.explain_en: Malonyl-CoA, made by acetyl-CoA carboxylase, is the entry point of fatty acid synthesis; as soon as it rises it inhibits CPT-1, fatty acids cannot enter, and oxidation shuts off automatically whenever synthesis starts. His 'more ATP, less transport' has the right direction but the wrong mechanism — ATP is not an allosteric ligand of this enzyme. Long-chain acyl-CoA inhibits acetyl-CoA carboxylase instead, and cytosolic citrate is that same carboxylase's allosteric activator, so both act elsewhere and in another direction.

title_zh: 师生问答：酶为什么不遵循「底物越多越快」；「氧化」的定义（他说反后自纠）
title_en: Q&A on why enzymes do not simply follow 'more substrate, faster'; and the definition of oxidation, which he reverses and then fixes

points.zh: 他预告脂肪酸的氧化／分解过程一共涉及四个步骤，并让学生把发下去的图打开。
points.en: He previews that fatty acid oxidation involves four steps in total, and tells the student to open the handout figure.

points.zh: 学生提问：加底物可以增大转化速率，可是加再多酶速率也不会变吧？这不是热力学决定的吗？
points.en: The student asks: adding substrate can raise the conversion rate, but surely adding more enzyme changes nothing? Isn't this decided by thermodynamics?

points.zh: 他把问题重述为：你说的是不是「一个酶催化的反应，底物水平增加，反应平衡会不会改变」。
points.en: He restates the question as: are you asking whether raising substrate level changes the equilibrium of an enzyme-catalysed reaction?

points.zh: 学生补充：底物增加了按理来说反应应该增加，但因为那个酶是受限制的。
points.en: The student adds: more substrate should mean more reaction, but the enzyme is limited.

points.zh: 他的回答：生化跟传统化学最大的区别，就在于人体的酶都受到很多因素的调节。
points.en: His answer: the biggest difference between biochemistry and classical chemistry is that the body's enzymes are all regulated by many factors.

points.zh: 酶虽然充当催化剂，但受别的因素调控，所以在人体内并不是底物越多反应就进行得越快。
points.en: An enzyme acts as a catalyst but is subject to other controls, so inside the body more substrate does not simply mean a faster reaction.

points.zh: 而在最纯正的化学反应里（比如金属催化剂），底物越多反应一定越快，这一点没有太多质疑。
points.en: In a purely chemical system, say with a metal catalyst, more substrate certainly does mean a faster reaction, and that is not in doubt.

points.zh: 接着解释为什么这一段叫「氧化」：他先说成体系里频繁地加氢，「加氢和减氧是一对，统称氧化过程」。
points.en: He then explains why this section is called oxidation, first saying that the system repeatedly adds hydrogen and that 'adding hydrogen and removing oxygen are a pair, together called oxidation'.

points.zh: 他随即发现自己绕进去了并当场纠正：加氧原子、减氢原子才是氧化，加氢原子、减氧原子是还原；所以脂肪酸代谢是不断减氢的过程，占 90% 以上的主流形式叫 β-氧化。
