points.en: He immediately notices the slip and corrects himself on the spot: adding oxygen or removing hydrogen is oxidation, adding hydrogen or removing oxygen is reduction; so fatty acid metabolism is a continual removal of hydrogen, and the dominant form, over 90% of it, is called beta-oxidation.

extra.zh: 00:58:57 他把氧化说成「加氢、减氧」，00:59:28 立刻自己纠正为「加氧原子、减氢原子是氧化，加氢、减氧是还原」，之后的表述都正确。记笔记只保留纠正后的版本。在生化里更好用的判据是看电子／氢的去向：底物脱氢交给 NAD⁺ 或 FAD，底物就是被氧化的一方。
extra.en: At 00:58:57 he defines oxidation as adding hydrogen and removing oxygen; at 00:59:28 he corrects himself to 'adding oxygen or removing hydrogen is oxidation, adding hydrogen or removing oxygen is reduction', and everything after that is right. Keep only the corrected version. In biochemistry the more usable test is to follow the electrons: if the substrate hands hydrogen to NAD+ or FAD, the substrate is what gets oxidised.

extra.zh: 学生其实问到了两件不同的事，值得分开答。热力学：ΔG 和平衡常数只由始末态决定，酶和底物浓度都改变不了平衡位置，酶只是让正逆两个方向同等加速。动力学：底物浓度确实能提速，但按米氏方程 v = Vmax·[S]/(Km+[S])，当 [S] ≫ Km 时 v 趋近 Vmax 而饱和 —— 这就是「加再多底物也快不上去」的定量答案，因为酶的活性中心被占满了。
extra.en: The student actually asked two different things, worth separating. Thermodynamics: the free energy change and equilibrium constant depend only on initial and final states, so neither enzyme nor substrate concentration moves the equilibrium; an enzyme accelerates forward and reverse equally. Kinetics: substrate concentration does raise rate, but by the Michaelis-Menten equation v = Vmax[S]/(Km+[S]), once [S] is far above Km the rate saturates at Vmax — the quantitative answer to 'more substrate stops helping', because the active sites are all occupied.

extra.zh: 他讲的「体内还有别的调控」具体是三层：别构调节（秒级，如丙二酰CoA 抑制 CPT-1）、共价修饰（分钟级，如磷酸化调控激素敏感脂肪酶 HSL 和乙酰CoA 羧化酶）、以及酶量的转录调控（小时到天级）。正因为有这三层，体内通量不由质量作用定律单独决定 —— 这正是他想说但没说透的那句话。
extra.en: The 'other controls in the body' he refers to come in three layers: allosteric regulation on a seconds timescale (malonyl-CoA inhibiting CPT-1), covalent modification on a minutes timescale (phosphorylation of hormone-sensitive lipase and of acetyl-CoA carboxylase), and transcriptional control of enzyme amount over hours to days. Because of these, flux in vivo is not set by mass action alone — which is the point he was reaching for.

extra.zh: 「β-氧化」这个名字来自被氧化并最终断裂的是 β 碳（羧基碳记为 C-1，则 α 是 C-2、β 是 C-3）：一轮里 β 碳先形成双键、再水合成羟基、再氧化成酮基，最后在 α–β 之间硫解断开，每轮缩短两个碳。他说的「占 90% 以上」意思是相对于 α-氧化和 ω-氧化这两条旁路而言。
extra.en: The name beta-oxidation comes from the fact that the beta carbon is what gets oxidised and finally cleaved (numbering the carboxyl carbon C-1, alpha is C-2 and beta is C-3): in one round the beta carbon first forms a double bond, is hydrated to a hydroxyl, oxidised to a ketone, and finally cleaved between alpha and beta by thiolysis, shortening the chain by two carbons. His 'over 90%' means relative to the alpha- and omega-oxidation side routes.

quiz.q_zh: 按化学惯例，下列哪一句是「氧化」的正确定义？
quiz.q_en: By chemical convention, which statement correctly defines oxidation?

options.zh: 同时失去氢原子和失去电子的还原
options.en: a reduction in which hydrogen atoms and electrons are both lost

options.zh: 得到氧原子或者失去氢原子的过程
options.en: the process of gaining oxygen atoms or losing hydrogen atoms

options.zh: 得到氢原子或者失去氧原子的过程
options.en: the process of gaining hydrogen atoms or losing oxygen atoms

options.zh: 同时得到氢原子和氧原子的过程
options.en: the process of gaining hydrogen atoms and oxygen atoms at once

quiz.explain_zh: 加氧或脱氢是氧化，加氢或脱氧是还原。老师在 00:58:57 先说成「加氢减氧是氧化」，00:59:28 立刻自己纠正过来，以纠正后的版本为准。得到氢原子或失去氧原子恰是还原的定义；同时加氢又加氧不构成任何氧化还原判据；把脱氢叫做还原则连方向也一起反了 —— 脱氢的那一方正是被氧化的一方。
quiz.explain_en: Gaining oxygen or losing hydrogen is oxidation; gaining hydrogen or losing oxygen is reduction. At 00:58:57 he said the opposite and corrected himself at 00:59:28, so take the corrected version. Gaining hydrogen or losing oxygen is precisely the definition of reduction; gaining hydrogen and oxygen together is no redox criterion at all; and calling dehydrogenation a reduction reverses the direction — whatever loses hydrogen is what is oxidised.

quiz.q_zh: 关于酶浓度、底物浓度与反应的关系，哪一句说法是对的？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about enzyme concentration, substrate concentration and the reaction is correct?

options.zh: 底物浓度不影响速率，速率完全由酶量决定
options.en: substrate level does not affect rate, which is set by enzyme amount alone

options.zh: 酶量和底物浓度都可以改变反应的平衡常数
options.en: both enzyme amount and substrate level can change the equilibrium constant

options.zh: 底物浓度提高能提速，但趋近 Vmax 之后饱和
options.en: raising substrate speeds things up, but the rate saturates at Vmax

options.zh: 只要不断增加酶的量，反应速率就能无限提高
options.en: if you keep adding enzyme, the rate can be raised without limit

quiz.explain_zh: 按米氏方程，速率随底物浓度上升，但 [S] 远大于 Km 后活性中心被占满，速率趋于 Vmax 不再增加，这正是学生直觉里「酶受限制」的定量表述。平衡常数只由始末态的自由能差决定，酶和底物浓度都动不了它；无限加酶在体外能提高 Vmax，但在细胞里受合成成本和空间限制，不可能无限；说底物完全不影响速率则与 [S] 低于 Km 时速率近似一级的事实矛盾。
quiz.explain_en: By the Michaelis-Menten equation rate rises with substrate, but once [S] far exceeds Km the active sites are saturated and rate approaches Vmax and stops rising — the quantitative form of the student's intuition that the enzyme is limiting. The equilibrium constant depends only on the free energy difference between initial and final states and is untouched by either concentration; adding enzyme raises Vmax in a test tube but is bounded in a cell by synthesis cost and space; and saying substrate has no effect contradicts the near-first-order behaviour seen when [S] is below Km.

quiz.q_zh: 「β-氧化」这个名称的来源是什么？
quiz.q_en: Where does the name beta-oxidation come from?

options.zh: 断在 β 碳与 γ 碳之间，γ 碳先被羟基化
options.en: cleavage between beta and gamma, with gamma hydroxylated first

options.zh: 断在 α 碳与羧基碳之间，α 碳先被氧化脱氢
options.en: cleavage between alpha and the carboxyl carbon, alpha oxidised first

options.zh: 断在 ω 端，每次从甲基端切下两个碳原子
options.en: cleavage at the omega end, removing two carbons from the methyl end

options.zh: 断在 β 碳与 α 碳之间，β 碳先被氧化成酮基
options.en: cleavage between beta and alpha, with beta oxidised to a ketone first

quiz.explain_zh: 一轮 β-氧化里 β 碳（C-3）依次被氧化成双键、羟基、酮基，最后硫解酶在 α 与 β 之间断键，放出乙酰CoA 并使链缩短两个碳，名字就来自这个被氧化的碳。α 碳被氧化并逐个脱碳的是过氧化物酶体里的 α-氧化，处理植烷酸那类 β 碳带甲基的底物；从甲基端开始的是内质网里的 ω-氧化；γ 碳在这条通路上根本不被修饰。
quiz.explain_en: In one round the beta carbon (C-3) is oxidised in turn to a double bond, a hydroxyl and a ketone, after which thiolase cleaves between alpha and beta, releasing acetyl-CoA and shortening the chain by two carbons — the oxidised carbon gives the pathway its name. Oxidising the alpha carbon and removing one carbon at a time is peroxisomal alpha-oxidation, used for substrates like phytanic acid with a methyl on the beta carbon; starting from the methyl end is microsomal omega-oxidation; and the gamma carbon is not modified in this pathway at all.

title_zh: β-氧化第一步：FAD 脱氢，生成反式-Δ²-烯脂酰CoA
title_en: Beta-oxidation step one: FAD dehydrogenation to trans-delta-2-enoyl-CoA

points.zh: 脂肪酸的氧化过程一共就四步，而且是一个比较类似循环的过程。
points.en: Fatty acid oxidation has just four steps, and it works rather like a cycle.

points.zh: 起始底物是脂酰CoA，也就是上一步消耗一分子 ATP 由脂肪酸生成的那个分子。
points.en: The starting substrate is the fatty acyl-CoA made in the previous step at the cost of one ATP.

points.zh: 英文名是 fatty acyl-CoA；他说 acyl 就是「酰」，直接这样说教授也听得懂。
points.en: The English name is fatty acyl-CoA; he notes that acyl is the Chinese 'xian', and that saying it this way is understood by professors.

points.zh: 第一步的酶是脂酰CoA 脱氢酶 acyl-CoA dehydrogenase。
points.en: The first enzyme is acyl-CoA dehydrogenase.

points.zh: 他说这一步「先由 FAD 脱走两分子的氢原子」。
points.en: He says this step 'first uses FAD to remove two molecules of hydrogen atoms'.

points.zh: 脱氢的位置就在酰基旁边：α 位和 β 位，他在图上指出这是 α、这是 β。
points.en: The hydrogens come from right beside the acyl group, the alpha and beta positions, which he points out on the figure.

points.zh: 脱掉这两个氢以后，α 与 β 之间就形成了一个双键。
points.en: Removing those two hydrogens creates a double bond between alpha and beta.

points.zh: 第二步的酶叫「反式的 Δ2 烯酰CoA 水合酶」，他说中文名很绕，记英文名就可以。
points.en: The second enzyme is trans-delta-2-enoyl-CoA hydratase; he says the Chinese name is a mouthful and the English one is enough.

points.zh: 他解释 trans 为什么是反式：因为这一段是平面的，两个氢原子分别落在双键的两边，他顺口把画出来的形状称作「z 型」。
points.en: He explains why it is trans: this stretch is planar and the two hydrogens end up on opposite sides of the double bond; in passing he calls the drawn shape 'z-shaped'.

extra.zh: 「脱走两分子的氢原子」应为脱去两个氢原子 —— α 碳和 β 碳各一个，合起来 2H = 2H⁺ + 2e⁻。产物是 FADH₂ 和反式-Δ²-烯脂酰CoA。同一处口误他在后面讲总能量时还会再犯一次（说「一分子的 FADH」，应为 FADH₂）。
extra.en: 'Two molecules of hydrogen atoms' should be two hydrogen atoms — one from the alpha carbon and one from the beta carbon, together 2H = 2 protons + 2 electrons. The products are FADH2 and trans-delta-2-enoyl-CoA. He repeats the same slip later when totting up energy, saying 'one molecule of FADH' where FADH2 is meant.

extra.zh: 两个氢在双键两侧就是反式，按 E/Z 命名法记作 E，不是 Z。如果他指的是画出来那条锯齿状的「之」字形线条，那没有问题；但如果指 E/Z 命名法里的 Z，就说反了。录音里分不出来，所以笔记上直接写 trans（E），不要写 Z。
extra.en: Two hydrogens on opposite sides of the double bond is trans, designated E in the E/Z system, not Z. If he meant the zig-zag shape of the drawn line, that is fine; if he meant Z in the E/Z nomenclature, it is backwards. The recording cannot distinguish the two, so write trans (E) in notes and leave Z out.

extra.zh: 这一步的 FADH₂ 电子不走复合体 I：脂酰CoA 脱氢酶是内膜结合的黄素酶，电子经电子转移黄素蛋白 ETF 和 ETF-泛醌氧化还原酶交给辅酶 Q，因此按 1.5 ATP 结算。这也解释了为什么四个酶里只有它跟膜有关系，其余三步都在基质里可溶。
extra.en: The FADH2 from this step bypasses complex I: acyl-CoA dehydrogenase is a membrane-associated flavoenzyme whose electrons pass through electron-transfer flavoprotein (ETF) and ETF-ubiquinone oxidoreductase to coenzyme Q, so it is booked at 1.5 ATP. This is also why it is the only one of the four enzymes tied to the membrane, the other three being soluble in the matrix.

extra.zh: 脂酰CoA 脱氢酶按底物链长分成四种同工酶：VLCAD（极长链）、LCAD、MCAD（中链）、SCAD（短链）。MCAD 缺陷是许多国家新生儿足跟血筛查的项目 —— 患儿禁食时中链脂肪酸氧化受阻，出现低酮性低血糖，因为脂肪酸不能被氧化就生不出酮体。
extra.en: Acyl-CoA dehydrogenase exists as four isoenzymes sorted by chain length: VLCAD, LCAD, MCAD and SCAD. MCAD deficiency is on newborn heel-prick screening panels in many countries — when the child fasts, medium-chain oxidation stalls and hypoketotic hypoglycaemia follows, because fatty acids that cannot be oxidised cannot make ketone bodies.

quiz.q_zh: β-氧化第一步用的辅酶和它的直接产物分别是什么？
quiz.q_en: Which coenzyme does the first step of beta-oxidation use, and what is its direct product?

options.zh: FAD 接受氢，产物是反式-Δ²-烯脂酰CoA
options.en: FAD accepts the hydrogens, giving trans-delta-2-enoyl-CoA

options.zh: NADP⁺ 接受氢，产物是顺式-Δ³-烯脂酰CoA
options.en: NADP+ accepts the hydrogens, giving cis-delta-3-enoyl-CoA

options.zh: FMN 接受氢，产物直接是 β-酮脂酰CoA
options.en: FMN accepts the hydrogens, giving beta-ketoacyl-CoA directly

options.zh: NAD⁺ 接受氢，产物是 L-β-羟脂酰CoA
options.en: NAD+ accepts the hydrogens, giving L-beta-hydroxyacyl-CoA

quiz.explain_zh: 脂酰CoA 脱氢酶从 α 碳和 β 碳各取走一个氢交给 FAD，生成 FADH₂ 和反式-Δ²-烯脂酰CoA。用 NAD⁺ 的是第三步（L-3-羟脂酰CoA 脱氢酶），而 L-β-羟脂酰CoA 是第二步水合的产物、不是第一步的；NADP⁺ 是还原性生物合成的辅酶，不参与 β-氧化，顺式-Δ³ 是天然不饱和脂肪酸上的构型、要靠异构酶才能进入通路；β-酮脂酰CoA 要到第三步才出现。
quiz.explain_en: Acyl-CoA dehydrogenase takes one hydrogen each from the alpha and beta carbons and hands them to FAD, giving FADH2 and trans-delta-2-enoyl-CoA. NAD+ is used by the third step, L-3-hydroxyacyl-CoA dehydrogenase, and L-beta-hydroxyacyl-CoA is the hydration product of step two, not step one; NADP+ is the coenzyme of reductive biosynthesis and takes no part here, while cis-delta-3 is a configuration found in natural unsaturated fatty acids that needs an isomerase to enter the pathway; beta-ketoacyl-CoA appears only after step three.

quiz.q_zh: 第一步产生的 FADH₂，其电子进入呼吸链的路径是什么？
quiz.q_en: By what route do the electrons of the FADH2 from step one enter the respiratory chain?

options.zh: 经 ETF 与 ETF-泛醌氧化还原酶交给辅酶 Q
options.en: via ETF and ETF-ubiquinone oxidoreductase to coenzyme Q

options.zh: 经复合体 I 交给辅酶 Q，按 2.5 个 ATP 结算
options.en: via complex I to coenzyme Q, and booked as 2.5 ATP

options.zh: 经苹果酸-天冬氨酸穿梭送进基质再交给 NAD⁺
options.en: via the malate-aspartate shuttle into the matrix and on to NAD+

options.zh: 经细胞色素 c 直接交给复合体 IV 与氧结合
options.en: via cytochrome c straight to complex IV and on to oxygen

quiz.explain_zh: 脂酰CoA 脱氢酶的 FADH₂ 把电子交给电子转移黄素蛋白 ETF，再由 ETF-泛醌氧化还原酶送入辅酶 Q 池，绕开了复合体 I，所以只泵出对应 1.5 个 ATP 的质子。走复合体 I 的是 NADH，那才按 2.5 计；苹果酸-天冬氨酸穿梭运的是胞质 NADH 的还原当量，与基质里已经产生的 FADH₂ 无关；细胞色素 c 位于辅酶 Q 的下游，电子不可能跳过 Q 直接进入。
quiz.explain_en: The FADH2 of acyl-CoA dehydrogenase passes its electrons to electron-transfer flavoprotein, and ETF-ubiquinone oxidoreductase feeds them into the coenzyme Q pool, bypassing complex I, so only enough protons are pumped for 1.5 ATP. It is NADH that goes through complex I and is booked at 2.5; the malate-aspartate shuttle carries reducing equivalents of cytosolic NADH and has nothing to do with FADH2 already made in the matrix; and cytochrome c lies downstream of coenzyme Q, so electrons cannot skip Q to reach it.

quiz.q_zh: 脂酰CoA 脱氢后生成的双键是反式的，这句话在构型上意味着什么？
quiz.q_en: The double bond made by acyl-CoA dehydrogenase is trans — what does that mean configurationally?

options.zh: 两个氢在双键同侧，属顺式，按 E/Z 记作 Z
options.en: the two hydrogens lie on the same side, cis, designated Z

options.zh: 两个氢在双键两侧，属反式，按 E/Z 记作 E
options.en: the two hydrogens lie on opposite sides, trans, designated E

options.zh: 两个氢在双键两侧，属顺式，按 E/Z 记作 Z
options.en: the two hydrogens lie on opposite sides, cis, designated Z

options.zh: 两个氢在双键同侧，属反式，按 E/Z 记作 E
options.en: the two hydrogens lie on the same side, trans, designated E

quiz.explain_zh: α 碳和 β 碳各脱一个氢后，剩下的两个氢分处双键两侧，这就是反式，在 E/Z 命名法里记作 E。老师顺口说的「z 型」如果指的是 E/Z 的 Z 就说反了，如果指画出来的锯齿线条则无妨，笔记直接写 trans（E）最安全。把氢在同侧说成反式、或把氢在异侧说成顺式，都是把顺反的定义本身弄反了。
quiz.explain_en: After one hydrogen is removed from each of the alpha and beta carbons, the two remaining hydrogens sit on opposite sides of the double bond — that is trans, written E in the E/Z system. His offhand 'z-shaped' would be backwards if he meant Z in E/Z, and harmless if he meant the zig-zag drawing, so notes should simply say trans (E). Calling same-side hydrogens trans, or opposite-side hydrogens cis, inverts the definition itself.

title_zh: Δ 与 ω 两套编号；enoyl 不是烯醇；自然界的脂肪酸以顺式为主
title_en: Delta versus omega numbering; enoyl is not enol; natural fatty acids are mostly cis

points.zh: Δ2 里的 Δ 是脂肪酸那一章讲过的、用来描述不饱和脂肪酸双键位置的编号法之一。
points.en: The delta in delta-2 is one of the numbering systems for locating double bonds in unsaturated fatty acids, introduced in the fatty acid chapter.

points.zh: 不饱和脂肪酸的双键位置有两种表示形式：一种叫 Δ，一种叫 Omega。
points.en: There are two conventions for locating the double bond: delta and omega.

points.zh: Δ 表示距离羧基的位置：Δ2 就是羧基旁边数过来第二个位置；他说 Δ 是比较不常用的一种表示形式。
points.en: Delta counts from the carboxyl: delta-2 is the second position along from the carboxyl; he says delta is the less commonly used convention.

points.zh: Omega 是从最远离羧基的另一端开始数的。
points.en: Omega counts from the far end, the one furthest from the carboxyl.

points.zh: 他在图上画一条链、一端写 COOH，说明 Δ 从这边命名、Omega 从那边命名。
points.en: He draws a chain with COOH at one end to show that delta is named from this end and omega from the other.

points.zh: 经常听到的 Omega-3、Omega-6 不饱和脂肪酸，就是以 Omega 来命名的。
points.en: The familiar omega-3 and omega-6 unsaturated fatty acids are named on the omega convention.

points.zh: 第二步产物的英文里有 -yl，他说自己一直不确定该怎么发音；并把 enoyl 的词根解释成「烯醇」，说 EMP 那一章也提到过这个词根，因此把产物叫成「反式的 Δ2 烯醇CoA」。
points.en: He is unsure how to pronounce the -yl in the English name, and glosses the root of enoyl as 'enol', saying the same root came up in the EMP chapter, so he calls the product 'trans-delta-2-enol-CoA'.

points.zh: 学生指出这东西在自然界不常见吧、不然也不至于叫反式；他确认这一点，并说脂肪酸那一章正好没有录像，所以他自己也讲得有点迷糊，答应之后回顾一遍。
points.en: The student remarks that this must be rare in nature, or it would not be called trans; he agrees, and notes that the fatty acid chapter was not recorded, so he is hazy on it himself and promises to review it later.

points.zh: 他给出的数字：自然界 90% 的脂肪都是饱和脂肪酸，只有很少是不饱和的；而不饱和的里面顺式远多于反式。
points.en: The figure he gives: 90% of fats in nature are saturated and only a few are unsaturated, and among the unsaturated ones cis greatly outnumbers trans.

extra.zh: enoyl 不是烯醇。-ene 这个词根只表示碳碳双键，中文是「烯脂酰／烯酰」，产物应写作反式-Δ²-烯脂酰CoA（trans-Δ²-enoyl-CoA）。烯醇 enol 是另一回事：C=C 上直接连一个 —OH，例如糖酵解里的磷酸烯醇式丙酮酸 PEP —— 他大概正是被 EMP 里那个烯醇带偏的。β-氧化第二步的产物上没有羟基，羟基要到第三步水合之后才出现，叫「烯醇」会和紧接着的 L-β-羟脂酰CoA 混成一团。
extra.en: Enoyl is not enol. The -ene root denotes only a carbon-carbon double bond, so the Chinese is 'xi-zhi-xian' and the product should be written trans-delta-2-enoyl-CoA. An enol is something else: a hydroxyl bonded directly to a doubly-bonded carbon, as in glycolysis's phosphoenolpyruvate — almost certainly what led him astray. The step-two product carries no hydroxyl; the hydroxyl appears only after the hydration in step three, so calling it an enol blurs it into the L-beta-hydroxyacyl-CoA that follows.

extra.zh: 「自然界 90% 的脂肪是饱和脂肪酸」数字方向反了。多数天然油脂以不饱和脂肪酸为主 —— 橄榄油约四分之三是油酸，常见植物油普遍以不饱和为主，动物脂肪通常也只有三到五成饱和。生物膜磷脂更典型地是一条链饱和、一条链不饱和（如 1-软脂酰-2-油酰-磷脂酰胆碱），不饱和链正是维持膜流动性的手段。
extra.en: The claim that 90% of natural fats are saturated has the direction reversed. Most natural oils are predominantly unsaturated — olive oil is about three-quarters oleic acid, common vegetable oils are unsaturated as a rule, and even animal fats are typically only 30-50% saturated. Membrane phospholipids are more typically one saturated and one unsaturated chain (for example 1-palmitoyl-2-oleoyl-phosphatidylcholine), the unsaturated chain being exactly how fluidity is maintained.

extra.zh: 两套编号不能混用，换算关系是 ω 号 = 碳链总长 − Δ 号。亚油酸 18:2 Δ9,12 就是 ω-6，α-亚麻酸 18:3 Δ9,12,15 就是 ω-3。要点在于：β-氧化是从羧基端一刀一刀往回切的，所以通路里所有的位置判断（比如双键落在奇数位还是偶数位、要不要异构酶）都必须用 Δ 编号，拿 ω 号来判断会错。
extra.en: The two systems must not be mixed; the conversion is omega number = chain length minus delta number. Linoleic acid 18:2 delta-9,12 is omega-6, and alpha-linolenic acid 18:3 delta-9,12,15 is omega-3. The point that matters: beta-oxidation chops inward from the carboxyl end, so every positional judgement in the pathway — whether a double bond lands on an odd or even carbon, whether an isomerase is needed — must use delta numbering, and using omega numbers gives wrong answers.

extra.zh: 说 Δ「比较不常用」只在营养品标签的语境下成立。在教科书和酶学里 Δ 才是主流写法：Δ⁹-去饱和酶、反式-Δ²-烯脂酰CoA、Δ³,Δ²-烯脂酰CoA 异构酶，全都用 Δ。ω 编号主要活跃在营养学和食品科学的语境里，因为它把「必需脂肪酸的家族」这件事标得更清楚。
extra.en: Calling delta 'less commonly used' holds only in the language of nutrition labels. In textbooks and enzymology delta is the mainstream notation: delta-9 desaturase, trans-delta-2-enoyl-CoA, delta-3,delta-2-enoyl-CoA isomerase all use it. Omega numbering lives mainly in nutrition and food science, because it labels the essential fatty acid families more clearly.

quiz.q_zh: Δ 编号与 ω 编号的起点分别在脂肪酸的哪一端？
quiz.q_en: From which end of the fatty acid do the delta and omega numbering systems start?

options.zh: 两者都从甲基端数起，只是方向恰好相反
options.en: both count from the methyl end, merely in opposite directions

options.zh: Δ 从羧基端数起，ω 从甲基端数起
options.en: delta counts from the carboxyl end, omega from the methyl end

options.zh: Δ 从甲基端数起，ω 从羧基端数起
options.en: delta counts from the methyl end, omega from the carboxyl end

options.zh: 两者都从羧基端数起，起始编号相差一位
options.en: both count from the carboxyl end, offset by one position

quiz.explain_zh: Δ 从羧基碳（C-1）开始数，所以 β-氧化第二步的产物是反式-Δ²；ω 从最远离羧基的甲基端开始数，所以有 Omega-3、Omega-6。换算是 ω 号 = 碳链总长 − Δ 号，亚油酸 18:2 Δ9,12 就是 ω-6。把两个起点对调会让 Δ2 落到甲基端去；说两者同端只差一位、或同端方向相反，都取消了这两套编号本来要区分的东西 —— 一个盯着代谢入口，一个盯着必需脂肪酸家族。
quiz.explain_en: Delta counts from the carboxyl carbon (C-1), which is why the step-two product is trans-delta-2; omega counts from the methyl end furthest from the carboxyl, which is where omega-3 and omega-6 come from. The conversion is omega = chain length minus delta, so linoleic acid 18:2 delta-9,12 is omega-6. Swapping the two origins would put delta-2 at the methyl end; and claiming both start at the same end, whether offset by one or running in opposite directions, erases exactly what the two systems were built to distinguish — one tracks the metabolic entry point, the other the essential fatty acid family.

quiz.q_zh: β-氧化第二步的底物 trans-Δ²-enoyl-CoA，中文正确的叫法和理由是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the correct Chinese name for trans-delta-2-enoyl-CoA, and why?

options.zh: 反式-Δ²-酮脂酰CoA，β 位此时已经是酮基
options.en: trans-delta-2-ketoacyl-CoA, as beta is already a ketone by now

options.zh: 反式-Δ²-烯脂酰CoA，enoyl 只表示碳碳双键
options.en: trans-delta-2-enoyl-CoA, as enoyl denotes only a C=C bond

options.zh: 反式-Δ²-烯醇CoA，enoyl 的词根就是烯醇
options.en: trans-delta-2-enol-CoA, because the root of enoyl is enol

options.zh: 反式-Δ²-羟脂酰CoA，双键上已经带了羟基
options.en: trans-delta-2-hydroxyacyl-CoA, as the bond already bears a hydroxyl

quiz.explain_zh: enoyl 的 -ene 只表示碳碳双键，所以是烯脂酰（烯酰），分子上此刻只有一个 α–β 双键。烯醇 enol 指双键碳上直接连羟基，比如 PEP，老师大概是被 EMP 里那个词带偏了。羟基要到第三步水合以后才出现，那时的产物是 L-β-羟脂酰CoA；酮基更晚，要等第三步的 NAD⁺ 脱氢才生成 β-酮脂酰CoA。
quiz.explain_en: The -ene in enoyl denotes only a carbon-carbon double bond, so the compound is an enoyl species carrying a single alpha-beta double bond and nothing else. An enol has a hydroxyl on a doubly-bonded carbon, as in PEP, which is probably what carried him over from the EMP chapter. A hydroxyl appears only after the hydration of the next step, giving L-beta-hydroxyacyl-CoA; the ketone comes later still, once NAD+ dehydrogenation makes beta-ketoacyl-CoA.

quiz.q_zh: 关于自然界脂肪酸的饱和／不饱和比例，哪一句符合实际？
quiz.q_en: Which statement matches reality about how saturated natural fatty acids are?

options.zh: 天然油脂多以不饱和为主，膜磷脂常一饱一不饱
options.en: natural oils are largely unsaturated, membranes often one of each

options.zh: 天然油脂约九成是饱和脂肪酸，膜磷脂也以饱和为主
options.en: natural oils are about 90% saturated, and so are membranes

options.zh: 天然油脂几乎全是反式不饱和，顺式只见于动物脂肪
options.en: natural oils are almost all trans, cis occurring only in animal fat

options.zh: 天然油脂中饱和与不饱和恰好各半，膜磷脂全为饱和链
options.en: natural oils are exactly half saturated, and membranes wholly so

quiz.explain_zh: 橄榄油约四分之三是油酸，常见植物油普遍以不饱和为主，动物脂肪通常也只有三到五成饱和；膜磷脂典型地一条链饱和、一条链不饱和，正是靠不饱和链维持流动性。老师说的「九成饱和」把方向说反了 —— 如果膜里真有九成饱和链，在体温下会过于有序、失去流动性，反而与他自己用堆积紧密解释顺式弯折的那套论证矛盾。天然不饱和脂肪酸绝大多数是顺式，反式只是少量（反刍动物脂肪）或工业副产物。
quiz.explain_en: Olive oil is about three-quarters oleic acid, common vegetable oils are predominantly unsaturated, and even animal fats are usually only 30-50% saturated; membrane phospholipids typically carry one saturated and one unsaturated chain, and the unsaturated one is what keeps the bilayer fluid. His '90% saturated' has the direction reversed — a membrane that really were 90% saturated would be far too ordered at body temperature, contradicting his own packing argument for the cis kink. Natural unsaturated fatty acids are overwhelmingly cis; trans forms are a small share from ruminant fat or an industrial by-product.

title_zh: 顺式与反式的构象后果；氢化植物油与反式脂肪酸的来源
title_en: What cis and trans do to chain shape; hydrogenated vegetable oil and where trans fats come from

points.zh: 他从磷脂双分子层出发论证：膜里的脂质一定要排列得比较紧密。
points.en: He argues from the phospholipid bilayer: the lipids in a membrane must pack fairly tightly.

points.zh: 顺式不饱和脂肪酸并没有改变脂肪酸链的走向 —— 烷基链还是竖着往下走，所以能排进膜里。
points.en: A cis unsaturated fatty acid does not change the overall direction of the chain — the alkyl chain still runs straight down, so it fits into the membrane.

points.zh: 反式脂肪酸则会改变整个烷基链的走向，等于把链扭了一下。
points.en: A trans fatty acid changes the direction of the whole alkyl chain, effectively kinking it.

points.zh: 扭过的链在热力学上不利于脂质进行很紧密的堆积。
points.en: A kinked chain is thermodynamically unfavourable for tight lipid packing.

points.zh: 所以他说自然界（他把「人体内」现场更正为「自然界」）大部分脂肪酸是顺式的，反式也有但占比远远少于顺式。
points.en: So, he says, most fatty acids in nature — correcting himself from 'in the body' to 'in nature' — are cis, with trans present but far less abundant.

points.zh: 他说人体的细胞膜里 90% 都是饱和脂肪酸，还有 10% 是不饱和脂肪酸。
points.en: He says human cell membranes are 90% saturated fatty acids with the remaining 10% unsaturated.

points.zh: 他说这些不饱和脂肪酸在人体的降解里不太好降解、人不太好吸收，堆积起来就会产生很糟糕的影响。
points.en: He says these unsaturated fatty acids are hard for the body to degrade and to absorb, and that accumulating them has very bad effects.

points.zh: 所以食品工业会对顺式的不饱和脂肪酸做氢化处理 —— 平常看到的「氢化植物油」，就是在化学催化下给双键加上两个氢原子变成饱和脂肪酸。
points.en: Hence the food industry hydrogenates cis unsaturated fatty acids — the 'hydrogenated vegetable oil' one sees on labels is the result of chemically catalysed addition of two hydrogens across the double bond.

points.zh: 但氢化反应不是 100% 进行的：顺式加氢变成饱和脂肪酸的同时，也会在催化剂作用下变成反式脂肪酸，所以零食里才会出现一定量的反式脂肪；他补充说身体降解不饱和脂肪酸时也会经过一个反式中间物。
points.en: But hydrogenation does not go to completion: while cis chains are being saturated, the catalyst also converts some into trans fatty acids, which is why snacks contain some trans fat; he adds that the body's own degradation of unsaturated fatty acids also passes through a trans intermediate.

extra.zh: 「不饱和脂肪酸不好降解、会堆积，所以才要氢化」因果讲错了。不饱和脂肪酸能正常进行 β-氧化，只是需要两个辅助酶：烯脂酰CoA 异构酶（把天然的顺式-Δ³ 转成通路能用的反式-Δ²）和 2,4-二烯脂酰CoA 还原酶（处理多不饱和链）。代价只是产能略少 —— 双键已经存在的那一轮跳过第一步脱氢，少掉一个 FADH₂。不存在「不好吸收、会堆积」这回事。
extra.en: The causal claim that unsaturated fatty acids are hard to degrade, accumulate, and therefore must be hydrogenated is wrong. Unsaturated fatty acids undergo beta-oxidation normally, needing only two auxiliary enzymes: enoyl-CoA isomerase, which converts a natural cis-delta-3 into the usable trans-delta-2, and 2,4-dienoyl-CoA reductase for polyunsaturated chains. The only cost is a slightly lower yield — the round where the double bond already exists skips the first dehydrogenation and forfeits one FADH2. There is no poor absorption and no accumulation.

extra.zh: 工业氢化的真实动机是三条：抗氧化酸败（双键是自动氧化的起点，去掉它货架期大幅延长）、把液态油变成半固态起酥油以获得口感和结构、以及成本（便宜的植物油替代猪油和黄油）。反式脂肪确实有害（升 LDL、降 HDL），但它是氢化不完全的副产物，不是氢化的目的 —— 这正是后来「部分氢化油」被各国限制、而「完全氢化油」不受同样限制的原因。
extra.en: Industrial hydrogenation has three real motives: resisting oxidative rancidity (the double bond is where autoxidation starts, so removing it greatly extends shelf life), turning a liquid oil into a semi-solid shortening for texture and structure, and cost (cheap vegetable oil replacing lard and butter). Trans fat is genuinely harmful, raising LDL and lowering HDL, but it is a by-product of incomplete hydrogenation, not its purpose — which is why partially hydrogenated oils were later restricted in many countries while fully hydrogenated ones were not.

extra.zh: 「细胞膜里 90% 是饱和脂肪酸」与上一段的「自然界 90% 是饱和」是同一个反了方向的数字。生物膜典型的磷脂是一条饱和链加一条不饱和链，不饱和链造成的弯折正是膜在体温下保持流动性的手段。他用「紧密堆积」论证顺式为什么占优，这个论证本身其实说明了膜需要不饱和链 —— 如果真有九成饱和，膜会过于有序。
extra.en: '90% of the cell membrane is saturated' is the same reversed figure as 'nature is 90% saturated' in the previous stretch. A typical membrane phospholipid carries one saturated and one unsaturated chain, and the kink from the unsaturated chain is exactly how the membrane stays fluid at body temperature. His packing argument for why cis predominates in fact shows that membranes need unsaturated chains — at 90% saturation the bilayer would be far too ordered.

extra.zh: 顺式双键在链上造成一个约 30° 的固定弯折，使邻链间的范德华接触面减小，熔点因此大幅下降；反式双键几乎不改变链的走向，行为接近饱和链。同为 18 碳可以排成一条熔点三连：硬脂酸 18:0 约 70 °C，反油酸（反式-Δ⁹）约 45 °C，油酸（顺式-Δ⁹）约 13 °C。这就是「反式脂肪在物理性质和营养上都像饱和脂肪」的物理基础。
extra.en: A cis double bond puts a fixed kink of roughly 30 degrees into the chain, shrinking the van der Waals contact area between neighbours and dropping the melting point sharply; a trans double bond barely alters the chain's direction and behaves much like a saturated one. At 18 carbons the three line up: stearic acid 18:0 melts near 70 C, elaidic acid (trans-delta-9) near 45 C, oleic acid (cis-delta-9) near 13 C. That is the physical basis for trans fat behaving, physically and nutritionally, like saturated fat.

quiz.q_zh: 同样是 18 个碳，硬脂酸、油酸（顺式-Δ⁹）与反油酸（反式-Δ⁹）的熔点高低顺序是？
quiz.q_en: For the same 18 carbons, how do the melting points of stearic, oleic (cis-delta-9) and elaidic (trans-delta-9) acid rank?

options.zh: 硬脂酸最高，反油酸居中，油酸最低
options.en: stearic highest, elaidic in between, oleic lowest

options.zh: 三者熔点接近，双键构型并不影响熔点
options.en: all three are close, configuration having no effect on melting

options.zh: 油酸最高，硬脂酸居中，反油酸最低
options.en: oleic highest, stearic in between, elaidic lowest

options.zh: 反油酸最高，油酸居中，硬脂酸最低
options.en: elaidic highest, oleic in between, stearic lowest

quiz.explain_zh: 硬脂酸 18:0 约 70 °C，反油酸约 45 °C，油酸约 13 °C。顺式双键造成约 30° 的固定弯折，链间接触面减小，熔点大降；反式双键几乎不改变链的走向，行为接近饱和链，所以熔点重新升上去。把油酸或反油酸排在最高都颠倒了这个顺序；说三者接近则否定了构型对堆积的决定性作用，而这正是反式脂肪在物理性质上像饱和脂肪的原因。
quiz.explain_en: Stearic acid melts near 70 C, elaidic near 45 C, oleic near 13 C. A cis double bond creates a fixed kink of about 30 degrees, cutting the contact area between chains and dropping the melting point sharply; a trans double bond hardly alters the chain's direction and behaves like a saturated one, so the melting point climbs back. Putting oleic or elaidic at the top inverts the order; saying the three are close denies the decisive role of configuration in packing, which is exactly why trans fat physically resembles saturated fat.

quiz.q_zh: 不饱和脂肪酸在人体内能否进行 β-氧化？
quiz.q_en: Can unsaturated fatty acids undergo beta-oxidation in the human body?

options.zh: 不能进行，只能靠过氧化物酶体的 α-氧化处理
options.en: no, they can only be handled by peroxisomal alpha-oxidation

options.zh: 能正常进行，只需烯脂酰CoA 异构酶等两个辅助酶
options.en: yes, normally, needing only enoyl-CoA isomerase and one other

options.zh: 能正常进行，而且比饱和脂肪酸多产生几个 FADH₂
options.en: yes, and they even yield a few more FADH2 than saturated ones

options.zh: 不能进行，必须先在肝内氢化成饱和脂肪酸再氧化
options.en: no, they must first be hydrogenated to saturated forms in the liver

quiz.explain_zh: 不饱和脂肪酸走的是同一条 β-氧化通路，只是多用两个酶：烯脂酰CoA 异构酶把天然的顺式-Δ³ 转成通路能用的反式-Δ²，2,4-二烯脂酰CoA 还原酶处理多不饱和链。老师说「不好降解、会堆积」因果讲反了。产能只会略少而不是更多，因为双键已经存在的那一轮跳过第一步脱氢、少掉一个 FADH₂；人体也没有把不饱和脂肪酸氢化成饱和脂肪酸的酶，氢化只发生在工厂的催化反应里。
quiz.explain_en: Unsaturated fatty acids use the same beta-oxidation pathway with two extra enzymes: enoyl-CoA isomerase converts a natural cis-delta-3 into the usable trans-delta-2, and 2,4-dienoyl-CoA reductase deals with polyunsaturated chains. His claim that they are hard to degrade and accumulate has the causation backwards. The yield is slightly lower, not higher, because the round with a pre-existing double bond skips the first dehydrogenation and forfeits an FADH2; and the body has no enzyme that hydrogenates unsaturated to saturated chains, that reaction happening only in an industrial catalyst.

quiz.q_zh: 食品工业对植物油进行氢化处理，主要动机是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the food industry's main motive for hydrogenating vegetable oil?

options.zh: 为了让人体更容易吸收不饱和脂肪酸，避免堆积
options.en: to make unsaturated fatty acids easier to absorb and avoid buildup

options.zh: 为了主动制造反式脂肪酸，用来改善零食的风味
options.en: to deliberately create trans fats in order to improve snack flavour

options.zh: 为了把饱和脂肪酸转化成必需脂肪酸补充营养
options.en: to convert saturated fatty acids into essential ones for nutrition

options.zh: 为了抗氧化酸败、延长货架期并得到半固态油脂
options.en: to resist rancidity, extend shelf life and give a semi-solid fat

quiz.explain_zh: 双键是自动氧化酸败的起点，去掉它货架期大幅延长；同时液态油变成半固态起酥油，才能做出酥皮和人造黄油的质地，成本也比猪油黄油低。老师说的「让人体好吸收」是他前面那个因果错误的延伸，不饱和脂肪酸本来就能正常氧化。反式脂肪是氢化不完全的副产物而不是目的，各国限制的正是「部分氢化油」；氢化只会减少双键，不可能生成必需脂肪酸 —— 必需脂肪酸恰恰是人体不能合成的那些多不饱和脂肪酸。
quiz.explain_en: The double bond is where autoxidative rancidity begins, so removing it greatly extends shelf life; at the same time a liquid oil becomes a semi-solid shortening, which is what gives pastry and margarine their texture, and it is cheaper than lard or butter. His 'easier for the body to absorb' extends the causal error above, since unsaturated fatty acids oxidise perfectly well. Trans fat is a by-product of incomplete hydrogenation rather than the aim, and it is partially hydrogenated oil that regulators restrict; hydrogenation only removes double bonds and can never produce essential fatty acids, which are precisely the polyunsaturated ones humans cannot make.

title_zh: β-氧化第二至四步：水合、再脱氢、硫解
title_en: β-oxidation steps 2-4: hydration, second dehydrogenation, thiolysis

points.zh: 上一步产生的反式-Δ²-双键化合物，在他念作 hydratase 的酶（enoyl-CoA hydratase，水合酶）催化下进行 hydration。
points.en: The trans-Δ² product of step 1 is acted on by the enzyme he pronounces as hydratase (enoyl-CoA hydratase), which carries out a hydration.

points.zh: 他给出的理由是：反式脂肪酸对人体不好，机体不希望它累积，所以下一步马上把它处理掉。
points.en: His stated reason: trans fatty acids are bad for you, the body does not want them accumulating, so the next step disposes of it immediately.

points.zh: 一分子水加成到双键上：羟基上到 β 位，氢上到 α 位。
points.en: One water molecule adds across the double bond: the hydroxyl goes onto the β carbon, the hydrogen onto the α carbon.

points.zh: 产物中文叫 L 型的 β-羟脂酰CoA，英文 L-β-hydroxyacyl-CoA；他强调 hydroxy 就是羟基，名字很长但拆开看就清楚。
points.en: The product is L-β-hydroxyacyl-CoA; he stresses that 'hydroxy' just means the OH group, and the long name reads easily once broken apart.

points.zh: D/L 构型完全是人为规定的，和糖那一章一样以甘油醛为参照物看羟基朝左朝右；这里羟基朝下，所以叫 L 型。
points.en: The D/L designation is a human convention, referred to glyceraldehyde exactly as in the carbohydrate chapter; here the OH points down, so it is called L.

points.zh: 分解代谢的中间物是 L 型，而脂肪酸合成时对应的中间物是 D 型，因为合成走的是逆反应——留到合成部分再讲。
points.en: The catabolic intermediate is the L isomer, while the corresponding intermediate in fatty acid synthesis is D, because synthesis runs the reverse route - to be covered in the synthesis section.

points.zh: 第三步是 oxidation，又是一个 dehydrogenase、又是一次脱氢，他说这一步「是 NADH 来主导的」。
points.en: Step 3 is an oxidation, again a dehydrogenase and again a dehydrogenation; he says this step 'is driven by NADH'.

points.zh: 第三步把刚加到 β 位的羟基变成双键（酮），产物叫 β-酮脂酰CoA（β-ketoacyl-CoA）。
points.en: Step 3 converts the OH just installed at the β carbon into a double bond (a keto group); the product is β-ketoacyl-CoA.

points.zh: 第四步叫硫解（thiolysis）：另一分子被活化的 CoA 用它的硫原子进攻 β 位羰基，切下一分子乙酰CoA，剩下少两个碳的脂酰CoA，乙酰CoA 进入三羧酸循环。
points.en: Step 4 is thiolysis: another activated CoA attacks the β carbonyl with its sulfur, releasing one acetyl-CoA and an acyl-CoA two carbons shorter; the acetyl-CoA enters the TCA cycle.

extra.zh: 第三步的氧化剂他说成 NADH，实际进反应的是 NAD⁺，NADH 是产物：L-β-羟脂酰CoA + NAD⁺ → β-酮脂酰CoA + NADH + H⁺。同一毛病在第一步也有——脱氢用的是 FAD，不是 FADH₂（还原型不可能再收氢）。他在 01:19:48 之后画图复述时仍沿用 FADH／NADH 的口语说法，笔记一律写氧化型。
extra.en: He names NADH as the oxidant in step 3. The oxidant is NAD+; NADH is the product: L-β-hydroxyacyl-CoA + NAD+ → β-ketoacyl-CoA + NADH + H+. Same slip for step 1, where the coenzyme entering is FAD, not FADH2 - a reduced coenzyme cannot accept more hydrogen. He keeps the FADH/NADH wording when he redraws the steps after 01:19:48, so write the oxidized forms in your notes.

extra.zh: 烯醇（enol）不是烯脂酰（enoyl）。他从头到尾把 Δ²-烯脂酰CoA 叫「烯醇」，这是从糖酵解的磷酸烯醇式丙酮酸 PEP 带过来的。enoyl 的词根只表示碳碳双键，中文是烯脂酰／烯酰；enol 指的是 C=C 上直接连一个 —OH。β-氧化第二步的底物上根本没有羟基，羟基要到水合之后才出现在 β 位——把它叫烯醇，正好会和紧接着的 L-β-羟脂酰CoA 混成一团。
extra.en: Enol is not enoyl. Throughout he calls Δ²-enoyl-CoA an 'enol', carried over from phosphoenolpyruvate in glycolysis. The -ene root in enoyl denotes only a C=C double bond; an enol has an OH bonded directly to the C=C. The substrate of step 2 has no hydroxyl at all - the OH appears at the β carbon only after hydration, so calling it an enol blurs it into the L-β-hydroxyacyl-CoA that follows.

extra.zh: 水合这一步的动机不是「清除有害的反式脂肪酸」。反式-Δ²-烯脂酰CoA 是酶促反应的正常中间物，停留在活性中心的时间极短，和食品里的反式脂肪酸（多为长链的反式 Δ9 单不饱和酸）不是一类东西。水合的化学理由是：必须先在 β 碳上装一个羟基，第三步才有可氧化成酮的基团，第四步才有可被硫解的 β-羰基。顺带一提，工业氢化的动机也不是「不饱和脂肪不好消化」，而是抗氧化酸败、延长货架期、把液态油变成半固态起酥油；反式脂肪酸是氢化不完全的副产物，不是目的。
extra.en: Hydration is not there to 'clear away harmful trans fat'. trans-Δ²-enoyl-CoA is a normal, extremely short-lived enzymatic intermediate, chemically unlike dietary trans fats (mostly long-chain trans-Δ9 monoenes). The real reason is chemical: an OH must be placed on the β carbon so that step 3 has something to oxidize to a ketone and step 4 has a β-carbonyl to cleave. Likewise, industrial hydrogenation is done for oxidative stability, shelf life and turning liquid oil into semi-solid shortening - trans fat is a by-product of incomplete hydrogenation, not its purpose.

extra.zh: 一轮四步的酶和顺序要连起来记：脂酰CoA脱氢酶 acyl-CoA dehydrogenase（FAD，按链长分 VLCAD／LCAD／MCAD／SCAD 四种同工酶）→ 烯脂酰CoA水合酶 → L-3-羟脂酰CoA脱氢酶（NAD⁺）→ β-酮硫解酶。链长特异性有临床意义：MCAD 缺陷是最常见的脂肪酸氧化遗传病，典型表现是空腹后的低酮性低血糖（hypoketotic hypoglycemia）。
extra.en: Memorize the four enzymes in order: acyl-CoA dehydrogenase (FAD; four chain-length isoforms VLCAD/LCAD/MCAD/SCAD) → enoyl-CoA hydratase → L-3-hydroxyacyl-CoA dehydrogenase (NAD+) → β-ketothiolase. The chain-length specificity is clinically meaningful: MCAD deficiency is the commonest inherited defect of fatty acid oxidation, presenting as hypoketotic hypoglycemia after fasting.

quiz.q_zh: β-氧化第三步（L-β-羟脂酰CoA 脱氢）真正进入反应的氧化剂是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the actual oxidant entering step 3 of β-oxidation (dehydrogenation of L-β-hydroxyacyl-CoA)?

options.zh: NADP⁺，被还原成 NADPH
options.en: NADP+, reduced to NADPH

options.zh: NAD⁺，被还原成 NADH
options.en: NAD+, reduced to NADH

options.zh: NADH，被氧化成 NAD⁺
options.en: NADH, oxidized to NAD+

options.zh: FAD，被还原成 FADH₂
options.en: FAD, reduced to FADH2

quiz.explain_zh: NAD⁺ 是氧化剂，反应后变成 NADH + H⁺；老师口头说的「NADH 主导」把产物当成了反应物。FAD 是第一步脂酰CoA脱氢酶的辅基，不在第三步。NADP⁺／NADPH 这一对是还原性生物合成用的，脂肪酸合成才用它，分解不用。
quiz.explain_en: NAD+ is the oxidant and becomes NADH + H+. Saying NADH drives the step confuses product with reactant. FAD belongs to step 1, acyl-CoA dehydrogenase, not step 3. The NADP+/NADPH pair serves reductive biosynthesis - fatty acid synthesis uses it, breakdown does not.

quiz.q_zh: β-氧化第四步硫解时，进攻 β-酮脂酰CoA 羰基碳的是什么？
quiz.q_en: In the thiolysis step of β-oxidation, what attacks the carbonyl carbon of β-ketoacyl-CoA?

options.zh: 一分子肉碱，用它的羟基氧来进攻
options.en: a carnitine, attacking with its hydroxyl oxygen

options.zh: 一分子游离 CoA，用它的巯基硫进攻
options.en: a free CoA-SH, attacking with its thiol sulfur

options.zh: 一分子谷胱甘肽，用它的巯基硫进攻
options.en: a glutathione, attacking with its thiol sulfur

options.zh: 一分子乙酰CoA，用它的甲基碳进攻
options.en: an acetyl-CoA, attacking with its methyl carbon

quiz.explain_zh: 进来的是游离的辅酶A（CoA-SH），巯基上的硫作为亲核基团进攻 β 位羰基。乙酰CoA 是走掉的那一半产物，不是进攻者。肉碱只在穿梭步骤上载脂酰基，且靠羟基成酯，不参与硫解。谷胱甘肽的巯基用于抗氧化与结合解毒，不参与 β-氧化。
quiz.explain_en: The attacking species is free coenzyme A (CoA-SH); its thiol sulfur is the nucleophile at the β carbonyl. Acetyl-CoA is the leaving half, the product, not the attacker. Carnitine carries acyl groups only in the shuttle, esterified through its hydroxyl, and plays no part in thiolysis. The glutathione thiol works in antioxidant defence and conjugation, not in β-oxidation.

quiz.q_zh: β-羟脂酰CoA 的构型在分解与合成中分别是什么？
quiz.q_en: Which configuration does β-hydroxyacyl-CoA take in breakdown and in synthesis?

options.zh: 分解代谢是 L 型，合成代谢也是 L 型
options.en: L in catabolism and L in synthesis as well

options.zh: 分解代谢是 L 型，合成代谢是 D 型
options.en: L in catabolism and D in synthesis

options.zh: 分解代谢是 D 型，合成代谢也是 D 型
options.en: D in catabolism and D in synthesis as well

options.zh: 分解代谢是 D 型，合成代谢是 L 型
options.en: D in catabolism and L in synthesis

quiz.explain_zh: β-氧化的水合酶产生 L-β-羟脂酰CoA，而脂肪酸合成的还原酶产生 D-β-羟脂酰-ACP，这一对反差是常考点。说分解是 D 型把两条路径调了个头；说两条路径构型相同则抹掉了这个对比，也就无法解释为什么两条路径必须用不同的酶。
quiz.explain_en: The hydratase of β-oxidation gives L-β-hydroxyacyl-CoA, whereas the reductase of fatty acid synthesis gives D-β-hydroxyacyl-ACP; this contrast is a standard exam point. Calling catabolism D reverses the two pathways, and claiming both share one configuration erases the contrast and leaves no reason why the two pathways need different enzymes.

title_zh: 一轮的收支与整条脂肪酸的总能量核算（7n−6）
title_en: Yield per round and the total energy budget of a fatty acid (7n−6)

points.zh: 脂肪酸的分解是一个近似于循环的过程，只不过每循环一轮就少两个碳原子，缩短了的脂酰CoA 继续下一轮。
points.en: Fatty acid breakdown is quasi-cyclic: each turn removes two carbons and the shortened acyl-CoA re-enters the next turn.

points.zh: 每一轮循环得到一分子 FADH（他的说法）和一分子 NADH。
points.en: Each round yields one FADH (his wording) and one NADH.

points.zh: 整个循环过程不消耗任何 ATP，唯一的消耗是最开始活化的那一步，一个脂肪酸只消耗一个 ATP 分子。
points.en: The cycle itself consumes no ATP; the only cost is the initial activation, one ATP molecule per fatty acid.

points.zh: 但算能量时按两分子 ATP 计，因为那一步断掉的是两个高能磷酸键。
points.en: In the energy bookkeeping it is counted as two ATP, because that step breaks two high-energy phosphate bonds.

points.zh: FADH₂ 按 1.5、NADH 按 2.5 计，所以每一轮循环产生 4 分子 ATP。
points.en: FADH2 counts as 1.5 and NADH as 2.5, so each round yields 4 ATP.

points.zh: 碳数为 n 的脂肪酸要跑 n/2 − 1 轮：因为剩到 4 个碳时，那一轮脱氢、加水、再脱氢之后一次就断成两分子乙酰CoA。
points.en: A fatty acid with n carbons runs n/2 − 1 rounds: once only four carbons remain, that round's dehydrogenation, hydration and second dehydrogenation give a molecule that cleaves into two acetyl-CoA at once.

points.zh: 一共得到 n/2 个乙酰CoA，每一个都进三羧酸循环产能。
points.en: The total is n/2 acetyl-CoA, each of which enters the TCA cycle to make energy.

points.zh: 他说计算过程比较复杂，记住结论就行：n 个碳的脂肪酸彻底代谢一共产生 7n − 6 个 ATP。
points.en: He says the arithmetic is fiddly and only the conclusion matters: complete oxidation of an n-carbon fatty acid yields 7n − 6 ATP.

points.zh: 人体内最常见的 16 碳脂肪酸：7×16 − 6 = 106 个 ATP，而一分子葡萄糖只有 32 个，所以脂肪的能量密度远高于葡萄糖。
points.en: For the commonest human fatty acid, C16: 7×16 − 6 = 106 ATP, against 32 for one glucose, so fat is far denser in energy.

extra.zh: 106 是怎么凑出来的，值得自己算一遍：软脂酸 C16 跑 7 轮 → 7 FADH₂ × 1.5 = 10.5，7 NADH × 2.5 = 17.5，8 个乙酰CoA × 10 = 80，合计 108；减去活化耗掉的 2 个高能磷酸键 = 106，正好等于 7×16 − 6。注意 7n − 6 这个公式只对偶数碳的饱和脂肪酸成立，而且是按 1.5／2.5 这套现代计法；旧教材按 2／3 计会得到别的数。
extra.en: Worth deriving 106 yourself: palmitate (C16) runs 7 rounds → 7 FADH2 × 1.5 = 10.5, 7 NADH × 2.5 = 17.5, 8 acetyl-CoA × 10 = 80, total 108; subtract the 2 high-energy phosphate bonds spent on activation to get 106, exactly 7×16 − 6. The formula 7n − 6 holds only for even-chain saturated fatty acids and only with the modern 1.5/2.5 P/O values; older textbooks using 2/3 give different totals.

extra.zh: 轮数他先说对了（「n 除以二减一次循环」），随后在 01:14:54 前后口误成「二除以 N 减一次循环」「二除以 N 个乙酰CoA」。以 n/2 − 1 轮、n/2 个乙酰CoA 为准：C16 是 7 轮、8 个乙酰CoA。
extra.en: He first states the round count correctly (n/2 − 1) and then, around 01:14:54, misspeaks it as '2 divided by N minus one' and '2 divided by N acetyl-CoA'. The correct version is n/2 − 1 rounds and n/2 acetyl-CoA: for C16 that is 7 rounds and 8 acetyl-CoA.

extra.zh: 在 01:14:20 讲最后一轮时，他把四步的顺序说成「先经过这个脱水加氢再脱氢」。正确顺序是脱氢（FAD）→ 加水 → 再脱氢（NAD⁺）→ 硫解，即先脱氢后加水，中间没有任何一步是「脱水」。他在 01:19:48–01:20:18 逐步画图时讲的顺序是对的（脱两个氢 → 加水 → 再脱氢），以画图那一段为准。另外「一分子的 FADH」应写作 FADH₂，NADH 严格写作 NADH + H⁺，数目本身没错。
extra.en: At 01:14:20, describing the last round, he gives the order as 'dehydration then hydrogenation, then dehydrogenation'. The correct order is dehydrogenation (FAD) → hydration → dehydrogenation (NAD+) → thiolysis: oxidation first, water second, and no step anywhere is a dehydration. When he redraws the steps between 01:19:48 and 01:20:18 he gives the right order (remove two hydrogens → add water → remove two more), so take that pass as authoritative. Also, 'one FADH' should be written FADH2 and NADH strictly as NADH + H+, though the counts themselves are right.

extra.zh: 为什么活化那一步按 2 个 ATP 算：脂酰CoA合成酶（在线粒体外膜）把 ATP 断成 AMP + PPi，而不是 ADP + Pi；随后无机焦磷酸酶把 PPi 水解成 2 Pi，这个额外的放能步骤把整个活化反应不可逆地拉过去。细胞要把 AMP 变回 ATP 还得再花一个高能磷酸键（腺苷酸激酶：AMP + ATP → 2 ADP），所以净耗 2 个。这是生化里「花两个键买不可逆性」的典型例子，和糖原合成里 UTP 断出 PPi 是同一个套路。
extra.en: Why activation counts as two ATP: acyl-CoA synthetase on the outer mitochondrial membrane cleaves ATP to AMP + PPi, not ADP + Pi; inorganic pyrophosphatase then hydrolyses PPi to 2 Pi, and that extra exergonic step pulls the activation irreversibly forward. Regenerating ATP from AMP costs another high-energy bond (adenylate kinase: AMP + ATP → 2 ADP), so the net cost is two. This is the classic 'spend two bonds to buy irreversibility' motif, the same device used when UTP releases PPi in glycogen synthesis.

quiz.q_zh: 16 碳的软脂酸完全进行 β-氧化，需要几轮循环、产生几个乙酰CoA？
quiz.q_en: How many rounds and how many acetyl-CoA does complete β-oxidation of C16 palmitate give?

options.zh: 8 轮循环，产生 8 个乙酰CoA
options.en: 8 rounds, giving 8 acetyl-CoA

options.zh: 7 轮循环，产生 8 个乙酰CoA
options.en: 7 rounds, giving 8 acetyl-CoA

options.zh: 7 轮循环，产生 7 个乙酰CoA
options.en: 7 rounds, giving 7 acetyl-CoA

options.zh: 16 轮循环，产生 16 个乙酰CoA
options.en: 16 rounds, giving 16 acetyl-CoA

quiz.explain_zh: n/2 − 1 = 7 轮，n/2 = 8 个乙酰CoA。轮数与乙酰CoA 数不相等，正是因为最后一轮把 4 碳的乙酰乙酰CoA 一次切成两个乙酰CoA，所以 8 轮 8 个、7 轮 7 个都算错了一头。16 轮 16 个则是把「每轮切一个碳」当成了「每轮切两个碳」。
quiz.explain_en: n/2 − 1 = 7 rounds and n/2 = 8 acetyl-CoA. Rounds and acetyl-CoA differ by one because the final round splits the four-carbon acetoacetyl-CoA into two acetyl-CoA at once, so 8 rounds/8 units and 7 rounds/7 units each miscount one end. 16 rounds/16 units treats the cycle as removing one carbon per turn instead of two.

quiz.q_zh: 为什么一分子脂肪酸的活化按消耗 2 个 ATP 计，而不是 1 个？
quiz.q_en: Why is activation of one fatty acid counted as costing 2 ATP rather than 1?

options.zh: 硫酯键形成时要两分子 ATP 同时供能
options.en: thioester formation needs two ATP acting together

options.zh: ATP 一次断到 AMP，用掉两个高能键
options.en: ATP is split all the way to AMP, using two bonds

options.zh: 活化时连续消耗两分子 ATP，各断一个键
options.en: activation burns two ATP in a row, one bond each

options.zh: 肉碱穿梭送脂酰基进基质时再耗一个 ATP
options.en: the carnitine shuttle spends one more ATP on entry

quiz.explain_zh: 脂酰CoA合成酶把 ATP 一次断到 AMP，同时释放焦磷酸，等于用掉两个高能磷酸键，所以按 2 个 ATP 记。只消耗了一分子 ATP，不是两分子，所以「连续消耗两分子」不成立；肉碱穿梭是脂酰基与肉碱之间的转酯和反向交换，本身不水解 ATP；硫酯键的能量正来自这一次 ATP 的裂解，不需要第二分子 ATP 同时参与。
quiz.explain_en: Acyl-CoA synthetase cleaves ATP all the way to AMP and releases pyrophosphate, spending two high-energy phosphate bonds, hence the count of 2 ATP. Only one ATP molecule is consumed, so 'two ATP in a row' is wrong; the carnitine shuttle works by transesterification and antiport and hydrolyses no ATP; and the thioester bond is paid for by that single ATP cleavage, with no second ATP involved.

quiz.q_zh: 按课上的算法，一分子 16 碳脂肪酸与一分子葡萄糖彻底氧化各产多少 ATP？
quiz.q_en: By the lecture's arithmetic, how much ATP does complete oxidation of one C16 fatty acid and one glucose give?

options.zh: 脂肪酸 96 个，葡萄糖 38 个
options.en: fatty acid 96 ATP, glucose 38 ATP

options.zh: 脂肪酸 112 个，葡萄糖 36 个
options.en: fatty acid 112 ATP, glucose 36 ATP

options.zh: 脂肪酸 106 个，葡萄糖 32 个
options.en: fatty acid 106 ATP, glucose 32 ATP

options.zh: 脂肪酸 129 个，葡萄糖 30 个
options.en: fatty acid 129 ATP, glucose 30 ATP

quiz.explain_zh: 7×16 − 6 = 106，葡萄糖按苹果酸-天冬氨酸穿梭计 32。112 是忘了减掉活化的两个高能磷酸键（108 也不是 112）；96 与 129 都不来自这套算法；30 是走磷酸甘油穿梭的葡萄糖数值，与 129 搭配没有依据。
quiz.explain_en: 7×16 − 6 = 106, and glucose gives 32 via the malate-aspartate shuttle. 112 forgets to subtract the two activation bonds (and 108, not 112, is the pre-subtraction figure); 96 and 129 come from no version of this calculation; 30 is the glycerol-phosphate-shuttle value for glucose and does not pair with 129.

title_zh: 现场画结构：从甘油三酯到脂肪酸再到脂酰CoA
title_en: Drawing it out: from triacylglycerol to fatty acid to acyl-CoA

points.zh: 学生说四步反应还好，主要是对脂肪酸这个分子本身不太熟悉，他就打开 ChemDraw 现场画。
points.en: The student says the four steps are fine but the fatty acid molecule itself is unfamiliar, so he opens ChemDraw and draws it live.

points.zh: 他的看法是：脂肪酸的结构比糖类简单得多，糖有四碳五碳六碳的环状结构要分，脂肪酸就是一条长链。
points.en: His view: a fatty acid is far simpler than a sugar - sugars come as four-, five- and six-carbon rings to keep apart, a fatty acid is just a long chain.

points.zh: 先画甘油：三个碳，每一个位置上都是一个羟基。
points.en: First glycerol: three carbons, each bearing a hydroxyl.

points.zh: 甘油的每一个羟基位置都连上一分子脂肪酸形成酯键，后面跟着一长串碳，他边数边画到十四、十五、十六个碳。
points.en: Each glycerol hydroxyl is esterified to a fatty acid whose long carbon chain follows; he counts them out to fourteen, fifteen, sixteen carbons.

points.zh: 三条链都画完，这就是最经典的脂肪长的样子（甘油三酯）。
points.en: With all three chains drawn, this is what classical fat - a triacylglycerol - looks like.

points.zh: 脂肪进入体内最先被分解的就是这里：把上下两个位置的酯键水解掉，各放出一分子脂肪酸。
points.en: This is where digestion starts: the ester bonds at the top and bottom positions are hydrolysed, releasing one fatty acid each.

points.zh: 把羧基上的羟基补上，得到的就是游离脂肪酸——「脂肪酸长的就是这个样子」。
points.en: Put the OH back on the carboxyl and you have the free fatty acid - 'this is what a fatty acid looks like'.

points.zh: 他把画好的分子转个方向，说这样看就是我们平时写脂肪酸的样子，刚才只是摆的角度陌生。
points.en: He rotates the drawing and says that in this orientation it is the way we normally write a fatty acid; only the earlier angle looked unfamiliar.

points.zh: 脂酰CoA 形成在羧基这一端：把羧基上的那个位置换成 S-CoA，这个东西就是脂酰CoA，也就是 β-氧化的底物。
points.en: Acyl-CoA forms at the carboxyl end: replace that position with S-CoA and you have acyl-CoA, the substrate of β-oxidation.

extra.zh: 他「把上下两个酯键水解掉、留中间那个」画对了结果——胰脂肪酶的产物就是 2-单酰甘油 + 2 分子脂肪酸——但前面给的理由（中间那个位阻大）不对。真正的原因是胰脂肪酶的 sn-1,3 位置专一性：酶的活性中心只识别甘油骨架两个端位的酯键，中间的 sn-2 位根本进不去活性中心。
extra.en: Hydrolysing the top and bottom esters and leaving the middle one gives the right answer - pancreatic lipase yields 2-monoacylglycerol plus two fatty acids - but the reason he gave earlier (steric bulk at the middle ester) is wrong. The real cause is the sn-1,3 positional specificity of pancreatic lipase: its active site recognizes only the two terminal ester bonds, and the sn-2 position never reaches the catalytic centre.

extra.zh: 脂酰CoA 里脂肪酸与 CoA 之间是硫酯键（thioester），不是画甘油三酯时那种普通酯键。硫酯水解的 ΔG°′ 约 −31 kJ/mol，和 ATP 水解相当，这就是「活化」二字的含义：被活化的是脂肪酸的羧基（变成高能形式），不是 CoA。老师在更早的一段里曾说成「把 CoA 活化」，随后自己改口说的是活化脂肪酸。
extra.en: The bond between fatty acid and CoA is a thioester, not the ordinary ester drawn in the triacylglycerol. Thioester hydrolysis has ΔG°' around −31 kJ/mol, comparable to ATP, which is exactly what 'activation' means: the fatty acid's carboxyl is raised to a high-energy form, not the CoA. Earlier in the lecture he said 'activate the CoA' and then corrected himself to activating the fatty acid.

extra.zh: 画出来的甘油那一半不进 β-氧化，它有自己的去路：甘油激酶把它磷酸化成 3-磷酸甘油（sn-glycerol-3-phosphate），3-磷酸甘油脱氢酶再把它氧化成磷酸二羟丙酮 DHAP，从这里进糖酵解或糖异生。所以禁食时脂肪动员出来的甘油是一个现成的糖异生底物，而脂肪酸那一半则不能净生成葡萄糖。
extra.en: The glycerol half he drew does not enter β-oxidation; it has its own route. Glycerol kinase phosphorylates it to sn-glycerol-3-phosphate, glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase oxidizes that to dihydroxyacetone phosphate (DHAP), and from there it joins glycolysis or gluconeogenesis. So the glycerol released during fasting is a ready-made gluconeogenic substrate, whereas the fatty acid half cannot give net glucose.

extra.zh: 编号规则配着这张图记：脂肪酸从羧基碳开始算 C1，C2 就是 α 位、C3 就是 β 位，β-氧化切的正是 α 与 β 之间那根键，也正是「β」这个名字的由来。书写用 16:0（软脂酸 palmitate）、18:0（硬脂酸 stearate）、18:1 Δ9（油酸 oleate）这种「碳数:双键数 + 位置」的格式。
extra.en: Fix the numbering against this drawing: C1 is the carboxyl carbon, C2 is α and C3 is β, and β-oxidation cleaves precisely the α-β bond - which is where the name comes from. The shorthand is carbons:double bonds plus positions, e.g. 16:0 palmitate, 18:0 stearate, 18:1 Δ9 oleate.

quiz.q_zh: 胰脂肪酶水解甘油三酯得到什么产物，原因是什么？
quiz.q_en: What does pancreatic lipase make from a triacylglycerol, and why?

options.zh: 二酰甘油和 1 分子脂肪酸，只认 sn-1 位
options.en: diacylglycerol and 1 fatty acid, recognizing sn-1 only

options.zh: 2-单酰甘油和 2 分子脂肪酸，酶只切两端的酯键
options.en: 2-monoacylglycerol and 2 fatty acids, only end esters cut

options.zh: 甘油和 3 分子脂肪酸，三个酯键全部被水解
options.en: glycerol and 3 fatty acids, since all three esters are cut

options.zh: 1-单酰甘油和 2 分子脂肪酸，中间酯键位阻大
options.en: 1-monoacylglycerol and 2 fatty acids, from steric bulk

quiz.explain_zh: 胰脂肪酶只切甘油骨架两端（sn-1 和 sn-3）的酯键，中间的 sn-2 位保留下来，所以产物是 2-单酰甘油和两分子脂肪酸。完全水解成甘油需要别的脂肪酶接力，不是胰脂肪酶一步的结果；「位阻大」是老师给的理由，结果虽对但机制不是位阻；只切一个酯键得二酰甘油则低估了它的活性。
quiz.explain_en: Pancreatic lipase cuts only the two terminal esters (sn-1 and sn-3), leaving sn-2 intact, so the products are 2-monoacylglycerol and two fatty acids. Complete hydrolysis to glycerol requires other lipases downstream, not this one enzyme; steric bulk was the teacher's reason and gives the right products for the wrong mechanism; and cutting a single ester to diacylglycerol understates the enzyme's action.

quiz.q_zh: 脂酰CoA 中脂肪酸与辅酶A 之间是什么键？
quiz.q_en: What kind of bond joins the fatty acid to coenzyme A in acyl-CoA?

options.zh: 磷酸酐键，由羧基与 CoA 的磷酸形成
options.en: a phosphoanhydride, from the carboxyl and a phosphate

options.zh: 普通酯键，由羧基与 CoA 的羟基形成
options.en: an ordinary ester, from the carboxyl and a CoA hydroxyl

options.zh: 硫酯键，由羧基与 CoA 的巯基形成
options.en: a thioester, from the carboxyl and the CoA thiol group

options.zh: 酰胺键，由羧基与 CoA 的氨基形成
options.en: an amide, from the carboxyl and an amino group of CoA

quiz.explain_zh: CoA 起反应的基团是末端巯基 —SH，与脂肪酸羧基缩合成高能硫酯键，这正是「脂肪酸被活化」的化学含义。普通酯键的水解自由能远小于硫酯，撑不起后面的硫解和缩合反应；CoA 分子里虽有氨基和磷酸，但它们不是酰基的挂载点。
quiz.explain_en: The reactive group of CoA is its terminal thiol, which condenses with the fatty acid carboxyl to form a high-energy thioester - this is the chemistry behind 'activated fatty acid'. An ordinary ester releases far less free energy on hydrolysis and could not drive the later thiolysis and condensation steps; CoA does contain amino and phosphate groups, but neither is where the acyl group is carried.

title_zh: 在结构上复走四步：硫解、游离 CoA 的来源与反应部位
title_en: Walking the four steps through the structure: thiolysis, where free CoA comes from, and where it all happens

points.zh: 第一步：在 α 位和 β 位之间脱掉两个氢原子（他说「用一分子的 FADH」），形成双键。
points.en: Step 1: two hydrogen atoms are removed between the α and β carbons ('using one FADH', as he puts it), creating a double bond.

points.zh: 第二步：在这里加一个水，羟基加到 β 位，水的另一边那个氢原子加到 α 位。
points.en: Step 2: water adds here - the hydroxyl to the β carbon, the leftover hydrogen to the α carbon.

points.zh: 第三步：再脱掉两个氢，脱在 β 位这个羟基上，于是形成一个「对称」的结构——左边是一个乙酰、右边也像一个乙酰。
points.en: Step 3: two more hydrogens come off the β hydroxyl, giving what he calls a symmetric structure - an acetyl on the left and something acetyl-like on the right.

points.zh: 第四步：一分子新的 CoA 打到这里来，左边那一半就作为乙酰CoA 走掉了。
points.en: Step 4: a fresh CoA comes in here and the left-hand half leaves as acetyl-CoA.

points.zh: 他先把打进来的那一分子说成「新的乙酰CoA」，随后在 01:21:25 之后讲清楚：进来的是游离的 CoA。
points.en: He first calls the incoming molecule 'a new acetyl-CoA', then makes clear after 01:21:25 that what comes in is free CoA.

points.zh: 游离 CoA 的来源：CoA 是维生素那一章讲过的小分子，三羧酸循环里就有一步会放出游离的 CoA。
points.en: Where free CoA comes from: CoA is the small molecule from the vitamins chapter, and one step of the TCA cycle releases it in free form.

points.zh: 乙酰CoA 带着乙酰基马上参与 TCA，在第一步就把乙酰基交给草酰乙酸，自己又变回游离 CoA，可以再去接新的乙酰基。
points.en: Acetyl-CoA carries its acetyl group straight into the TCA cycle, hands it to oxaloacetate at the very first step, reverts to free CoA and is ready to pick up another acetyl group.

points.zh: 所以 CoA 是一个循环往复、「用不完」的小分子——学生总结说「是一个很多地方都用得到、用不完的玩意儿」。
points.en: So CoA is a small molecule that cycles endlessly and is effectively never used up - as the student sums up, something used everywhere and never exhausted.

points.zh: 他说整个 β-氧化过程「都是在线粒体内膜里边发生的」，三羧酸循环也在那里，所以那里有大量游离 CoA；并总结脂肪酸代谢比糖的分解简单得多，一共就四步，画两遍就记住了。
points.en: He states that the whole of β-oxidation 'happens inside the inner mitochondrial membrane', that the TCA cycle is there too and therefore plenty of free CoA is available, and concludes that fatty acid metabolism is far simpler than sugar breakdown - four steps, drawn twice and remembered.

extra.zh: β-氧化的部位是线粒体基质（matrix），不是线粒体内膜——这是本讲反复出现的一处定位问题。四个酶里只有第一步的脂酰CoA脱氢酶与内膜结合（它是黄素酶，电子经 ETF 和 ETF-泛醌氧化还原酶交给辅酶 Q，绕过复合体 I，所以 FADH₂ 只值 1.5 个 ATP）；烯脂酰CoA水合酶、L-3-羟脂酰CoA脱氢酶和硫解酶都是基质里的可溶性酶。三羧酸循环同样在基质，内膜上跑的是电子传递链。他后面讲酮体时说的「线粒体的基质」才是对的。
extra.en: β-oxidation runs in the mitochondrial matrix, not in the inner membrane - a localization slip that recurs through this lecture. Of the four enzymes only acyl-CoA dehydrogenase is membrane-associated: it is a flavoenzyme that passes electrons through ETF and ETF-ubiquinone oxidoreductase to coenzyme Q, bypassing complex I, which is exactly why its FADH2 is worth only 1.5 ATP. Enoyl-CoA hydratase, L-3-hydroxyacyl-CoA dehydrogenase and thiolase are all soluble matrix enzymes. The TCA cycle is likewise in the matrix; the inner membrane carries the electron transport chain. When he reaches ketone bodies later he correctly says 'mitochondrial matrix'.

extra.zh: 硫解那一步进来的是游离的 CoA-SH，不是乙酰CoA；乙酰CoA 是走掉的那一半产物。他在 01:21:25–01:21:55 自己讲清楚了（「产生这个游离的 CoA……线粒体内部有很多游离的 CoA」），做笔记按自纠后的版本记，不要把「新的乙酰CoA 打进来」写成知识点。
extra.en: The molecule entering at thiolysis is free CoA-SH, not acetyl-CoA; acetyl-CoA is the half that leaves. He sorts this out himself between 01:21:25 and 01:21:55 ('free CoA is produced ... there is plenty of free CoA inside the mitochondrion'), so take the corrected version and do not record 'a new acetyl-CoA comes in' as a fact.

extra.zh: 「CoA 用不完」是对的，但胞质和基质是两个互不相通的 CoA 池——CoA 本身从不穿过线粒体内膜。这正是肉碱穿梭存在的理由，三步分工要分清：CPT-1（线粒体外膜，面向胞质）把脂酰基从 CoA 转到肉碱上，释放出胞质的游离 CoA-SH；CACT（内膜转位酶）以肉碱／脂酰肉碱一比一反向交换把脂酰肉碱换进基质；CPT-2（内膜的基质面）再用基质里的另一分子 CoA-SH 把脂酰基接回来，重新做成脂酰CoA。所以「脂酰CoA 和肉碱一起进去、进去以后再分开」是错的：分开发生在进去之前。
extra.en: That CoA is never used up is true, but the cytosolic and matrix CoA pools are separate - CoA itself never crosses the inner membrane. That is precisely why the carnitine shuttle exists, and the division of labour matters: CPT-1 on the outer membrane, facing the cytosol, transfers the acyl group from CoA onto carnitine and releases cytosolic free CoA-SH; CACT in the inner membrane exchanges acylcarnitine inward one-for-one against free carnitine; CPT-2 on the matrix face of the inner membrane hands the acyl group to a different CoA-SH from the matrix pool, regenerating acyl-CoA. So 'acyl-CoA and carnitine go in together and separate inside' is wrong: they separate before entry.

extra.zh: 这个入口是分解与合成的总开关，而开关不是 ATP：CPT-1 的生理性别构抑制剂是丙二酰CoA（malonyl-CoA），也就是脂肪酸合成的第一个中间物。进食、胰岛素高 → 乙酰CoA羧化酶活跃 → 丙二酰CoA 升高 → CPT-1 被抑制 → 脂肪酸进不了线粒体。细胞正在造脂肪酸的时候，β-氧化的大门是关着的，两条路因此不会同时空转。这一点会在下半节的合成部分接上。
extra.en: This entry point is the master switch between breakdown and synthesis, and the switch is not ATP: the physiological allosteric inhibitor of CPT-1 is malonyl-CoA, the first committed intermediate of fatty acid synthesis. Feeding and high insulin activate acetyl-CoA carboxylase, malonyl-CoA rises, CPT-1 is inhibited and fatty acids cannot enter the mitochondrion. While the cell is making fatty acids the door to β-oxidation is shut, so the two pathways never run as a futile cycle. The synthesis half of the lecture picks this up later.

quiz.q_zh: β-氧化的四个酶分别在线粒体的什么位置？
quiz.q_en: Where in the mitochondrion do the four enzymes of β-oxidation sit?

options.zh: 四步酶都嵌在线粒体内膜上，面向基质
options.en: all four are embedded in the inner membrane, facing the matrix

options.zh: 四步酶全都是基质中的可溶性酶
options.en: all four are soluble enzymes floating free in the matrix

options.zh: 第一步脱氢酶连着内膜，其余三步在基质
options.en: the first dehydrogenase is membrane-linked, the rest are matrix

options.zh: 前三步在基质，硫解酶结合在内膜上
options.en: the first three are in the matrix, thiolase on the inner membrane

quiz.explain_zh: 脂酰CoA脱氢酶是与内膜结合的黄素酶，电子经 ETF／ETF-QO 交给辅酶 Q；水合酶、羟脂酰CoA脱氢酶和硫解酶都是基质中的可溶性酶。说四步全在内膜就是课上那个定位说法，说四步全溶于基质则漏掉了第一步与呼吸链的偶联，也就无法解释 FADH₂ 为什么只值 1.5 个 ATP；把硫解酶说成膜结合则完全没有依据。
quiz.explain_en: Acyl-CoA dehydrogenase is a membrane-linked flavoenzyme feeding electrons through ETF/ETF-QO to coenzyme Q, while the hydratase, hydroxyacyl-CoA dehydrogenase and thiolase are soluble matrix enzymes. Putting all four in the membrane is the lecture's slip; making all four soluble loses the coupling of step 1 to the respiratory chain and leaves the 1.5 ATP value of FADH2 unexplained; and there is no basis for calling thiolase membrane-bound.

quiz.q_zh: 关于 CoA 在线粒体内外的分布，正确的是？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about CoA on either side of the inner membrane is correct?

options.zh: CoA 不过内膜，胞质池与基质池彼此独立
options.en: CoA never crosses; cytosolic and matrix pools stay separate

options.zh: CoA 随脂酰基一起经肉碱穿梭进入基质
options.en: CoA rides into the matrix with the acyl group on the shuttle

options.zh: CoA 由 CACT 与肉碱一比一交换进入基质
options.en: CACT exchanges CoA one-for-one against carnitine inward

options.zh: CoA 只在基质合成，胞质中没有游离 CoA
options.en: CoA is made only in the matrix, none free in the cytosol

quiz.explain_zh: CoA 本身不穿过线粒体内膜：CPT-1 在胞质侧把脂酰基卸到肉碱上并放出胞质 CoA，CPT-2 在基质侧再用基质的 CoA 装回去，两池因此各自调控。跟着脂酰基一起进去就等于说 CoA 过了膜；CACT 交换的是肉碱与脂酰肉碱，不是 CoA；而胞质里必须有游离 CoA，否则脂酰CoA合成酶那一步无法进行。
quiz.explain_en: CoA itself does not cross the inner membrane: CPT-1 unloads the acyl group onto carnitine on the cytosolic side and releases cytosolic CoA, and CPT-2 reloads it onto matrix CoA, so the two pools are regulated independently. Riding in with the acyl group would mean CoA crossed; CACT exchanges carnitine against acylcarnitine, not CoA; and free CoA must exist in the cytosol or acyl-CoA synthetase could not work.

quiz.q_zh: 乙酰CoA 把乙酰基交给谁之后重新变回游离 CoA？
quiz.q_en: To what does acetyl-CoA hand its acetyl group, regenerating free CoA?

options.zh: 琥珀酸，在琥珀酰CoA 合成酶那一步
options.en: succinate, at the step run by succinyl-CoA synthetase

options.zh: 苹果酸，在苹果酸脱氢酶催化的那一步
options.en: malate, at the step catalysed by malate dehydrogenase

options.zh: 草酰乙酸，在柠檬酸合酶催化的那一步
options.en: oxaloacetate, at the step catalysed by citrate synthase

options.zh: α-酮戊二酸，在异柠檬酸脱氢酶那一步
options.en: α-ketoglutarate, at the isocitrate dehydrogenase step

quiz.explain_zh: TCA 的第一步就是柠檬酸合酶把乙酰基缩合到草酰乙酸上生成柠檬酸，同时放出游离 CoA-SH。异柠檬酸脱氢酶做的是氧化脱羧产 NADH 和 CO₂，α-酮戊二酸是它的产物而不是乙酰基受体；琥珀酰CoA 合成酶放出的是琥珀酰CoA 上的 CoA，与乙酰基无关；苹果酸脱氢酶只做羟基到酮的氧化，不涉及 CoA。
quiz.explain_en: The first step of the TCA cycle is citrate synthase condensing the acetyl group onto oxaloacetate to give citrate, releasing free CoA-SH. Isocitrate dehydrogenase performs an oxidative decarboxylation yielding NADH and CO2, with α-ketoglutarate as its product rather than an acetyl acceptor; succinyl-CoA synthetase releases the CoA of succinyl-CoA, which has nothing to do with an acetyl group; and malate dehydrogenase merely oxidizes a hydroxyl to a ketone, with no CoA involved.

title_zh: 不饱和脂肪酸的 β-氧化与那个异构酶
title_en: β-oxidation of unsaturated fatty acids and the isomerase

points.zh: 他说接下来是一些「不太重要」的知识点：脂肪酸并不是只有偶数碳、也不是只有 16 碳 18 碳。
points.en: He moves on to what he calls less important points: fatty acids are not only even-numbered and not only 16 or 18 carbons long.

points.zh: 还有奇数碳的脂肪酸，他举了 15 个碳、14 个碳、13 个碳、11 个碳这些例子。
points.en: There are odd-chain fatty acids too; he lists 15, 14, 13 and 11 carbons as examples.

points.zh: 涉及这些脂肪酸时，经典的 β-氧化过程没有办法把它完全裂解，因为最后总会剩下多出来的一个三碳的 CoA 化合物。
points.en: For those, classical β-oxidation cannot cleave the chain completely, because a three-carbon CoA compound is always left over at the end.

points.zh: 人体因此另有一些途径来处理奇数碳的脂肪酸。
points.en: The body therefore has other routes for handling odd-chain fatty acids.

points.zh: 不饱和脂肪酸方面，他说大部分不饱和脂肪酸都是 Omega 的，前面提过 Omega-3、Omega-6，并说「三位六位都是奇数位」。
points.en: For unsaturated fatty acids he says most are omega types - omega-3 and omega-6 as mentioned earlier - and that 'positions 3 and 6 are both odd'.

points.zh: β-氧化从羧基端开始，每次切两个碳，是「双数双数」地往下切，所以碰到双键时一定会停在某个固定的样式上。
points.en: β-oxidation starts at the carboxyl end and removes two carbons at a time, so when it reaches a double bond the intermediate always has one particular pattern.

points.zh: 如果双键落在双数位置，那这个中间物本来就是 β-氧化过程中的正常产物，可以直接继续往下走。
points.en: If the double bond falls at an even-numbered position, the intermediate is already a normal β-oxidation product and the pathway simply continues.

points.zh: 如果双键落在单数位置就不行，需要先经过几步反应：一个异构酶把这个双键的位置挪一挪，挪到可以用的位置上。
points.en: If it falls at an odd-numbered position it will not work, and a few extra steps are needed: an isomerase shifts the double bond to a usable position.

points.zh: 他说具体原理不用看，只需要知道有这么一个酶能把单数位置的双键变到双数位置，反应就能进一步进行下去。
points.en: He says the detailed mechanism can be skipped: it is enough to know that an enzyme moves an odd-position double bond to an even one so the reaction can proceed.

extra.zh: 「Omega-3、Omega-6 的三位六位都是奇数位」有两处问题：6 不是奇数；更要紧的是 ω 编号从甲基端数、Δ 编号从羧基端数，两套编号不能直接混用，而 β-氧化是从羧基端切的，只认 Δ 编号。以亚油酸 18:2（ω-6）为例，它的 Δ 编号是 Δ9,12，Δ12 恰好落在偶数位。他后面「奇数位需要异构酶、偶数位可直接走」的结论本身是对的，错的是把 ω 号当成了 Δ 号。
extra.en: Two problems with 'omega-3 and omega-6 are both at odd positions': six is not odd, and more importantly omega numbering counts from the methyl end while delta numbering counts from the carboxyl end. β-oxidation chews from the carboxyl end and recognizes only delta numbers. Linoleate 18:2 (omega-6) is Δ9,12 - and Δ12 is even. His conclusion, that odd positions need an isomerase and even positions do not, is itself right; what is wrong is reading omega numbers as delta numbers.

extra.zh: 真正需要的两个辅助酶要记住名字。一，烯脂酰CoA异构酶（enoyl-CoA isomerase）：把天然的顺式-Δ³-烯脂酰CoA 转成反式-Δ²-烯脂酰CoA，也就是水合酶认得的那个正常中间物——单不饱和脂肪酸（如油酸 18:1 Δ9，切三轮后变成顺式-Δ³）只需要这一个酶。二，2,4-二烯脂酰CoA还原酶：多不饱和脂肪酸（如亚油酸）会走出反式-Δ²、顺式-Δ⁴ 的共轭二烯，需要这个酶用 NADPH 把它还原成反式-Δ³，再交给异构酶转成反式-Δ²。
extra.en: Learn the names of the two auxiliary enzymes. First, enoyl-CoA isomerase: it converts the naturally occurring cis-Δ³-enoyl-CoA into trans-Δ²-enoyl-CoA, the normal intermediate the hydratase recognizes - a monounsaturated acid such as oleate (18:1 Δ9), which reaches cis-Δ³ after three rounds, needs only this enzyme. Second, 2,4-dienoyl-CoA reductase: polyunsaturated acids such as linoleate generate a conjugated trans-Δ², cis-Δ⁴ dienoyl-CoA, which this enzyme reduces with NADPH to trans-Δ³, handed on to the isomerase for conversion to trans-Δ².

extra.zh: 不饱和脂肪酸的产能略少，而且少得可以算出来：每绕开一次脂酰CoA脱氢酶那一步就少 1 个 FADH₂，即少 1.5 个 ATP（双键已经存在，不必再脱氢造）；走还原酶那条路还要额外花 1 个 NADPH。所以油酸 18:1 比硬脂酸 18:0 少约 1.5 个 ATP，亚油酸 18:2 再少一些。这个量级说明「不饱和脂肪酸人体不好降解、会堆积」是不成立的——它们只是多用两个酶，代谢通畅得很。
extra.en: Unsaturated fatty acids yield slightly less, and the shortfall is calculable: every acyl-CoA dehydrogenase step skipped costs one FADH2, i.e. 1.5 ATP, because the double bond is already there and need not be made; the reductase route additionally spends one NADPH. Oleate (18:1) therefore yields about 1.5 ATP less than stearate (18:0), and linoleate (18:2) a little less again. Losses of that size show that 'unsaturated fats are hard for the body to break down and accumulate' does not hold - they simply need two extra enzymes and are metabolized perfectly well.

extra.zh: 「奇偶」其实是一个推论，不必死记：β-氧化每轮把 Δ 编号往下拉 2，所以起始双键在奇数 Δ 位（如油酸的 Δ9）的，几轮后必然落到 Δ³，走异构酶那条；起始在偶数 Δ 位（如亚油酸的 Δ12）的，必然落到 Δ⁴，走还原酶那条。他讲的「偶数位可以直接进入 β-氧化」严格说指的是能被异构酶／还原酶送回反式-Δ² 的情形，真正能「不加任何辅助酶直接走」的只有反式-Δ² 本身。
extra.en: The odd/even rule is a consequence, not something to memorize: each round of β-oxidation lowers the delta number by two, so a double bond starting at an odd delta position (oleate's Δ9) inevitably lands on Δ³ and takes the isomerase route, while one starting at an even position (linoleate's Δ12) lands on Δ⁴ and takes the reductase route. His 'even positions go straight into β-oxidation' strictly means positions that can be returned to trans-Δ² by the isomerase or reductase; the only species that truly needs no auxiliary enzyme is trans-Δ² itself.

quiz.q_zh: 油酸 β-氧化几轮后出现的顺式-Δ³-烯脂酰CoA 靠什么继续往下走？
quiz.q_en: After several rounds, oleate gives cis-Δ³-enoyl-CoA. What lets β-oxidation continue?

options.zh: 烯脂酰CoA 异构酶，转成反式-Δ²-烯脂酰CoA
options.en: enoyl-CoA isomerase, converting it to trans-Δ²-enoyl-CoA

options.zh: 2,4-二烯脂酰CoA 还原酶，用 NADPH 还原
options.en: 2,4-dienoyl-CoA reductase, reducing the bond with NADPH

options.zh: 脂酰CoA 脱氢酶，用 FAD 把双键再脱一次氢
options.en: acyl-CoA dehydrogenase, using FAD to dehydrogenate again

options.zh: 烯脂酰CoA 水合酶，直接加水生成羟脂酰CoA
options.en: enoyl-CoA hydratase, adding water to give a hydroxyacyl-CoA

quiz.explain_zh: 水合酶只认反式-Δ²，所以先要靠烯脂酰CoA异构酶把顺式-Δ³ 挪成反式-Δ²。让水合酶直接对顺式-Δ³ 下手是不行的，构型和位置都不对；2,4-二烯脂酰CoA还原酶处理的是多不饱和链走出来的共轭二烯，单不饱和的油酸用不到；脂酰CoA脱氢酶的任务是造双键，这里双键已经存在。
quiz.explain_en: The hydratase accepts only trans-Δ², so enoyl-CoA isomerase must first shift cis-Δ³ to trans-Δ². Letting the hydratase act on cis-Δ³ directly fails on both geometry and position; 2,4-dienoyl-CoA reductase deals with the conjugated diene arising from polyunsaturated chains and is not needed for monounsaturated oleate; and acyl-CoA dehydrogenase exists to create a double bond, which is already present here.

quiz.q_zh: Δ 编号与 ω 编号的关系是什么？
quiz.q_en: How do delta numbering and omega numbering relate?

options.zh: ω 从甲基端数，Δ 从羧基端数，不能混用
options.en: omega counts from the methyl end, delta from the carboxyl end

options.zh: 两套都从甲基端数，ω 专用于必需脂肪酸
options.en: both count from the methyl end, omega for essential acids only

options.zh: 两套都从羧基端数，只是起点差一个碳
options.en: both count from the carboxyl end, offset by one carbon

options.zh: ω 从羧基端数，Δ 从甲基端数，可以互换
options.en: omega counts from the carboxyl end, delta from the methyl end

quiz.explain_zh: Δ 从羧基碳（C1）往甲基端数，ω 从甲基端往回数，换算关系是 ω 号 = 碳链总长 − Δ 号。β-氧化从羧基端切，只能用 Δ 号判断双键位置，所以把 ω-3、ω-6 当成 Δ3、Δ6 会得出错误的奇偶。说两套同端数或方向相反可互换，都会破坏这个换算；ω 编号也不是必需脂肪酸的专用记法。
quiz.explain_en: Delta counts from the carboxyl carbon (C1) towards the methyl end, omega counts back from the methyl end, and the conversion is omega number = chain length − delta number. Since β-oxidation cuts from the carboxyl end, only delta numbers say where a double bond sits, so reading omega-3 and omega-6 as Δ3 and Δ6 gives the wrong parity. Having both count from the same end, or swapping their directions as interchangeable, breaks the conversion, and omega numbering is not reserved for essential fatty acids.

title_zh: 奇数碳脂肪酸：三碳残余 → 琥珀酰CoA
title_en: Odd-chain fatty acids: the three-carbon remainder becomes succinyl-CoA

points.zh: 奇数碳的脂肪酸在 β-氧化的最后一步一定会产生一个三碳的 CoA 化合物——乙酰CoA 是两个碳，这个多出一个碳。
points.en: An odd-chain fatty acid inevitably ends its last round of β-oxidation with a three-carbon CoA compound - acetyl-CoA has two carbons, this one has three.

points.zh: 这个三碳化合物在一个羧化酶的作用下，在它的 α 位上加上一个羧基。
points.en: A carboxylase adds a carboxyl group to the α carbon of that three-carbon compound.

points.zh: 接着一个变位酶把刚加上的这个羧基挪到 β 位上。
points.en: A mutase then moves that newly added carboxyl group to the β carbon.

points.zh: 挪完之后这个分子就是琥珀酰CoA，它可以直接进入三羧酸循环。
points.en: Once moved, the molecule is succinyl-CoA and can enter the TCA cycle directly.

points.zh: 这就是奇数碳脂肪酸的处理方式：多出来的那三个碳不浪费，进 TCA。
points.en: That is how odd-chain fatty acids are handled: the extra three carbons are not wasted but go into the TCA cycle.

points.zh: 他说对人来说处理奇数碳比较难，人的这套酶好像相对来说比较少。
points.en: He says humans handle odd chains relatively poorly and seem to have fewer of these enzymes.

points.zh: 这条途径在植物和动物里发挥得更多，植物里还有别的酶可以把这个三碳化合物直接变成乙酰CoA。
points.en: The route matters more in plants and other animals, and plants have additional enzymes that convert the three-carbon compound straight to acetyl-CoA.

points.zh: 反刍动物特别是牛、羊这些食草动物，吃进很多含奇数碳的食物，主要靠这条途径重新产生琥珀酰CoA 进入 TCA 循环。
points.en: Ruminants, cattle and sheep especially, take in a great deal of odd-chain material and rely on this route to regenerate succinyl-CoA for the TCA cycle.

extra.zh: 完整机制是三个酶，中间那一步他完全没提：①丙酰CoA羧化酶（propionyl-CoA carboxylase，以生物素为辅基，耗 1 个 ATP，固定 1 个 CO₂）→ D-甲基丙二酰CoA；②甲基丙二酰CoA 消旋酶／差向异构酶 → L-甲基丙二酰CoA；③甲基丙二酰CoA 变位酶（methylmalonyl-CoA mutase，需要维生素 B₁₂ 的腺苷钴胺素形式）→ 琥珀酰CoA。漏掉的正是消旋酶那一步，而变位酶只认 L 型。
extra.en: The full mechanism has three enzymes, and he omits the middle one entirely: (1) propionyl-CoA carboxylase, a biotin enzyme spending one ATP to fix one CO2, giving D-methylmalonyl-CoA; (2) methylmalonyl-CoA epimerase (racemase), giving L-methylmalonyl-CoA; (3) methylmalonyl-CoA mutase, requiring the adenosylcobalamin form of vitamin B12, giving succinyl-CoA. The step left out is the epimerase, and the mutase accepts only the L isomer.

extra.zh: 变位酶做的不是「把羧基挪个位置」，而是把整个 —CO—S-CoA 硫酯基团在碳骨架上迁移的自由基重排（B₁₂ 的 Co—C 键均裂产生 5'-脱氧腺苷自由基来启动）。这两个辅因子是考点：生物素（羧化）和 B₁₂（变位）。临床上 B₁₂ 缺乏时甲基丙二酸在血、尿中蓄积，甲基丙二酸浓度是比 B₁₂ 血清浓度更敏感的功能性缺乏指标；先天性缺陷则表现为甲基丙二酸血症。
extra.en: The mutase does not simply relocate a carboxyl: it performs a radical rearrangement that migrates the whole −CO−S-CoA thioester group along the carbon skeleton, initiated by homolysis of the B12 Co−C bond to a 5'-deoxyadenosyl radical. Both cofactors are exam material: biotin for the carboxylation, B12 for the mutase. Clinically, B12 deficiency causes methylmalonic acid to accumulate in blood and urine, and methylmalonic acid is a more sensitive marker of functional deficiency than serum B12; an inherited defect presents as methylmalonic acidemia.

extra.zh: 琥珀酰CoA 进 TCA 是回补反应（anaplerotic），不是单纯供能：它补的是四碳骨架，可以经苹果酸出线粒体进入糖异生。所以奇数碳脂肪酸末端那三个碳是脂肪酸里少数能「生糖」的碳；偶数碳脂肪酸产生的乙酰CoA 则不能净合成葡萄糖（进 TCA 后两个碳以 CO₂ 形式丢掉）。这正是「脂肪不能变糖、但甘油和丙酰CoA 可以」的完整说法。
extra.en: Succinyl-CoA entering the TCA cycle is anaplerotic, not merely energy-yielding: it replenishes a four-carbon skeleton that can leave as malate and feed gluconeogenesis. The final three carbons of an odd-chain fatty acid are therefore among the few fatty acid carbons that are glucogenic, whereas the acetyl-CoA from even chains cannot give net glucose, since both carbons are lost as CO2 in the cycle. This is the precise form of the rule that fat cannot become sugar - except for glycerol and propionyl-CoA.

extra.zh: 反刍动物那一段有具体机制：瘤胃细菌发酵纤维素产生的短链脂肪酸以乙酸、丙酸、丁酸为主，其中丙酸经丙酰CoA → 琥珀酰CoA 进入糖异生，是反刍动物血糖的主要来源（牛几乎不从饲料里直接吸收葡萄糖）。这就是为什么这条途径在食草动物里比在人体里重要得多。另外他在举奇数碳例子时说的「15 个碳、14 个碳、13 个碳、11 个碳」里，14 是偶数，不属于奇数碳脂肪酸，其余三个是对的。
extra.en: The ruminant remark has a concrete mechanism behind it: rumen bacteria fermenting cellulose produce mainly acetate, propionate and butyrate, and propionate travels propionyl-CoA → succinyl-CoA into gluconeogenesis, providing most of a ruminant's blood glucose - cattle absorb almost no dietary glucose directly. That is why this pathway matters far more in herbivores than in humans. Note also that in his list of odd-chain examples - 15, 14, 13 and 11 carbons - 14 is even and does not belong; the other three are right.

quiz.q_zh: 丙酰CoA 转变为琥珀酰CoA 需要哪两个辅因子？
quiz.q_en: Which two cofactors does the conversion of propionyl-CoA to succinyl-CoA require?

options.zh: 泛酸与烟酰胺（NAD⁺ 的前体）
options.en: pantothenate and niacin (the NAD+ precursor)

options.zh: 生物素与腺苷钴胺素（B₁₂）
options.en: biotin and adenosylcobalamin, i.e. vitamin B12

options.zh: 硫胺素焦磷酸（TPP）与硫辛酸
options.en: thiamine pyrophosphate (TPP) and lipoic acid

options.zh: 叶酸与吡哆醛磷酸（维生素 B₆）
options.en: folate and pyridoxal phosphate (vitamin B6)

quiz.explain_zh: 羧化那一步由丙酰CoA羧化酶完成，以生物素为羧基载体；变位那一步由甲基丙二酰CoA变位酶完成，需要 B₁₂ 的腺苷钴胺素形式。TPP 和硫辛酸是丙酮酸脱氢酶和 α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶复合体的辅因子；叶酸和 B₆ 分别管一碳单位转移和转氨基；泛酸是 CoA 本身的组成部分、烟酰胺构成 NAD⁺，都不参与这两步催化。
quiz.explain_en: The carboxylation is done by propionyl-CoA carboxylase with biotin as the carboxyl carrier, and the rearrangement by methylmalonyl-CoA mutase, which needs the adenosylcobalamin form of B12. TPP and lipoate serve the pyruvate and α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase complexes; folate and B6 handle one-carbon transfer and transamination respectively; pantothenate is part of CoA itself and niacin builds NAD+, and none of these catalyse these two steps.

quiz.q_zh: 为什么说奇数碳脂肪酸有一部分碳是「生糖」的？
quiz.q_en: Why are some carbons of an odd-chain fatty acid described as glucogenic?

options.zh: 水解出的甘油被磷酸化后进入糖异生途径
options.en: the glycerol released is phosphorylated into gluconeogenesis

options.zh: 乙酰CoA 也可以净合成葡萄糖，只是效率低
options.en: acetyl-CoA can give net glucose too, just inefficiently

options.zh: 丙酰CoA 变琥珀酰CoA，四碳骨架进糖异生
options.en: propionyl-CoA becomes succinyl-CoA, a four-carbon skeleton

options.zh: 丙酰CoA 脱羧后可以直接进入糖异生途径
options.en: propionyl-CoA is decarboxylated straight into gluconeogenesis

quiz.explain_zh: 末端的丙酰CoA 经羧化和变位变成琥珀酰CoA，这是一个四碳骨架，可经苹果酸出线粒体进糖异生。乙酰CoA 进 TCA 后两个碳以 CO₂ 丢掉，不能净生成葡萄糖；丙酰CoA 走的是羧化而不是脱羧，方向刚好相反；甘油确实能生糖，但那是甘油三酯里甘油骨架的贡献，与奇数碳脂肪酸这条链无关。
quiz.explain_en: The terminal propionyl-CoA is carboxylated and rearranged to succinyl-CoA, a four-carbon skeleton that can leave as malate and feed gluconeogenesis. Acetyl-CoA loses both carbons as CO2 in the cycle and gives no net glucose; propionyl-CoA is carboxylated rather than decarboxylated, the opposite direction; and glycerol is indeed glucogenic, but it comes from the glycerol backbone of the triacylglycerol, not from the odd-chain fatty acid itself.

quiz.q_zh: 老师说「羧化后由变位酶把羧基挪到 β 位」，中间漏掉了哪一步？
quiz.q_en: He says carboxylation is followed by a mutase moving the carboxyl to the β carbon. Which step is missing?

options.zh: 一步水合酶把丙烯酰CoA 变羟基丙酰CoA
options.en: a hydratase adding water to give hydroxypropionyl-CoA

options.zh: 一步消旋酶把 D-甲基丙二酰CoA 变成 L 型
options.en: an epimerase turning D-methylmalonyl-CoA into the L form

options.zh: 一步脱氢酶把丙酰CoA 氧化成丙烯酰CoA
options.en: a dehydrogenase oxidizing propionyl-CoA to acryloyl-CoA

options.zh: 一步硫解酶把丙酰CoA 切成乙酰CoA 和甲酸
options.en: a thiolase cleaving propionyl-CoA to acetyl-CoA and formate

quiz.explain_zh: 羧化酶的产物是 D-甲基丙二酰CoA，而变位酶只接受 L 型，所以中间必须有甲基丙二酰CoA 消旋酶（差向异构酶）把构型翻过来。丙酰CoA 在这条通路里不脱氢生成丙烯酰CoA（那是细菌的另一条丙酸代谢路线），也不会被硫解成两个更小的片段；此时分子上没有双键，水合酶无从下手。
quiz.explain_en: The carboxylase gives D-methylmalonyl-CoA while the mutase accepts only the L isomer, so methylmalonyl-CoA epimerase must invert the configuration in between. Propionyl-CoA is not dehydrogenated to acryloyl-CoA on this route (that is a separate bacterial propionate pathway) and is not cleaved into smaller fragments; and with no double bond present there is nothing for a hydratase to act on.

title_zh: 特殊的氧化方式：α-氧化与 ω-氧化
title_en: The special oxidations: alpha and omega

points.zh: 前面讲的一直是 β-氧化，之所以叫 β，是因为氧化发生在 β 位——在 β 碳上装一个羰基，从那里断开。
points.en: Everything so far has been β-oxidation, so called because the oxidation happens at the β carbon: a carbonyl is installed there and the chain is cut at that point.

points.zh: α-氧化则是在 α 位上加一个羟基，形成 α 位带羟基的那样一个分子。
points.en: α-oxidation instead puts a hydroxyl on the α carbon, giving an α-hydroxy species.

points.zh: 这个分子会直接脱去一分子二氧化碳，把最边上的那个羧基整个脱掉。
points.en: That molecule then loses one molecule of carbon dioxide, taking off the terminal carboxyl entirely.

points.zh: 所以 α-氧化等于是一种「产气」的氧化方式，每处理一个碳就放出一分子 CO₂。
points.en: α-oxidation is therefore a gas-producing form of oxidation, releasing one CO2 for each carbon processed.

points.zh: 他说这个东西在人体内基本不存在，只在一些微生物里被利用，特别是食腐的生物用它来消耗动物尸体里的脂肪。
points.en: He says it essentially does not exist in humans and is used only by some microbes, especially scavengers consuming the fat in animal carcasses.

points.zh: 他举鲸落为例：鲸体内有很多很多脂肪、很多不饱和脂肪，鲸死后会发生大量 α-氧化和不饱和脂肪酸氧化，产生大量二氧化碳气体，最后鲸会被从体内撑开、直接炸开。
points.en: His example is the whale fall: whales carry a great deal of fat, much of it unsaturated; after death, extensive α-oxidation and unsaturated fatty acid oxidation generate large amounts of CO2, which distends the carcass from within until it bursts.

points.zh: ω-氧化里的 Omega 指的是氧化的方向：β-氧化是从靠近羧基端（Δ² 那一端）开始的，在图上是从右端往左氧化。
points.en: The omega in ω-oxidation refers to direction: β-oxidation starts near the carboxyl end (the Δ² end), working right to left on his drawing.

points.zh: ω-氧化则从烷基链那一端开始一步一步地氧化，见于一些降解石油的微生物。
points.en: ω-oxidation starts at the alkyl end and works stepwise from there; it occurs in some petroleum-degrading microbes.

points.zh: 他总结：这些是几种特殊的脂肪酸处理方式，但人体主要还是以 β-氧化为主，那四步反应牢牢记住就 OK，是脂肪酸这一章最重要的内容。
points.en: He concludes that these are special-case routes, that the human body runs mainly on β-oxidation, and that the four steps are the one thing to hold on to from this chapter.

extra.zh: α-氧化在人体内确实存在，而且有明确的临床意义。它发生在过氧化物酶体（peroxisome），专门处理 β 碳上带甲基、因而无法直接进行 β-氧化的支链脂肪酸——最典型的是植烷酸（phytanic acid，来自反刍动物脂肪和乳制品，是叶绿素侧链植醇的代谢产物）。α-氧化先切掉一个碳生成降植烷酸，把甲基从 β 位挪到 α 位，之后就能正常走 β-氧化。这条通路缺陷就是 Refsum 病（植烷酸贮积症），表现为视网膜色素变性、周围神经病和小脑共济失调，治疗靠限制植烷酸摄入。所以不是「人体基本不存在」，而是一条小而明确的通路。
extra.en: α-oxidation does exist in humans and has a definite clinical role. It runs in peroxisomes and handles branched fatty acids that carry a methyl group on the β carbon and so cannot undergo β-oxidation - the classic case being phytanic acid, derived from the phytol side chain of chlorophyll and reaching us through ruminant fat and dairy. α-oxidation removes one carbon to give pristanic acid, moving the methyl group from the β to the α position, after which normal β-oxidation proceeds. A defect in this pathway is Refsum disease (phytanic acid storage disease), presenting with retinitis pigmentosa, peripheral neuropathy and cerebellar ataxia, and treated by dietary restriction of phytanic acid. So it is not absent from humans, just small and specific.

extra.zh: 鲸尸胀气爆裂的气体主要来自厌氧细菌腐败产生的甲烷、硫化氢、氨和 CO₂，不是鲸自身脂肪酸 α-氧化的产物——个体死亡后细胞内的酶促代谢很快就停了，没有 ATP 和辅酶再生，跑不动这些反应。另外「鲸落 whale fall」在海洋生态学里指的是鲸尸沉入深海形成的、可维持数十年的化能生态系统，与新闻里那种搁浅鲸尸在岸上爆炸不是同一件事，两个概念被合在一起讲了。
