quiz.explain_en: Ubiquitin is a 76-residue protein of roughly 8 kD with a highly conserved sequence. A 129-residue, 14 kD hydrolase describes lysozyme; a 51-residue two-chain hormone describes insulin; a 21-residue membrane-anchored signal peptide has nothing to do with ubiquitin, which is soluble and attaches covalently to substrates.

title_zh: 泛素途径：多泛素标记与 E1 / E2 / E3
title_en: The ubiquitin pathway: polyubiquitin tagging and E1 / E2 / E3

points.zh: 泛素与底物蛋白赖氨酸侧链上的 ε-氨基形成异肽键，是一种共价结合
points.en: Ubiquitin forms an isopeptide bond with the epsilon-amino group on a substrate lysine side chain, a covalent attachment.

points.zh: 当一个蛋白被机体识别为已经 dysfunction、没有功能了，就会通过泛素途径被挂上泛素
points.en: When a protein is recognised as dysfunctional and no longer useful, the ubiquitin pathway tags it with ubiquitin.

points.zh: 一旦挂上了一个泛素，后面的泛素会继续加到这个泛素上，形成一串
points.en: Once the first ubiquitin is attached, further ubiquitins are added onto that ubiquitin, building a chain.

points.zh: 这一串泛素相当于给不想要的蛋白质做了一个 tag（标签）
points.en: That chain amounts to a tag placed on the unwanted protein.

points.zh: 他说这些 tag 是由 E1「泛素连接酶」加上去的
points.en: He said the tags are added by E1, which he called the ubiquitin ligase.

points.zh: 他说挂了好几个 tag 之后，这个蛋白会被 E2 识别——E2 专门识别连了很多泛素的蛋白
points.en: He said that after several tags the protein is recognised by E2, which he described as recognising heavily ubiquitinated proteins.

points.zh: 他说 E2 把这一坨连了很多泛素的蛋白转移到 E3 上
points.en: He said E2 then transfers the heavily ubiquitinated protein onto E3.

points.zh: 他说 E3 是最终介导蛋白质降解的蛋白，发挥「溶酶体的功能」把它降解掉
points.en: He said E3 is the protein that finally mediates degradation, performing what he called the lysosome's function.

points.zh: 他把这条通路作为一个「小途径」简单提及，说它是近年比较火的方向
points.en: He presented the pathway briefly as a side topic, noting it is a currently fashionable area.

extra.zh: E1 / E2 / E3 的分工讲反了，而且他没有自我更正。正确是：E1 是泛素活化酶，耗 ATP 把泛素腺苷酰化后以硫酯键挂到自己的 Cys 上；E2 是泛素结合酶，只是载体；E3 才是泛素连接酶，由它识别底物、决定特异性，把泛素转到底物的赖氨酸上。人体 E1 只有两种、E2 几十种、E3 上百种，特异性正是由数量最多的 E3 提供的。
extra.en: The E1/E2/E3 division of labour is reversed, and he never corrects it. Correctly: E1 is the ubiquitin-activating enzyme, using ATP to adenylate ubiquitin and hold it as a thioester on its own cysteine; E2 is the conjugating enzyme, a carrier; E3 is the ligase that recognises the substrate, sets specificity and transfers ubiquitin onto the substrate lysine. Humans have two E1s, dozens of E2s and hundreds of E3s, and specificity comes from the most numerous class.

extra.zh: 他把这条通路的终点说成溶酶体。正确是蛋白酶体 proteasome：经典的 K48 多泛素链由 26S 蛋白酶体的 19S 调节颗粒识别，耗 ATP 把底物去折叠、抽进 20S 核心颗粒水解成短肽，泛素被回收。溶酶体与蛋白酶体是他自己在前一段并列讲过的两条不同途径，这里混起来了，同样没有更正。
extra.en: He gives the lysosome as the endpoint of this pathway. It is the proteasome: a classic K48-linked chain is recognised by the 19S regulatory particle of the 26S proteasome, which uses ATP to unfold the substrate and thread it into the 20S core for hydrolysis to short peptides, while ubiquitin is recycled. Lysosome and proteasome are the two separate routes he himself listed side by side a moment earlier. Not corrected.

extra.zh: 泛素 C 端 Gly76 的羧基与底物赖氨酸的 ε-氨基成键，叫「异肽键」正是因为参与的不是主链 α-氨基。链的连接方式决定命运：K48 链送去降解，K63 链多参与信号转导和 DNA 损伤应答，单泛素化常调控内吞和膜运输。所以泛素化不等于「判死刑」。
extra.en: The bond forms between the carboxyl of ubiquitin's C-terminal Gly76 and the epsilon-amino group of a substrate lysine; it is called an isopeptide bond precisely because the backbone alpha-amino group is not involved. Linkage type sets the fate: K48 chains route to degradation, K63 chains mostly signal in transduction and DNA damage responses, and monoubiquitination often regulates endocytosis and trafficking. Ubiquitination is not automatically a death sentence.

extra.zh: 2004 年的奖是诺贝尔化学奖，授予 Ciechanover、Hershko 和 Rose，表彰「泛素介导的蛋白质降解」的发现。临床上这条通路是真实药靶：蛋白酶体抑制剂硼替佐米 bortezomib 用于多发性骨髓瘤，近年的 PROTAC 分子则是人为把目标蛋白拉到 E3 上强行降解。
extra.en: The 2004 prize was in chemistry, to Ciechanover, Hershko and Rose, for the discovery of ubiquitin-mediated protein degradation. The pathway is a real drug target: the proteasome inhibitor bortezomib is used in multiple myeloma, and PROTAC molecules deliberately recruit a target protein to an E3 to force its degradation.

quiz.q_zh: 泛素化系统中，识别底物、决定特异性并把泛素交到底物赖氨酸上的是哪个酶？
quiz.q_en: In the ubiquitin system, which enzyme recognises the substrate, sets specificity and delivers ubiquitin to the substrate lysine?

options.zh: E3 泛素连接酶，识别底物并转移泛素
options.en: E3, the ligase, which picks the substrate lysine

options.zh: E2 泛素结合酶，作为活化泛素的载体
options.en: E2, the conjugating enzyme, carrying ubiquitin

options.zh: 19S 调节颗粒，去折叠后送入核心颗粒
options.en: The 19S particle, which unfolds the substrate

options.zh: E1 泛素活化酶，耗 ATP 活化泛素分子
options.en: E1, the activating enzyme, spending ATP on ubiquitin

quiz.explain_zh: E3 泛素连接酶是决定特异性的一环，人体内 E3 有上百种，正对应形形色色的底物。E1 只负责耗 ATP 活化泛素并把它挂在自己的半胱氨酸上；E2 只是把活化的泛素带过去的载体；19S 调节颗粒属于蛋白酶体，在泛素链已经装好之后才负责识别与去折叠。课上把这三者的分工说反了。
quiz.explain_en: The E3 ligase is where specificity lives, which is why humans have hundreds of them for the variety of substrates. E1 only spends ATP to activate ubiquitin and hold it on its own cysteine; E2 is merely the carrier that brings activated ubiquitin over; the 19S particle belongs to the proteasome and acts after the chain is already built, recognising and unfolding the substrate. The lecture reversed these roles.

quiz.q_zh: 挂上 K48 多泛素链的蛋白质最终在哪里被水解？
quiz.q_en: Where is a protein carrying a K48-linked polyubiquitin chain finally hydrolysed?

options.zh: 在线粒体基质由 Lon 蛋白酶降解
options.en: In the matrix, by the Lon protease

options.zh: 在溶酶体腔内由酸性组织蛋白酶水解
options.en: In the lysosome, by acidic cathepsins

options.zh: 在内质网腔由分子伴侣复合体降解
options.en: In the ER lumen, by chaperone complexes

options.zh: 在 26S 蛋白酶体的核心颗粒内水解
options.en: In the 20S core of the 26S proteasome

quiz.explain_zh: K48 链的去向是 26S 蛋白酶体：19S 帽识别泛素链并耗 ATP 把底物去折叠，20S 核心颗粒里的蛋白酶活性位点把它切成短肽。溶酶体的酸性组织蛋白酶走的是另一条并行途径（自噬、内吞的底物）；内质网里的分子伴侣负责折叠与质控，本身不做终末水解，错误折叠蛋白还要经 ERAD 逆向转运出去交给蛋白酶体；线粒体 Lon 蛋白酶只处理基质内的蛋白，与胞质的泛素化底物无关。课上把终点说成了溶酶体。
quiz.explain_en: K48 chains route to the 26S proteasome: the 19S cap recognises the chain and uses ATP to unfold the substrate, and the protease sites inside the 20S core cut it into short peptides. Lysosomal cathepsins serve a parallel route for autophagic and endocytosed cargo. ER chaperones handle folding and quality control rather than terminal hydrolysis; misfolded proteins there are retrotranslocated by ERAD and handed to the proteasome anyway. The mitochondrial Lon protease acts only on matrix proteins, not on cytosolic ubiquitinated ones. The lecture named the lysosome by mistake.

title_zh: 氨基酸分解代谢的去向，与「先脱氨基」的总纲
title_en: What amino acid catabolism is for, and the master plan of removing the amino group first

points.zh: 蛋白质很少很少拿来供能，他举的例子是地震被压在房子下面 30 天只能喝水，才会降解蛋白供能
points.en: Protein is very rarely used as fuel; his example was being trapped under a collapsed building for 30 days with only water, when protein would finally be broken down for energy.

points.zh: 氨基酸的主要去向是重新合成蛋白质，或者合成其他的物质
points.en: The main fate of amino acids is resynthesis into protein, or synthesis of other compounds.

points.zh: 他举琥珀酸、琥珀酰 CoA 为例，说它和天冬氨酸「长得很像」，是天冬氨酸的衍生物
points.en: He used succinate and succinyl-CoA as an example, saying it looks very like aspartate and is a derivative of it.

points.zh: 他说当 TCA 循环里的琥珀酰 CoA 比较少的时候，天冬氨酸可以经一些途径补进 TCA 循环
points.en: He said that when succinyl-CoA runs low in the TCA cycle, aspartate can be routed in to top the cycle up.

points.zh: 被彻底氧化、纯粹发挥供能作用，是氨基酸最少见的去路
points.en: Complete oxidation purely for energy is the least common fate of amino acids.

points.zh: 氨基酸代谢的总纲：先把最有特征的氨基脱掉
points.en: The master plan of amino acid metabolism: first strip off the amino group, the amino acid's defining feature.

points.zh: 脱掉氨基以后只剩一个含羧基的碳骨架
points.en: Once the amino group is gone, only a carboxyl-bearing carbon skeleton is left.

points.zh: 这个碳骨架可以经加水、脱氢、加氧这类过程，很轻易地转变成其他中间体
points.en: That skeleton is easily converted into other intermediates by hydration, dehydrogenation or oxygenation.

points.zh: 脱氨基主要有四种途径，这节课的目标就是把「氨基怎么脱」讲完
points.en: There are four main routes for removing the amino group, and finishing them was the goal for this session.

extra.zh: 琥珀酰 CoA 不是天冬氨酸的衍生物。天冬氨酸转氨后直接对应的碳骨架是草酰乙酸（Asp + α-酮戊二酸 ⇌ 草酰乙酸 + Glu）；在尿素循环和嘌呤核苷酸循环里，天冬氨酸给出氨基后留下的是延胡索酸。琥珀酰 CoA 是甲硫氨酸、苏氨酸、异亮氨酸、缬氨酸的降解终点，也是奇数碳脂肪酸经丙酰 CoA 的去处。两者都是四碳二羧酸骨架，「长得像」是对的，代谢关系不是。
extra.en: Succinyl-CoA is not a derivative of aspartate. Transamination of aspartate gives oxaloacetate directly (Asp + alpha-ketoglutarate to OAA + Glu), and in the urea cycle and purine nucleotide cycle aspartate donates its amino group and leaves fumarate behind. Succinyl-CoA is the degradation endpoint of methionine, threonine, isoleucine and valine, and the entry point for odd-chain fatty acids via propionyl-CoA. Both are four-carbon diacid skeletons, so they do look alike, but the metabolic relationship he stated is wrong.

extra.zh: 碳骨架的分类是标准考点：生糖氨基酸的碳骨架进入丙酮酸、α-酮戊二酸、琥珀酰 CoA、延胡索酸或草酰乙酸这五个位点，可用于糖异生；生酮氨基酸的碳骨架进入乙酰 CoA 或乙酰乙酰 CoA，不能净合成葡萄糖。纯生酮的只有亮氨酸和赖氨酸，苯丙氨酸、酪氨酸、色氨酸、异亮氨酸、苏氨酸兼具，其余都是生糖的。
extra.en: Classifying the carbon skeleton is a standard exam point: glucogenic amino acids feed into pyruvate, alpha-ketoglutarate, succinyl-CoA, fumarate or oxaloacetate and can support gluconeogenesis; ketogenic ones feed into acetyl-CoA or acetoacetyl-CoA and cannot yield net glucose. Only leucine and lysine are purely ketogenic; phenylalanine, tyrosine, tryptophan, isoleucine and threonine are both; the rest are glucogenic.

extra.zh: 「蛋白质基本上不供能」讲的是它不是首选燃料，但份额不是零。空腹和长期饥饿时，肌肉蛋白降解出的丙氨酸和谷氨酰胺是肝脏糖异生的主要氮源与碳源；这也是为什么长期饥饿会掉肌肉，而不是只掉脂肪。
extra.en: Saying protein essentially never fuels the body captures that it is not the preferred fuel, but its share is not zero. In fasting and prolonged starvation the alanine and glutamine released from muscle protein are the main nitrogen and carbon supply for hepatic gluconeogenesis, which is why prolonged starvation costs muscle and not only fat.

extra.zh: 「脱氨基」与「脱羧基」是两件不同的事：脱氨基取走 α-氨基，留下 α-酮酸，碳骨架进能量代谢；脱羧基取走羧基，留下胺，产物是组胺、GABA、5-羟色胺这类活性物质。课上把后者也塞进了「四种脱氨途径」里（02:10:04 之后），名字对错了位，先在这里记住这个分界。
extra.en: Deamination and decarboxylation are different reactions: deamination removes the alpha-amino group and leaves an alpha-keto acid whose skeleton enters energy metabolism, whereas decarboxylation removes the carboxyl group and leaves an amine such as histamine, GABA or serotonin. The lecture files the second one under its four deamination routes (from 02:10:04 on), which misapplies the name; fix the boundary here.

quiz.q_zh: 氨基酸脱去氨基以后，剩下的碳骨架属于哪一类化合物？
quiz.q_en: After an amino acid loses its amino group, what class of compound is the remaining carbon skeleton?

options.zh: 脂酰 CoA，直接进入线粒体 β-氧化
options.en: An acyl-CoA, entering beta-oxidation directly

options.zh: α-羟基醛，磷酸化后进入磷酸戊糖途径
options.en: An alpha-hydroxy aldehyde, entering the PPP

options.zh: α-酮酸，可经加水脱氢进入中间代谢
options.en: An alpha-keto acid, ready for the TCA pool

options.zh: β-氨基酸，需再次转氨才能被利用
options.en: A beta-amino acid, needing another transamination

quiz.explain_zh: 脱氨后留下的是 α-酮酸，例如谷氨酸对应 α-酮戊二酸、丙氨酸对应丙酮酸、天冬氨酸对应草酰乙酸，正是它们可以经加水、脱氢进入 TCA 循环或糖异生。β-氨基酸不是标准蛋白质氨基酸的降解产物；脂酰 CoA 是脂肪酸活化的产物，与氨基酸碳骨架无关；α-羟基醛也不是脱氨的产物，磷酸戊糖途径的底物是 6-磷酸葡萄糖。
quiz.explain_en: Deamination leaves an alpha-keto acid: glutamate gives alpha-ketoglutarate, alanine gives pyruvate, aspartate gives oxaloacetate, and these enter the TCA cycle or gluconeogenesis after hydration or dehydrogenation. Beta-amino acids are not products of standard amino acid breakdown; acyl-CoA comes from fatty acid activation and has nothing to do with amino acid skeletons; an alpha-hydroxy aldehyde is not a deamination product, and the pentose phosphate pathway starts from glucose-6-phosphate.

quiz.q_zh: 琥珀酰 CoA 在氨基酸降解中的来源，正确的是？
quiz.q_en: Where does succinyl-CoA come from in amino acid degradation?

options.zh: 由天冬氨酸直接脱氨后衍生而来
options.en: Directly from aspartate after deamination

options.zh: 由甲硫氨酸、苏氨酸、缬氨酸降解而来
options.en: From methionine, threonine and valine breakdown

options.zh: 由亮氨酸和赖氨酸经生酮途径产生
options.en: From leucine and lysine by the ketogenic route

options.zh: 由谷氨酸经谷氨酸脱氢酶氧化产生
options.en: From glutamate oxidised by its dehydrogenase

quiz.explain_zh: 琥珀酰 CoA 是甲硫氨酸、苏氨酸、异亮氨酸、缬氨酸的降解终点（也是奇数碳脂肪酸经丙酰 CoA 的入口）。天冬氨酸脱氨得到的是草酰乙酸，不是琥珀酰 CoA——这正是课上说反的地方；亮氨酸和赖氨酸是纯生酮氨基酸，碳骨架进乙酰 CoA 与乙酰乙酰 CoA；谷氨酸经谷氨酸脱氢酶氧化得到的是 α-酮戊二酸。
quiz.explain_en: Succinyl-CoA is the degradation endpoint of methionine, threonine, isoleucine and valine, and also the entry point for odd-chain fatty acids via propionyl-CoA. Aspartate deamination gives oxaloacetate rather than succinyl-CoA, which is exactly the point the lecture inverted. Leucine and lysine are purely ketogenic and feed acetyl-CoA and acetoacetyl-CoA. Glutamate oxidised by glutamate dehydrogenase gives alpha-ketoglutarate.

title_zh: 转氨基作用：PLP 辅基，与谷氨酸／α-酮戊二酸这个核心
title_en: Transamination: the PLP cofactor and the glutamate / alpha-ketoglutarate hub

points.zh: 转氨基是人体内最常见的脱氨方式，人体有很多转氨酶，特别是在肝脏里
points.en: Transamination is the commonest way the body handles amino groups; there are many aminotransferases, especially in liver.

points.zh: 反应的一方是带 R2 基团、不带氨基的酮（α-酮酸），另一方是一个正常的氨基酸（R1）
points.en: One partner is a keto compound carrying an R2 group and no amino group; the other is an ordinary amino acid (R1).

points.zh: 转氨酶以 PLP 为辅基，PLP 就是维生素 B6 的形式
points.en: The aminotransferase uses PLP as its prosthetic group, PLP being the vitamin B6 form.

points.zh: 结果是把氨基从正常氨基酸上转移到那个酮上，生成一个脱去氨基的产物和一个新氨基酸
points.en: The amino group is moved from the ordinary amino acid onto the keto compound, giving a deaminated product and a new amino acid.

points.zh: 接受氨基的主要是谷氨酸，少数是天冬氨酸
points.en: The acceptor is mostly glutamate, occasionally aspartate.

points.zh: 之所以是这几个：谷氨酸脱去一分子氨基就变成 α-酮戊二酸
points.en: The reason is the pairing itself: glutamate losing one amino group becomes alpha-ketoglutarate.

points.zh: α-酮戊二酸可以进入 TCA 循环，所以这个受体能够被源源不断地消耗掉
points.en: Alpha-ketoglutarate can enter the TCA cycle, so this acceptor is drained continuously.

points.zh: 普通的氨基酸没办法被源源不断地消耗，所以不适合充当氨基的中转站
points.en: An ordinary amino acid cannot be consumed continuously, so it makes a poor relay point for amino groups.

points.zh: 结论：人体内最常见的转氨基，是以谷氨酸、天冬氨酸和 α-酮戊二酸为核心的一套体系
points.en: Conclusion: the commonest transamination in the body is organised around glutamate, aspartate and alpha-ketoglutarate.

extra.zh: 在 02:01:34 前后他顺口说成「它接受了氨基以后它变成 α-酮戊二酸」，方向反了。他在此之前（约 02:00:59–02:01:20）已经讲对过：α-酮戊二酸接受氨基生成谷氨酸，谷氨酸脱去氨基才变回 α-酮戊二酸。按讲对的那一遍记。
extra.en: Around 02:01:34 he slips and says the acceptor becomes alpha-ketoglutarate after taking on the amino group, which is backwards. He had already stated it correctly just before, around 02:00:59-02:01:20: alpha-ketoglutarate accepts the amino group to become glutamate, and glutamate losing it turns back into alpha-ketoglutarate. Keep the correct version.

extra.zh: 转氨的机制是乒乓 Bi-Bi：PLP 的醛基先与酶活性中心赖氨酸形成内部醛亚胺（Schiff 碱），底物氨基酸置换进来成外部醛亚胺，经醌型中间体转成酮亚胺，水解后放出 α-酮酸，此时辅基已变成磷酸吡哆胺 PMP；PMP 再把氨基交给第二个 α-酮酸，辅基复原。关键结论：整个过程不放出游离氨。
extra.en: The mechanism is ping-pong Bi-Bi: the PLP aldehyde first forms an internal aldimine (Schiff base) with an active-site lysine, the substrate amino acid displaces it to give an external aldimine, a quinonoid intermediate converts this to a ketimine, and hydrolysis releases the alpha-keto acid leaving the cofactor as pyridoxamine phosphate (PMP); PMP then hands the amino group to a second alpha-keto acid and PLP is regenerated. The key consequence is that no free ammonia is released.

extra.zh: 转氨反应的 ΔG°′ 接近 0，平衡常数约等于 1，方向完全由两侧底物与产物的浓度决定。这就是同一个酶既能用于氨基酸降解、又能用于非必需氨基酸合成的原因，也是为什么必需氨基酸的「必需」在于碳骨架而不在于氨基。
extra.en: Transamination has a standard free energy change near zero and an equilibrium constant close to one, so direction is set entirely by the concentrations on each side. That is why one enzyme serves both amino acid degradation and non-essential amino acid synthesis, and why the essential amino acids are essential for their carbon skeletons rather than their amino groups.

extra.zh: 转氨基本身不脱氮，氮只是从一个碳骨架搬到另一个碳骨架上，机体的总氮量没变。真正把氮变成游离氨的是随后谷氨酸脱氢酶催化的氧化脱氨。转氨基把全身氨基酸的氨基集中到谷氨酸这一个分子上，谷氨酸脱氢酶再把它放出来——这个「集中 + 释放」的分工，才是氨基氮汇入尿素循环的主漏斗。
extra.en: Transamination removes no nitrogen at all; the nitrogen simply moves from one carbon skeleton to another and the body's total is unchanged. What actually liberates it as free ammonia is the subsequent oxidative deamination by glutamate dehydrogenase. Transamination funnels amino groups from all amino acids onto the single molecule glutamate, and glutamate dehydrogenase then releases them; that collect-then-release division of labour is the main funnel carrying amino nitrogen into the urea cycle.

quiz.q_zh: 转氨酶的辅基是什么，来自哪一种维生素？
quiz.q_en: What prosthetic group do aminotransferases use, and which vitamin supplies it?

options.zh: 腺苷钴胺素辅酶，来自维生素 B12
options.en: Adenosylcobalamin, from vitamin B12

options.zh: 磷酸吡哆醛 PLP，来自维生素 B6
options.en: Pyridoxal phosphate, from vitamin B6

options.zh: 焦磷酸硫胺素 TPP，来自维生素 B1
options.en: Thiamine pyrophosphate, from vitamin B1

options.zh: 生物素 biotin，来自维生素 B7
options.en: Biotin, the carboxylase group from B7

quiz.explain_zh: 转氨酶的辅基是磷酸吡哆醛 PLP，由维生素 B6 转化而来，它以 Schiff 碱形式暂时承接氨基。焦磷酸硫胺素是丙酮酸脱氢酶、α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶和转酮酶的辅酶；生物素是羧化酶（丙酮酸羧化酶、乙酰 CoA 羧化酶）的辅基，管的是加羧基；腺苷钴胺素是甲基丙二酰 CoA 变位酶的辅酶，管碳骨架重排。
quiz.explain_en: Aminotransferases use pyridoxal phosphate, derived from vitamin B6, which holds the amino group transiently as a Schiff base. Thiamine pyrophosphate serves pyruvate dehydrogenase, alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase and transketolase. Biotin is the prosthetic group of carboxylases such as pyruvate carboxylase and acetyl-CoA carboxylase, and handles carboxyl addition. Adenosylcobalamin serves methylmalonyl-CoA mutase and handles skeletal rearrangement.

quiz.q_zh: 为什么氨基主要转给 α-酮戊二酸，而不是别的 α-酮酸？
quiz.q_en: Why is the amino group handed mainly to alpha-ketoglutarate rather than to some other alpha-keto acid?

options.zh: 因为它能自由穿过线粒体内膜进基质
options.en: It crosses the inner membrane without a carrier

options.zh: 因为这一步转氨反应不需要 PLP 参与
options.en: That transamination step needs no PLP cofactor

options.zh: 因为谷氨酸是唯一含两个羧基的氨基酸
options.en: Glutamate is the only diacidic amino acid

options.zh: 因为它属于 TCA 成员，能被不断消耗
options.en: It is a TCA member and is drained constantly

quiz.explain_zh: 这正是课上给的理由：α-酮戊二酸是 TCA 循环的成员，接受氨基变成谷氨酸后，谷氨酸再脱氨又变回 α-酮戊二酸并被循环消耗掉，因此这个受体可以源源不断地周转，而普通氨基酸不行。谷氨酸并不是唯一的二羧氨基酸，天冬氨酸也是；能否穿膜不是选它的理由，何况穿膜靠的是特定的转运体；转氨反应一律需要 PLP，没有例外。
quiz.explain_en: This is the reason he gave: alpha-ketoglutarate is a TCA cycle member, so once it takes on an amino group to become glutamate, glutamate can shed it again and return to alpha-ketoglutarate, which the cycle keeps consuming. The acceptor therefore turns over indefinitely, which an ordinary amino acid cannot do. Glutamate is not the only dicarboxylic amino acid, since aspartate is one too. Membrane crossing is not the criterion and in any case depends on specific carriers. Every transamination requires PLP, with no exceptions.

quiz.q_zh: 转氨基作用的直接产物是什么？
quiz.q_en: What are the immediate products of a transamination reaction?

options.zh: 一分子胺和一分子的二氧化碳
options.en: An amine plus one molecule of CO2

options.zh: 一分子 α-酮酸和一分子游离氨
options.en: An alpha-keto acid plus free ammonia

options.zh: 一分子亚氨基酸和一分子的尿素
options.en: An imino acid plus one urea molecule

options.zh: 一分子 α-酮酸和一个新的氨基酸
options.en: An alpha-keto acid plus a new amino acid

quiz.explain_zh: 转氨基是氨基的交换：供体氨基酸变成 α-酮酸，受体 α-酮酸变成新的氨基酸，全程氮都留在分子上。产生游离氨的是氧化脱氨，不是转氨；亚氨基酸是氧化脱氨的中间体，尿素则要到肝内尿素循环才生成；胺加二氧化碳是脱羧基作用的产物。
quiz.explain_en: Transamination is an exchange: the donor amino acid becomes an alpha-keto acid and the acceptor keto acid becomes a new amino acid, with nitrogen never leaving a molecule. Free ammonia comes from oxidative deamination, not from transamination. An imino acid is the intermediate of oxidative deamination, and urea is made only later in the hepatic urea cycle. An amine plus carbon dioxide is what decarboxylation yields.

title_zh: 谷丙／谷草转氨酶的临床意义，与葡萄糖-丙氨酸循环
title_en: What ALT and AST mean clinically, and the glucose-alanine cycle

points.zh: 体检报告上的谷丙转氨酶，指的是谷氨酸和丙氨酸之间发生的转氨基作用
points.en: The ALT on a blood panel refers to transamination between glutamate and alanine.

points.zh: 谷草转氨酶指的是谷氨酸和草酰乙酸之间发生的转氨基作用
points.en: AST refers to transamination between glutamate and oxaloacetate.

points.zh: 这两种酶在肝脏里含量很多
points.en: Both enzymes are abundant in the liver.

points.zh: 他的解释是：数值飙升说明体内游离氨基酸很多，机体因此需要大量的转氨酶
points.en: His explanation was that a spike means free amino acids are abundant, so the body needs a lot of aminotransferase.

points.zh: 游离氨基酸多说明机体某一块发生了降解，有细胞或组织坏死，氨基酸才进入肝脏发生转氨
points.en: Abundant free amino acids mean something in the body has broken down, with cells or tissue necrosed, releasing amino acids that reach the liver and get transaminated.

points.zh: 所以转氨酶可以用来监测机体的健康状况，急速升高代表遭遇了比较严重的问题
points.en: Aminotransferases therefore serve to monitor health, and a rapid rise signals a serious problem.

points.zh: 接着他讲一个「小支点」的循环，他叫它葡萄糖丙酮酸循环
points.en: He then introduced a side loop, which he called the glucose-pyruvate cycle.

points.zh: 肌肉里葡萄糖大量经 EMP 途径降解成丙酮酸，丙酮酸在转氨基作用下变成丙氨酸——丙酮酸的酮基换成 NH2，上面是甲基，下面就是 α-氨基
points.en: In muscle, glucose is broken down through the EMP pathway to pyruvate, and transamination converts pyruvate to alanine: swap the keto group for NH2 and, with a methyl group above, you have an alpha-amino acid.

points.zh: 丙氨酸可以在血液里自由流动进入肝脏，在肝内通过糖异生生成葡萄糖，再供给肌肉
points.en: Alanine travels freely in blood to the liver, where gluconeogenesis turns it into glucose that is supplied back to muscle.

extra.zh: 「转氨酶升高＝机体需要更多转氨酶，所以合成上去了」是错的诱导逻辑。血清 ALT/AST 升高是肝细胞（或心肌、骨骼肌）损伤、细胞膜破裂后胞内酶漏进血液的结果，验的是「漏出来的酶」，不是机体诱导表达的酶。他随后（约 02:03:08 之后）说「代表机体某一部分开始降解或坏死」，那句方向是对的，中间那一句解释不对。
extra.en: The idea that a rise in aminotransferase means the body induced more of the enzyme is the wrong causal logic. Elevated serum ALT/AST reflects injury to hepatocytes, myocardium or skeletal muscle: the membranes break and the intracellular enzyme leaks into blood, so the assay measures leaked enzyme, not induced expression. His follow-up just after 02:03:08, that it signals some part of the body starting to break down or necrose, points the right way; only the explanation in between is wrong.

extra.zh: 这个循环的标准名称是葡萄糖-丙氨酸循环 glucose-alanine cycle，他两次叫成「葡萄糖丙酮酸循环」（约 02:03:41 和 02:05:14），但内容讲对了，也明说了「是以丙氨酸为媒介来转运的」。考试写丙氨酸。
extra.en: The standard name is the glucose-alanine cycle. He calls it the glucose-pyruvate cycle twice, around 02:03:41 and 02:05:14, but the content he gives is right and he says explicitly that alanine is the carrier. Write alanine in the exam.

extra.zh: ALT 主要在肝细胞胞质里，AST 胞质和线粒体都有，而且心肌、骨骼肌含量高，所以 AST/ALT 比值才有定位意义：急性病毒性肝炎以 ALT 升高为主，酒精性肝病常见 AST/ALT 大于 2（线粒体型 AST 也漏出来），心肌与横纹肌损伤则以 AST、CK 为主。
extra.en: ALT sits mainly in hepatocyte cytosol, while AST occurs in both cytosol and mitochondria and is abundant in cardiac and skeletal muscle, which is what makes the AST/ALT ratio informative. Acute viral hepatitis raises ALT predominantly; alcoholic liver disease often shows AST/ALT above two because mitochondrial AST leaks as well; cardiac and skeletal muscle injury raises AST and CK instead.

extra.zh: 葡萄糖-丙氨酸循环一箭双雕，课上只讲了碳的那一半：它既把肌肉的碳（丙酮酸）送回肝做糖异生，又把肌肉产生的氨以无毒的丙氨酸形式安全运到肝脏，在肝内脱氨进尿素循环。代价是肝要替肌肉承担糖异生的 ATP 消耗，所以这是一种把能量负担从肌肉转移到肝的安排。
extra.en: The glucose-alanine cycle does two jobs and the lecture covered only the carbon half: it returns muscle carbon as pyruvate to the liver for gluconeogenesis, and it carries muscle-derived ammonia safely as non-toxic alanine to the liver, where deamination feeds the urea cycle. The price is that the liver bears the ATP cost of gluconeogenesis on the muscle's behalf, shifting the energy burden from muscle to liver.

quiz.q_zh: 血清 ALT／AST 升高的直接原因是什么？
quiz.q_en: What directly causes serum ALT/AST to rise?

options.zh: 肾小球滤过下降，酶无法被排出
options.en: Falling filtration keeps the enzymes in blood

options.zh: 维生素 B6 升高使酶的活性增强
options.en: Rising vitamin B6 boosts the enzyme activity

options.zh: 肝细胞受损破裂，胞内酶漏入血液
options.en: Damaged liver cells leak the enzymes out

options.zh: 机体为处理氨基酸而诱导酶的表达
options.en: The body induces more enzyme for amino acids

quiz.explain_zh: 这两种酶本来在细胞内，细胞膜一旦破裂就漏进血液，所以血清里的活性反映的是细胞损伤的程度。课上说的「机体需要大量转氨酶所以合成上去」是错的诱导逻辑；转氨酶是蛋白质，不经肾小球正常排泄，肾功能不是它的清除途径；维生素 B6 是辅基来源，补 B6 并不会把血清酶活性推高到病理水平。
quiz.explain_en: These enzymes normally sit inside cells and spill into blood when membranes rupture, so serum activity reports the extent of cell injury. The lecture's induction logic, that the body makes more enzyme because it needs it, is wrong. Aminotransferases are proteins and are not cleared through glomerular filtration, so renal function is not their disposal route. Vitamin B6 supplies the cofactor, but taking it does not drive serum activity to pathological levels.

quiz.q_zh: 葡萄糖-丙氨酸循环中，把氨基从肌肉运到肝脏的分子是哪一个？
quiz.q_en: In the glucose-alanine cycle, which molecule carries amino nitrogen from muscle to liver?

options.zh: 天冬氨酸，由草酰乙酸转氨生成
options.en: Aspartate, made by transaminating OAA

options.zh: 丙氨酸，由丙酮酸转氨基生成
options.en: Alanine, from pyruvate by transamination

options.zh: 乳酸，由丙酮酸经 LDH 还原
options.en: Lactate, from pyruvate reduced by LDH

options.zh: 谷氨酰胺，由谷氨酸接受氨生成
options.en: Glutamine, from glutamate plus ammonia

quiz.explain_zh: 肌肉里丙酮酸经转氨得到丙氨酸，丙氨酸入血到肝，肝内再脱氨并把碳骨架用于糖异生，所以它同时运碳和运氮。乳酸走的是另一条循环（Cori 循环），只运碳不运氮；谷氨酰胺确实是运氨的重要形式，但那是另一条路线，不是这个循环的媒介；天冬氨酸主要在尿素循环里提供第二个氮原子，不承担肌肉到肝的运输。
quiz.explain_en: In muscle, pyruvate is transaminated to alanine, which travels to the liver where it is deaminated and its skeleton used for gluconeogenesis, so it carries both carbon and nitrogen. Lactate belongs to the Cori cycle and carries carbon only. Glutamine is genuinely an important ammonia carrier, but by a different route rather than as this cycle's vehicle. Aspartate mainly supplies the second nitrogen atom in the urea cycle and does not do muscle-to-liver transport.

title_zh: 乳酸循环、谷氨酰胺运氨，与氧化脱氨的机制
title_en: The Cori cycle, glutamine as the ammonia carrier, and the mechanism of oxidative deamination

points.zh: 乳酸循环（Cori 循环）靠 NADH 把丙酮酸还原成乳酸，以乳酸的形式把碳运出肌肉
points.en: In the Cori cycle NADH reduces pyruvate to lactate, exporting the carbon from muscle as lactate.

points.zh: 乳酸同样在肝脏糖异生变成葡萄糖，再回到肌肉里
points.en: Lactate likewise undergoes gluconeogenesis in liver to glucose, which returns to muscle.

points.zh: 所以肌肉的糖有多条补充路线：以丙氨酸为媒介的一条，以乳酸为媒介的一条
points.en: Muscle glucose therefore has several resupply routes: one using alanine as the vehicle, one using lactate.

points.zh: 谷氨酰胺是体内氨基主要的储存以及运输形式
points.en: Glutamine is the body's main storage and transport form for amino nitrogen.

points.zh: 原因之一是谷氨酰胺比较容易透过细胞膜，而且它也是转氨基作用里比较关键的一员
points.en: One reason is that glutamine crosses membranes relatively easily, and it is also a key participant in transamination chemistry.

points.zh: 转氨基小结：把普通氨基酸上的氨基转给谷氨酸或天冬氨酸，它们变成 α-酮戊二酸后进 TCA 循环
points.en: Summary of transamination: the amino group of an ordinary amino acid is handed to glutamate or aspartate, which as alpha-ketoglutarate then enter the TCA cycle.

points.zh: 第二种脱氨方式叫氧化脱氨，用得稍微少一点，但也是很主要的一种
points.en: The second route is oxidative deamination, used somewhat less often but still a major one.

points.zh: 过程：正常氨基酸在酶的作用下先把氨基上的氢原子夺走，生成亚氨（亚氨基酸），这在有机化学里是不稳定结构
points.en: The mechanism: an enzyme first removes hydrogen from the amino group to give an imine (imino acid), an unstable structure in organic chemistry.

points.zh: 一分子水来进攻，就生成 α-酮酸并放出游离的氨；这与转氨基最大的区别就是它产生游离氨，而游离氨要掺进尿素循环、最终以尿液中的尿素排出
points.en: A water molecule attacks, giving an alpha-keto acid and releasing free ammonia; that release is the key difference from transamination, and the free ammonia is committed to the urea cycle and finally excreted as urinary urea.

extra.zh: 他没有点名这一步的酶。哺乳动物体内真正有意义的氧化脱氨几乎只有 L-谷氨酸脱氢酶 GDH 作用于谷氨酸这一条：定位在线粒体基质，NAD+ 或 NADP+ 都能当辅酶，别构上受 ATP 和 GTP 抑制、受 ADP 和 GDP 激活——能量不足时才放手脱氮。各种 L-氨基酸氧化酶在人体内活性都很低。
extra.en: He never names the enzyme. In mammals essentially the only meaningful oxidative deamination is L-glutamate dehydrogenase acting on glutamate: it sits in the mitochondrial matrix, can use either NAD+ or NADP+, and is allosterically inhibited by ATP and GTP while activated by ADP and GDP, so nitrogen is released when energy is short. The various L-amino acid oxidases have very low activity in humans.

extra.zh: 他说氧化脱氨「用得比较少、只是一种补充」，这个排序其实反了。转氨基本身根本不脱氮，只是把氮搬家；真正把氮变成游离氨、送进尿素循环的，正是转氨基与 GDH 偶联的联合脱氨，而其中释放氨的那一步就是氧化脱氨。它不是补充，是主干。
extra.en: He ranks oxidative deamination as a minor supplement, which inverts the picture. Transamination removes no nitrogen at all and merely relocates it; what actually converts nitrogen into free ammonia and commits it to the urea cycle is transdeamination, the coupling of transamination with glutamate dehydrogenase, and the ammonia-releasing step in that coupling is oxidative deamination. It is the trunk, not a supplement.

extra.zh: 他把产物叫「游离的氨基」。准确说是游离氨 NH3 / NH4+：生理 pH 下 98% 以上以 NH4+ 存在，只有中性的 NH3 能自由穿过细胞膜和血脑屏障，这正是氨中毒伤脑的物理基础。「氨基」是还挂在分子上的 —NH2，「氨」是已经离开分子的独立分子。从这一段往后，课上说的都是氨。
extra.en: He calls the product a free amino group. Precisely, it is free ammonia, NH3/NH4+: at physiological pH over 98% exists as NH4+, and only the neutral NH3 crosses membranes and the blood-brain barrier freely, which is the physical basis of ammonia's neurotoxicity. An amino group is the -NH2 still attached to a molecule; ammonia is the free molecule. From this passage on, the lecture means ammonia.

extra.zh: 谷氨酰胺怎么运氨：谷氨酰胺合成酶（胞质，耗 1 个 ATP）把 NH4+ 固定到谷氨酸的 γ-羧基上生成谷氨酰胺，无毒、电中性、血浆浓度最高；到了肝或肾，谷氨酰胺酶再水解放出 NH4+——在肝进尿素循环，在肾则直接分泌到尿里。肌肉和脑就是靠这条路把氨安全送走的。
extra.en: How glutamine carries ammonia: cytosolic glutamine synthetase spends one ATP to fix NH4+ onto the gamma-carboxyl of glutamate, giving glutamine, which is non-toxic, electrically neutral and the most abundant amino acid in plasma. In liver or kidney, glutaminase then hydrolyses it to release NH4+, which enters the urea cycle in liver and is secreted into urine in kidney. This is how muscle and brain dispose of ammonia safely.

quiz.q_zh: 氧化脱氨的中间产物与最终产物分别是什么？
quiz.q_en: What are the intermediate and the final products of oxidative deamination?

options.zh: 亚氨基酸中间体；α-酮酸与游离的氨
options.en: An imino acid, then keto acid and ammonia

options.zh: 酮亚胺中间体；谷氨酸与磷酸吡哆胺
options.en: A ketimine, then glutamate and PMP form

options.zh: 烯醇中间体；丙酮酸与 NADH
options.en: An enol form, then pyruvate and NADH

options.zh: 醛亚胺中间体；胺类物质与二氧化碳
options.en: An aldimine, then an amine plus CO2

quiz.explain_zh: 氧化脱氨先脱氢生成亚氨基酸，这个结构不稳定，水一进攻就水解成 α-酮酸并放出游离氨。醛亚胺与酮亚胺是转氨反应里 PLP 经历的 Schiff 碱中间体，产物是新氨基酸而不是氨；胺加二氧化碳是脱羧基的产物；烯醇中间体与丙酮酸、NADH 属于糖酵解和乳酸生成，与脱氨无关。
quiz.explain_en: Oxidative deamination first removes hydrogen to give an imino acid, an unstable structure that water attacks, hydrolysing it to an alpha-keto acid and releasing free ammonia. Aldimine and ketimine are the Schiff base intermediates PLP passes through during transamination, whose product is a new amino acid rather than ammonia. An amine plus carbon dioxide is the decarboxylation product. An enol intermediate with pyruvate and NADH belongs to glycolysis and lactate formation, not to deamination.

quiz.q_zh: 哺乳动物体内真正承担氧化脱氨的是哪一个酶？
quiz.q_en: Which enzyme actually carries out oxidative deamination in mammals?

options.zh: L-谷氨酸脱氢酶，作用于谷氨酸
options.en: L-glutamate dehydrogenase, on glutamate

options.zh: 谷氨酰胺酶，作用于谷氨酰胺酰胺基
options.en: Glutaminase, on the glutamine amide

options.zh: L-氨基酸氧化酶，作用于多数氨基酸
options.en: L-amino acid oxidase, on most amino acids

options.zh: 腺苷酸脱氨酶，作用于腺苷酸 AMP
options.en: AMP deaminase, acting on adenylate

quiz.explain_zh: L-谷氨酸脱氢酶位于线粒体基质，把谷氨酸氧化脱氨成 α-酮戊二酸并放出 NH4+，是转氨基之后真正脱氮的那一步。L-氨基酸氧化酶在人体内活性很低，不承担主要通量；腺苷酸脱氨酶确实放氨，但它属于肌肉的嘌呤核苷酸循环，底物是核苷酸不是氨基酸；谷氨酰胺酶水解的是酰胺键，属于水解脱酰胺，不是氧化反应。
quiz.explain_en: L-glutamate dehydrogenase sits in the mitochondrial matrix and oxidatively deaminates glutamate to alpha-ketoglutarate while releasing NH4+, the step that actually removes nitrogen after transamination. L-amino acid oxidase has very low activity in humans and carries no significant flux. AMP deaminase does release ammonia, but it belongs to the purine nucleotide cycle in muscle and its substrate is a nucleotide, not an amino acid. Glutaminase hydrolyses an amide bond, which is hydrolytic deamidation rather than an oxidation.

quiz.q_zh: 谷氨酰胺在氮代谢中的主要角色是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is glutamine's main role in nitrogen metabolism?

options.zh: 尿素循环中唯一的直接氮供体
options.en: The sole nitrogen donor of the urea cycle

options.zh: 转氨酶必需的辅酶载体分子
options.en: A required coenzyme carrier for ALT/AST

options.zh: 唯一的纯生酮氨基酸碳骨架
options.en: The only purely ketogenic carbon skeleton

options.zh: 体内氨的主要储存与运输形式
options.en: The main store and transport form of ammonia

quiz.explain_zh: 谷氨酰胺把有毒的 NH4+ 以酰胺形式固定成中性无毒的分子，是血浆里浓度最高的氨基酸，负责把肌肉和脑产生的氨安全送到肝和肾。尿素循环的两个氮分别来自游离氨（经氨甲酰磷酸）和天冬氨酸，谷氨酰胺不是唯一供体；转氨酶的辅基是 PLP，不是谷氨酰胺；纯生酮氨基酸是亮氨酸和赖氨酸，而谷氨酰胺是生糖的。
quiz.explain_en: Glutamine locks toxic NH4+ into a neutral, non-toxic amide, is the most abundant amino acid in plasma, and ferries ammonia from muscle and brain safely to liver and kidney. The urea cycle's two nitrogens come from free ammonia via carbamoyl phosphate and from aspartate, so glutamine is not its sole donor. The aminotransferase cofactor is PLP, not glutamine. The purely ketogenic amino acids are leucine and lysine, whereas glutamine is glucogenic.

title_zh: 联合脱氨，与被他叫作「非氧化脱氨」的脱羧基作用
title_en: Transdeamination, and the decarboxylation he called non-oxidative deamination

points.zh: 他说联合脱氨主要发生在肌肉里，别的部位主要还是转氨基作用，氧化脱氨只是一种补充
points.en: He said transdeamination happens mainly in muscle, that other tissues rely chiefly on transamination, and that oxidative deamination is only a supplement.

points.zh: 第一步：任意一种经典氨基酸在转氨酶作用下，把氨基转移到谷氨酸上
points.en: Step one: any classical amino acid hands its amino group to glutamate via an aminotransferase.

points.zh: 第二步：谷氨酸再在他称为谷草转氨酶的酶作用下，把氨基转给天冬氨酸
points.en: Step two: glutamate then passes the amino group to aspartate, by what he called AST.

points.zh: 第三步：天冬氨酸参与一个小循环，把氨基交给次黄嘌呤
points.en: Step three: aspartate enters a small cycle and gives the amino group to hypoxanthine.

points.zh: 第四步：接收后生成腺苷酸，腺苷酸再在腺苷酸脱氨酶作用下放出真正游离的氨
points.en: Step four: this yields adenylate, and AMP deaminase then releases genuinely free ammonia.

points.zh: 叫「联合」是因为它联合了核苷酸一起参与——要记的是谷氨酸、天冬氨酸、腺苷酸联合起来把氨基脱掉
points.en: It is called joint deamination because nucleotides join in; what to remember is that glutamate, aspartate and adenylate act together to strip the amino group.

points.zh: 他明确说每一步的细节可以不用记，记住这个联合的框架就行
points.en: He said explicitly that the step-by-step detail need not be memorised, only the framework of the joint process.

points.zh: 第四种、也是最少见的一种，他叫作「非氧化型的脱氨」：氨基酸在磷酸吡哆醛（维生素 B6 的辅酶形式）作用下直接把羧基脱去
points.en: The fourth and rarest route, which he called non-oxidative deamination: with pyridoxal phosphate, the vitamin B6 coenzyme form, the amino acid loses its carboxyl group outright.

points.zh: 羧基丢掉以后，剩下的那一整块就是一种游离的胺，可以再用别的方式把它消耗掉
points.en: Once the carboxyl is gone, what remains is a free amine, which can then be disposed of by other means.

extra.zh: 第四种反应的名字错位了，他没有自我更正。他描述的是氨基酸脱羧基作用 decarboxylation：产物是胺，氮还留在分子里，根本没有脱氨（组氨酸→组胺、谷氨酸→GABA、5-羟色氨酸→5-羟色胺）。真正的非氧化脱氨指的是脱水（丝氨酸、苏氨酸经脱水酶）、脱硫（半胱氨酸）和脱酰胺（谷氨酰胺酶、天冬酰胺酶），那些才放出氨。注意：他这一段说的产物「胺」本身是对的，从 02:11:12 讲氨中毒起说的才是「氨」，两个字不要混。
extra.en: The name of the fourth reaction is misapplied and he never corrects it. What he describes is amino acid decarboxylation: the product is an amine, the nitrogen stays in the molecule, and nothing is deaminated (histidine to histamine, glutamate to GABA, 5-hydroxytryptophan to serotonin). True non-oxidative deamination means dehydration (serine and threonine via dehydratases), desulfhydration (cysteine) and deamidation (glutaminase, asparaginase), and those do release ammonia. Note that the amine he speaks of here is correct; only from the ammonia-toxicity passage at 02:11:12 onward does the word mean ammonia.

extra.zh: 他讲的这条流程其实是嘌呤核苷酸循环 purine nucleotide cycle，确实主要在骨骼肌和脑。但教科书首选的「联合脱氨基作用」是转氨基 + 谷氨酸脱氢酶氧化脱氨的偶联，主要在肝和肾——那才是肝肾里最主要的脱氮途径。他说「别的部位主要还是转氨基作用」，等于把肝肾这条最重要的漏掉了。
extra.en: The sequence he gives is the purine nucleotide cycle, which does operate mainly in skeletal muscle and brain. But the textbook's primary transdeamination is the coupling of transamination with glutamate dehydrogenase, chiefly in liver and kidney, and that is the dominant nitrogen-removing route there. By saying other tissues rely mainly on transamination, he leaves out the most important pathway of liver and kidney.

extra.zh: 受体准确说是次黄嘌呤核苷酸 IMP，不是游离碱基次黄嘌呤。天冬氨酸与 IMP 先缩合成腺苷酸代琥珀酸（耗 GTP），裂解酶放出延胡索酸并生成 AMP，AMP 脱氨酶再水解放出 NH4+ 并变回 IMP。放出的延胡索酸正好补进 TCA 循环，所以这个循环在脱氮的同时也给肌肉补四碳中间物；剧烈运动时它明显上调。
extra.en: The acceptor is precisely inosine monophosphate, not the free base hypoxanthine. Aspartate first condenses with IMP to form adenylosuccinate at the cost of one GTP, a lyase then releases fumarate and yields AMP, and AMP deaminase hydrolyses it to release NH4+ and regenerate IMP. The fumarate released tops up the TCA cycle, so the loop supplies muscle with four-carbon intermediates while removing nitrogen, and it is markedly upregulated in vigorous exercise.

extra.zh: 脱氨基与脱羧基的产物完全不同：脱氨基留下 α-酮酸，是碳骨架，进能量代谢；脱羧基留下胺，是生物活性物质，由单胺氧化酶 MAO 或二胺氧化酶清除。两类反应都以 PLP 为辅基，这大概正是他把名字弄混的原因——辅基相同不等于反应相同。
extra.en: The two reactions give entirely different products: deamination leaves an alpha-keto acid, a carbon skeleton bound for energy metabolism, whereas decarboxylation leaves an amine, a bioactive substance cleared by monoamine oxidase or diamine oxidase. Both classes use PLP as prosthetic group, which is probably why the names got swapped: a shared cofactor does not make the reactions the same.

quiz.q_zh: 课上讲的这条「联合脱氨」，标准名称与主要发生部位是什么？
quiz.q_en: The joint deamination described in class: what is its standard name and main location?

options.zh: 鸟氨酸循环，主要在肝细胞线粒体
options.en: The ornithine cycle, in liver mitochondria

options.zh: 苹果酸穿梭循环，主要在心肌与肝
options.en: The malate shuttle cycle, in heart and liver

options.zh: 嘌呤核苷酸循环，主要在骨骼肌和脑
options.en: The purine nucleotide cycle, in muscle and brain

options.zh: 葡萄糖-丙氨酸循环，主要在肌肉
options.en: The glucose-alanine cycle, in muscle tissue

quiz.explain_zh: 谷氨酸把氨基交给天冬氨酸、天冬氨酸交给 IMP 生成 AMP、AMP 脱氨酶放氨，这一整套就是嘌呤核苷酸循环，主要在骨骼肌和脑。鸟氨酸循环是尿素循环的别名，处理的是已经放出来的氨；苹果酸穿梭运的是还原当量，不脱氮；葡萄糖-丙氨酸循环运的是丙氨酸的碳和氮，本身不释放游离氨。
quiz.explain_en: Glutamate passing its amino group to aspartate, aspartate passing it to IMP to form AMP, and AMP deaminase releasing ammonia is the purine nucleotide cycle, operating mainly in skeletal muscle and brain. The ornithine cycle is another name for the urea cycle and disposes of ammonia already released. The malate shuttle moves reducing equivalents and removes no nitrogen. The glucose-alanine cycle transports alanine's carbon and nitrogen without itself liberating free ammonia.

quiz.q_zh: 氨基酸在 PLP 作用下脱去羧基，这类反应叫什么、产物是什么？
quiz.q_en: When an amino acid loses its carboxyl group with PLP, what is the reaction called and what is the product?

options.zh: 氨基酸脱羧基作用，产物是胺类
options.en: Decarboxylation, giving an amine product

options.zh: 非氧化脱氨基作用，产物是游离氨
options.en: Non-oxidative deamination, giving ammonia

options.zh: 氧化脱氨基作用，产物是 α-酮酸
options.en: Oxidative deamination, giving a keto acid

options.zh: 氨基转移作用，产物是新的氨基酸
options.en: Transamination, giving a new amino acid

quiz.explain_zh: 脱去羧基、放出 CO2、氮仍留在分子上，这是氨基酸脱羧基作用，产物是胺——组氨酸给组胺、谷氨酸给 GABA、5-羟色氨酸给 5-羟色胺。课上把它叫成了非氧化脱氨，但非氧化脱氨指的是脱水、脱硫、脱酰胺那一类，产物是氨；氧化脱氨的产物是 α-酮酸加氨；转氨的产物是新氨基酸，也没有 CO2 放出。
quiz.explain_en: Losing the carboxyl group, releasing CO2 and keeping the nitrogen in the molecule is amino acid decarboxylation, whose products are amines: histidine gives histamine, glutamate gives GABA, 5-hydroxytryptophan gives serotonin. The lecture calls it non-oxidative deamination, but that term covers dehydration, desulfhydration and deamidation, which yield ammonia. Oxidative deamination yields an alpha-keto acid plus ammonia, and transamination yields a new amino acid with no CO2 released.

quiz.q_zh: 下列哪一类反应才是真正的非氧化脱氨基？
quiz.q_en: Which class of reaction is genuinely non-oxidative deamination?

options.zh: 谷氨酸经脱氢酶生成 α-酮戊二酸
options.en: Glutamate oxidised to alpha-ketoglutarate

options.zh: 丙氨酸经转氨酶把氨基交给酮酸
options.en: Alanine handing its amino group to a keto acid

options.zh: 丝氨酸、苏氨酸经脱水酶脱水放氨
options.en: Serine and threonine dehydrated by a dehydratase

options.zh: 组氨酸经脱羧酶生成组胺放 CO2
options.en: Histidine decarboxylated into histamine plus CO2

quiz.explain_zh: 丝氨酸、苏氨酸经脱水酶脱水生成不稳定的烯氨，再水解放出氨并得到酮酸，全程没有氧化还原，属于典型的非氧化脱氨；半胱氨酸脱硫、谷氨酰胺与天冬酰胺脱酰胺也属这一类。组氨酸生成组胺是脱羧基，放的是 CO2 不是氨；谷氨酸经脱氢酶那一步伴随 NAD(P)+ 还原，是氧化脱氨；转氨反应压根不释放氨。
quiz.explain_en: Serine and threonine are dehydrated by a dehydratase to an unstable enamine, which hydrolyses to release ammonia and give a keto acid, with no redox change anywhere: the textbook case of non-oxidative deamination, alongside cysteine desulfhydration and the deamidation of glutamine and asparagine. Histidine to histamine is a decarboxylation releasing CO2 rather than ammonia. The glutamate dehydrogenase step reduces NAD(P)+ and is therefore oxidative. Transamination releases no ammonia at all.

title_zh: 游离氨的毒性、氨中毒，与含氮废物的三种排泄形式
title_en: Ammonia toxicity, ammonia poisoning, and the three forms of nitrogen excretion

points.zh: 联合脱氨和氧化脱氨这两步都会产生游离的氨
points.en: Both transdeamination and oxidative deamination generate free ammonia.

points.zh: 游离氨在体内太多就会导致氨中毒
points.en: Too much free ammonia in the body causes ammonia poisoning.

points.zh: 他给的诱因是：人体分解游离氨的能力不够了，处理不过来
points.en: The cause he gave: the body's capacity to dispose of free ammonia falls short of the load.

points.zh: 他说氨中毒最主要发生在尿毒症患者，因为肾已经停止工作，没办法以水溶的尿素形式把氨带出去
points.en: He said ammonia poisoning occurs mainly in uraemic patients, because the kidney has stopped working and cannot carry ammonia out as water-soluble urea.

points.zh: 他说尿毒症患者体内会积攒大量的氨，也会有大量酮体的产生
points.en: He said uraemic patients accumulate large amounts of ammonia and also produce large amounts of ketone bodies.

points.zh: 氨的去路有三种：直接以氨气排出、以尿酸排出、以尿素排出
points.en: Ammonia has three exits: released directly as ammonia gas, excreted as uric acid, or excreted as urea.

points.zh: 他举农村堆肥、化粪池会产生大量氨气来说明排氨，并说这主要是那些微生物有排氨途径
points.en: He illustrated ammonia excretion with rural compost heaps and septic tanks giving off ammonia, saying the pathway belongs mainly to those microbes.

points.zh: 他说人体没有这个途径，不能把游离的氨直接以氨气的形式排出；人主要以尿素形式排氨，只有鸟类排尿酸
points.en: He said humans lack this route and cannot release free ammonia as gas; humans excrete mainly as urea, and only birds excrete uric acid.

points.zh: 尿素在水里的溶解度比尿酸大得多，人体只需要很少的水就能把尿素全部排掉；尿酸溶解度小，要排一点点也得用大量水，所以以尿素排出是一种保水方案
points.en: Urea is far more soluble in water than uric acid, so very little water suffices to clear it, whereas uric acid needs a lot of water for even a small amount; excreting urea is therefore a water-conserving strategy.

extra.zh: 氨中毒的主要病因是肝，不是肾。尿素循环在肝细胞里完成，所以肝衰竭、门体分流或尿素循环酶遗传缺陷（如 OTC 缺乏）时，氨转不成尿素，才出现高氨血症和肝性脑病。尿毒症是肾衰竭导致尿素、肌酐、尿酸等含氮废物潴留（氮质血症），血氨通常只是轻中度升高。他自己说的「人体分解游离氨的能力不够」，指的正是尿素循环的能力——那是肝的功能。
extra.en: Severe ammonia toxicity comes from the liver, not the kidney. The urea cycle runs in hepatocytes, so hyperammonaemia and hepatic encephalopathy arise from liver failure, portosystemic shunting, or inherited urea cycle enzyme defects such as OTC deficiency, when ammonia cannot be converted to urea. Uraemia is renal failure with retention of urea, creatinine and uric acid (azotaemia), and blood ammonia is usually only mildly to moderately raised. His own phrase, that the capacity to dispose of free ammonia has run out, refers to urea cycle capacity, which is a liver function.

extra.zh: 「尿毒症患者会产生大量酮体」不成立。酮体堆积见于糖尿病酮症酸中毒和长期饥饿／生酮状态，动力是胰岛素低下时脂肪酸氧化失控。肾衰竭确实造成代谢性酸中毒，但那来自潴留的 H+、硫酸盐和磷酸盐，不是生酮。相应地，呼气有烂苹果味（丙酮）的是酮症酸中毒患者，尿毒症的特征气味是氨味／尿味。
extra.en: Uraemic patients do not produce large amounts of ketone bodies. Ketone accumulation belongs to diabetic ketoacidosis and to prolonged fasting or ketogenic states, driven by unrestrained fatty acid oxidation when insulin is low. Renal failure does cause metabolic acidosis, but from retained H+, sulfate and phosphate rather than from ketogenesis. Correspondingly, the rotten-apple breath of acetone belongs to ketoacidosis, while uraemia characteristically smells of ammonia or urine.

extra.zh: 两处生物学举例都偏了。第一，排氨型（ammonotelic）动物的真实例子是水生动物——硬骨鱼、水生无脊椎动物、两栖类幼体，它们把 NH3/NH4+ 直接溶进周围大量的水里；堆肥和化粪池放出氨气，是细菌脲酶把动物已经排出的尿素、尿酸水解，加上蛋白腐败，属于腐败分解，不是活体动物的排泄策略。第二，排尿酸也不是鸟类专利：爬行动物（蛇、蜥蜴、陆龟）、大多数昆虫、陆生蜗牛同样是排尿酸型，共同理由正是他讲的省水，而且对有壳的卵来说，把氮存成几乎不溶的固体不会毒到胚胎。
extra.en: Both zoological examples are off. First, the real ammonotelic animals are aquatic: bony fish, aquatic invertebrates and amphibian larvae, which dump NH3/NH4+ straight into the surrounding water. Compost heaps and septic tanks give off ammonia because bacterial urease hydrolyses the urea and uric acid animals have already excreted, plus general protein decay; that is decomposition, not a living animal's excretory strategy. Second, uricotely is not unique to birds: reptiles such as snakes, lizards and tortoises, most insects and land snails are uricotelic too, for exactly the water-saving reason he gave, and for a shelled egg, storing nitrogen as a nearly insoluble solid keeps it from poisoning the embryo.

extra.zh: 「以尿素的形式排出大量的游离的氨」把他自己的逻辑说反了：排出去的恰恰不再是游离氨。氨在肝内被固定成尿素（NH4+ + CO2，加上天冬氨酸提供的第二个氮 → 尿素）之后，才不再游离、不再有毒。正确说法是尿素溶解度高，让机体能在很少的水里清除大量的氮。另外「人体完全不能排游离氨」也太绝对：肾近端小管把谷氨酰胺脱氨，把 NH4+ 分泌进尿液，每天数十毫摩尔，酸中毒时这条通路还会成倍上调，是排酸最主要的可调缓冲。人体做不到的是靠它处理大量氮负荷。
extra.en: Saying that urea lets the body excrete large amounts of free ammonia inverts his own logic: what leaves is precisely no longer free ammonia. Ammonia is fixed in the liver into urea (NH4+ plus CO2, with a second nitrogen from aspartate) exactly so that it is neither free nor toxic. The correct statement is that urea's high solubility lets the body clear a large nitrogen load in a small volume of water. His claim that humans cannot excrete free ammonia at all is also too absolute: the proximal tubule deaminates glutamine and secretes NH4+ into urine, tens of millimoles a day, rising severalfold in acidosis where it is the main adjustable buffer for acid. What the body cannot do is handle a large nitrogen load this way.

quiz.q_zh: 严重的高氨血症（氨中毒）最主要的病因来自哪个器官？
quiz.q_en: Which organ is chiefly responsible when severe hyperammonaemia develops?

options.zh: 肠道，细菌脲酶分解尿素放出氨
options.en: Gut, where bacterial urease releases ammonia

options.zh: 肾，滤过率下降导致含氮废物潴留
options.en: Kidney, retaining nitrogenous waste products

options.zh: 肝，尿素循环失代偿导致氨堆积
options.en: Liver, failing to convert ammonia into urea

options.zh: 肌肉，嘌呤核苷酸循环过度活跃
options.en: Muscle, running the purine cycle too fast

quiz.explain_zh: 尿素循环只在肝细胞里完整运行，所以肝衰竭、门体分流或尿素循环酶遗传缺陷时，氨转不成尿素，血氨显著升高并引起肝性脑病。肾滤过率下降造成的是尿素、肌酐潴留的氮质血症，血氨通常只轻中度升高，这正是课上说反的地方；肌肉的嘌呤核苷酸循环产氨量有限，且产物随即被谷氨酰胺带走；肠道细菌脲酶确实产氨，但那些氨正常情况下经门静脉入肝被清除，只有在肝功能失代偿时才成为负担。
quiz.explain_en: The complete urea cycle runs only in hepatocytes, so liver failure, portosystemic shunting or an inherited urea cycle enzyme defect leaves ammonia unconverted, raising blood ammonia sharply and producing hepatic encephalopathy. A fall in glomerular filtration produces azotaemia with retained urea and creatinine while blood ammonia rises only mildly, which is where the lecture inverted things. The muscle purine nucleotide cycle makes limited ammonia and glutamine removes it immediately. Gut bacterial urease genuinely makes ammonia, but the portal blood normally delivers it to the liver for clearance, and it only becomes a burden once liver function decompensates.

quiz.q_zh: 关于排尿酸型（uricotelic）动物，正确的说法是哪一个？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about uricotelic animals is correct?

options.zh: 只有鸟类排尿酸，其余动物排尿素
options.en: Only birds do, while all others excrete urea

options.zh: 硬骨鱼和两栖类成体主要排尿酸
options.en: Bony fish and adult amphibians rely on it

options.zh: 排尿酸比排尿素更耗水，故很少见
options.en: It costs more water than urea, so it is rare

options.zh: 鸟类、爬行类和多数昆虫都排尿酸
options.en: Birds, reptiles and most insects excrete it

quiz.explain_zh: 排尿酸是省水的策略，鸟类、爬行动物、大多数昆虫和陆生蜗牛都采用它，对有壳的卵来说还能把氮安全存成固体。课上说的「只有鸟类排尿酸」把范围收得太窄；硬骨鱼是典型的排氨型，直接把 NH4+ 溶进水里，两栖类成体主要排尿素；尿酸几乎不溶，正因为不需要大量水来溶解才被选用，说它更耗水与它被选用的理由相反。
quiz.explain_en: Uricotely is a water-saving strategy used by birds, reptiles, most insects and land snails, and for a shelled egg it also stores nitrogen safely as a solid. The lecture's claim that only birds do it draws the circle far too tightly. Bony fish are the classic ammonotelic case, dumping NH4+ into the water, and adult amphibians excrete mainly urea. Uric acid is almost insoluble, and it is chosen precisely because no large volume of water is needed, so calling it the more water-costly option reverses the reason for its use.

quiz.q_zh: 尿素作为含氮废物，相对尿酸的优势是什么？
quiz.q_en: What advantage does urea have over uric acid as a nitrogenous waste?

options.zh: 溶解度高，用很少的水就能排出
options.en: High solubility, so little water is needed

options.zh: 几乎不溶，可存在卵内不伤胚胎
options.en: Nearly insoluble, so it is safe inside eggs

options.zh: 分子量更小，可自由通过细胞膜
options.en: Smaller size, so it crosses membranes freely

options.zh: 含氮量更高，每分子带走四个氮
options.en: Higher nitrogen content, four N per molecule

quiz.explain_zh: 尿素在 20 ℃ 下的溶解度约 1000 g/L，尿酸只有约 0.06 g/L，相差上万倍，所以少量的水就能带走大量的氮，这正是课上讲的保水逻辑。尿素确实分子小、能穿膜，但那是它无处不在、可被肾髓质用于浓缩尿液的性质，不是相对尿酸的排泄优势；尿素每分子只带走两个氮，尿酸才带四个；几乎不溶是尿酸的性质，是排尿酸动物的优势而不是尿素的。
quiz.explain_en: Urea dissolves at roughly 1000 g/L at 20 degrees Celsius against roughly 0.06 g/L for uric acid, a difference of four orders of magnitude, so a small volume of water carries a large nitrogen load, which is exactly the water-conservation argument given in class. Urea is indeed small and membrane-permeable, but that property explains its ubiquity and its use in renal medullary concentration rather than any excretory advantage over uric acid. Urea carries two nitrogens per molecule while uric acid carries four. Near-insolubility is uric acid's property and the uricotelic animal's advantage, not urea's.

title_zh: 【可跳过·非课程内容】课程收尾、下次安排与闲聊
title_en: [Skippable · not course material] Wrapping up, next session and small talk

points.zh: 他宣布下一次上课时间：先说明天下午六点，随即自己改成下午四点
points.en: He announces the next session: first says six in the afternoon tomorrow, then corrects himself to four.

points.zh: 下一次要讲的内容是尿素循环，以及最后的核酸代谢，这两块都不在本次录音里
points.en: The next session is to cover the urea cycle and, last of all, nucleic acid metabolism, neither of which is in this recording.

points.zh: 他评价蛋白质降解这一章「比较绕」，因为分支多、东西杂
points.en: He calls the protein degradation chapter convoluted, because it has many branches and many separate items.

points.zh: 他问有没有特别不懂的地方，学生说没有、要再复习一下
points.en: He asks whether anything is unclear; the student says no, and will review it again.

points.zh: 他说代谢就是有机结构变来变去，涉及的多了会头晕，自己当年学多了也完全记不住
points.en: He remarks that metabolism is organic structures shifting endlessly, that too much of it makes the head spin, and that he could not keep it straight when he first learned it either.

points.zh: 他拿蛋白质工程和分子生物学里各种试剂和酶的名字（一会儿 T4、一会儿 T5）作对比，说那些更难记
points.en: He compares it with protein engineering and molecular biology, where the reagent and enzyme names run T4 then T5, and says those are harder to remember.

points.zh: 最后是互相道辛苦的闲聊：再辛苦一个月，考过了就解放了
points.en: It closes with mutual encouragement: one more month of effort and the exam will be behind you.

extra.zh: 这份课程材料到这里就结束了。尿素循环和核酸代谢被安排到了这份录音之外的下一次课，因此本课程没有覆盖它们，复习时必须另找来源补：鸟氨酸循环的五步酶与两个氮的来源（一个来自游离氨经氨甲酰磷酸、一个来自天冬氨酸）、限速酶 CPS-1 及其别构激活剂 N-乙酰谷氨酸、以及尿素循环与 TCA 循环通过延胡索酸的连接。
extra.en: The course material ends here. The urea cycle and nucleic acid metabolism were pushed to a session outside this recording, so the course does not cover them and you must fill them in from another source: the five enzymes of the ornithine cycle, the two nitrogen sources (one from free ammonia via carbamoyl phosphate, one from aspartate), the rate-limiting CPS-1 with its allosteric activator N-acetylglutamate, and the link between urea cycle and TCA cycle through fumarate.

extra.zh: 这节课真正的收束点是「氨基怎么脱下来」这一整套：转氨基（搬家，不脱氮）、氧化脱氨（谷氨酸脱氢酶，真正脱氮）、联合脱氨（前两者偶联，或肌肉里的嘌呤核苷酸循环），再加上被他归错名字的脱羧基（产胺，不脱氮）。下一步的尿素循环解决的是另一半问题：脱下来的氨怎么被安全处理掉。把这两半接起来，氨基酸代谢的氮支线才完整。
extra.en: The real closing point of this session is the full set of ways an amino group comes off: transamination (relocation, no nitrogen lost), oxidative deamination (glutamate dehydrogenase, genuine nitrogen removal), transdeamination (the two coupled, or the purine nucleotide cycle in muscle), plus the decarboxylation he filed under the wrong name (an amine, no nitrogen lost). The urea cycle that comes next answers the other half: how the released ammonia is safely disposed of. Join the two halves and the nitrogen branch of amino acid metabolism is complete.

quiz.q_zh: 按课上安排，紧接在「氨基怎么脱下来」之后要讲的两块内容是什么？
quiz.q_en: According to the schedule announced, which two topics come next after amino group removal?

options.zh: 电子传递链与氧化磷酸化
options.en: Electron transport and ATP production

options.zh: 尿素循环与核酸的代谢
options.en: The urea cycle and nucleic acid metabolism

options.zh: 糖异生与磷酸戊糖途径
options.en: Gluconeogenesis and the pentose pathway

options.zh: 酮体生成与胆固醇合成
options.en: Ketogenesis and cholesterol synthesis

quiz.explain_zh: 他在收尾时明确说下一次把尿素循环和最后的核酸代谢讲完，而这两块不在本次录音内。糖异生与磷酸戊糖途径是本次课前半段已经讲过的；酮体生成属于脂质分解那一节，也已经讲过；电子传递链与氧化磷酸化在更早的课上出现，都不是这里的安排。
quiz.explain_en: In closing he states explicitly that the next session will finish the urea cycle and, last, nucleic acid metabolism, neither of which appears in this recording. Gluconeogenesis and the pentose phosphate pathway were covered in the first half of this same session. Ketogenesis belongs to the lipid breakdown section already taught. Electron transport and oxidative phosphorylation came in an earlier lecture, so none of these is what was scheduled.
